title: Founding Research Engineer or Research Scientist
descriptionHtml:
About Grubel

Grubel is a research lab that builds AI for high-stakes knowledge work, starting with law. Legal matters require specialized expertise, and each one involves its own facts, practices, parties, and institutions. General-purpose AI applies the same system to every legal matter, varying only what goes into a limited context window.

To meet the depth and diversity of legal work, we let every matter build its own AI: engineer the right data for the matter, adapt the model and agent to it, and track what improves. We combine the three into a matter-specific improvement loop that runs until the system delivers what the matter demands.

Grubel was founded in 2026 by Moritz Hardt, director at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and formerly a UC Berkeley professor and Google Brain researcher; and Reinhard Heckel, professor of machine learning at the Technical University of Munich, on leave to build Grubel. The founding team includes engineers with PhDs in computer science and experience in foundation-model pretraining at Mistral and legal AI research at Thomson Reuters. The lab has offices in Munich and Tübingen.

Point Nine led an oversubscribed pre-seed funding round with backing from leading AI researchers and founders, including Jeff Dean, Chris Ré, Ion Stoica, and Harvey co-founders Gabe Pereyra and Winston Weinberg.


About the role

We are looking for a Founding Research Engineer or Research Scientist to develop the methods and systems that make matter-specific AI possible. You will work on data curation, agent environment design, model adaptation, training, and evaluation. We do not draw a sharp boundary between research and engineering: everyone contributes substantial code, owns experiments end-to-end, builds systems, and helps turn successful methods into products. Research is empirical and engineering intensive.

You will work directly with Grubel’s founders, engineers, legal experts, and enterprise partners. As an early member of the team, you will also help shape Grubel’s technical direction and research culture.

What you’ll work on

  • Developing, testing, and evaluating methods for adapting models and agents to individual legal matters

  • Designing benchmarks and evaluation tasks for complex legal capabilities

  • Developing data curation strategies for scaling from evaluation tasks to training tasks

  • Building infrastructure for training, inference, experimentation, and evaluation

  • Working with legal experts and enterprise partners to turn legal workflows into agentic workflows

  • Turning successful research methods into reliable product capabilities

You may be a good fit if

  • You hold a master’s degree or PhD in machine learning, computer science, mathematics, or a related field, or have equivalent research or industry experience

  • You have either a strong machine-learning research record or significant experience building large-scale machine-learning systems

  • You have trained and evaluated language models or built agentic systems

  • You are proactive, self-directed, and comfortable owning technically ambiguous problems

  • You are curious about how legal work actually gets done and enjoy working with domain experts

Particularly relevant experience

Any of the following would be valuable, but we do not expect candidates to have all of them:

  • LLM post-training, fine-tuning, or reinforcement learning experience

  • Data curation, synthetic data, or human-in-the-loop data generation pipelines

  • Evaluation harnesses and benchmark development

  • Distributed training, inference, or experiment infrastructure

  • Publications, open-source contributions, or deployed research systems

  • Legal AI or another expert-intensive application domain

Logistics

title: Front End Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Seamflow

Every plane, medical device, lift, battery and building has to be tested, inspected and certified before it reaches the world. It's the invisible layer that keeps the physical economy safe, and it still runs on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Seamflow is the software layer for that industry. We build AI-powered workflows for certification bodies, notified bodies and inspection companies: scheduling and resource planning, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence over messy real-world files.

Where we are:

  • Live in production inside some of the largest enterprises in the industry

  • $4.5M seed, 14x oversubscribed, co-led by Northzone and Initialized Capital, the funds behind Spotify, Klarna, Coinbase and Reddit. Angels include Charlie Songhurst and Mario Götze.

  • Demand is outstripping what we can build. That's the reason this role exists.

The team

Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. The team has come to us from Google, Amazon, X, Yandex, McKinsey and Bain, and from founding-engineer seats at startups that went on to multi-billion-dollar valuations. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further.

The role

A Front End Design Engineer thinks in finished interfaces, not mockups or components in isolation. A technical reviewer at a notified body spends their day inside a 400-page technical file, cross-referencing clauses, checking test reports against standards, and deciding whether a medical device is safe to sell. Today they do that in Word, Acrobat and a spreadsheet someone built in 2011. The interface they use decides how fast they work and whether they trust the AI sitting next to them.

You own that interface. Layout, typography, interaction, motion, the design system underneath it, and the React that ships it. You decide how a reviewer sees a finding, how they correct a model that got it wrong, and how a hundred fields of dense regulatory data become something a person can actually read. You sketch it, build it, ship it, then sit next to someone using it and find out what you got wrong. You'll ship to production in your first week.

What we're looking for

We care far more about taste and engineering strength than about matching a list of tools. If you're excellent, we'll hire you whether you've spent the last three years in React, Svelte, Vue or something we haven't heard of. Our stack is learnable in a fortnight. Judgement, craft and speed are not.

What we're actually screening for:

  • You've designed and built an interface that real people used every day. Not a Dribbble shot, not a component library nobody adopted. Something that shipped, got used, and got better.

  • You have taste, and you can defend it. Typography, spacing, motion, hierarchy. You notice when something is a few pixels off and you can explain why it matters.

  • You build the whole thing. Design, frontend, the state and data it sits on. You don't hand the code to someone else once the Figma is done, and you don't hand the design to someone else once the code is.

  • You can design for density. Expert users, complex workflows, hundreds of fields on a screen. Making that clear is much harder than making a landing page beautiful.

  • You go to the source. You'll watch a technical reviewer work through a real file, and you'll design for what they actually do rather than what the process diagram says.

Signals we like, none of them required:

design engineering or front-end roles at somewhere like Linear, Vercel, Notion or Figma, a design system you built and maintained, work on interfaces where people review or correct AI output, founder or ex-founder, founding team experience, EF / YC / Antler, early or stealth-stage startup.

This is probably not for you if

  • You want a strict boundary between work and life. We run one of the most ambitious startup cultures in Europe: fast paced, extremely high ownership, and in person in Shoreditch.

  • You want a well-defined ticket handed to you each morning.

  • You want to specialise narrowly and stay in your lane.

What you get

  • Real equity, and compensation that reflects a high bar

  • Genuine ownership of product surface area from day one, with the founders in the room

  • Relocation support and visa sponsorship, handled properly

  • Lunch and dinner covered, 24/7 gym access, and any tool that makes you faster

  • A small team with high standards, high trust, and no politics

If this sounds like your kind of problem, apply. A short note on the hardest thing you've built goes further with us than a polished CV.

title: Generalist Architect
descriptionHtml:
TLDR; Davis is looking for an architect who has sized capacity across several programs, from light-industrial and logistics to residential, office and retail, and who wants to practice differently than in a traditional firm. Target experience: around 5 to 6 years.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneurs First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The Role

Our clients come to us with a site and a capacity question, on a program that changes from one deal to the next. You are the one who answers whatever the program, and who stands behind the number in front of them.

You will run a portfolio of feasibility studies across light-industrial and logistics, residential, office, hospitality, retail and mixed-use operations. You take these projects from feasibility through schematic design.

This role sits at the meeting point of two worlds Davis is precisely working to bring together: architectural expertise and artificial intelligence. This is not a conventional architect position. It spans three complementary dimensions: guaranteeing the architectural quality and credibility of our deliverables, today generated in a matter of hours; co-producing the architectural drawings that accompany them; contributing actively to the development of our plan-generation technology.

It is an architect role whose impact reaches well beyond its own output.

The core of the role

  • Analyze local planning and zoning documents (land-use plans, development guidelines, easements) and derive project assumptions from them.

  • Set the programmatic assumptions for the program at hand, its ratios, structural grids and keys, and derive a quantified capacity.

  • Check and correct the outputs of our tools: confirm what holds up, fix what does not, and explain why.

  • Develop the project phase by phase, from a first capacity scenario through to a resolved project at schematic design.

  • Produce the graphic documents (drawings, images, diagrams) that make the project clear and compelling.

  • Arbitrate between several scenarios according to programmatic, regulatory and economic constraints.

  • Stand behind your numbers with the client, and defend them under challenge.

Contributing to the technology

  • Formalize best practice, program by program: translate ratios, structural grids and thresholds into criteria our AI teams can use.

  • Assess the model's outputs: say what is right, what is wrong, and on what grounds.

  • Work cross-functionally with the product, tech and real estate teams throughout the tool's continuous-improvement cycles.

Working as a team

  • Take part in project reviews and exchange with the other architects to improve methods and the quality of deliverables.

  • Contribute to the team's graphic standards.

What We're Looking For

  • Education: degree in architecture.

  • Experience: around 5 to 6 years. You have sized capacity yourself on at least three different programs (multi-family residential, logistics, light-industrial parks, office, hospitality or retail). Logistics or light-industrial is one of the three, as these are the programs that matter most to us. You know the ratios that govern each: clear height and loading docks in logistics and light-industrial, average area per unit and parking ratio in residential, structural grid and workstation ratio in office, area per key in hospitality.

  • Software: proficiency in Rhino and Revit is essential. AutoCAD is expected.

  • Appetite for digital tools and AI: the desire to bring them into your practice and to evolve it is essential. AI is one more tool in your hand, and drawing remains what we assess.

  • Speed and synthesis: our clients decide fast, on a number. You produce a credible, well-drawn scenario in hours, you cut to the essentials on ambiguous cases, and you know what level of detail serves the decision at each phase.

Core skills

  • Buildable capacity: connect a zoning rule to its quantified effect on a volume, and a volume to a program.

  • Programmatic versatility: move from residential to office, to logistics warehouse, to light-industrial or hospitality, and grasp the logic of each quickly.

  • Planning documents and how they apply: building envelope, height, setbacks, spacing rules, footprint, planted open ground, parking, permitted uses.

  • Site plan: siting, access, parking, water management, integration and edges.

  • Project phases, from feasibility through schematic design, and the level of detail each one requires.

  • Production of graphic documents: plans, sections and diagrams that make a capacity rationale legible to an investor.

Complementary skills

  • Rigor and a sense of synthesis, especially on ambiguous cases.

  • Information structuring: organizing what you produce so that others, human or machine, can use it.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally with the product, tech and real estate teams.

Why join Davis?

  • Take part in a genuine transformation of the real estate profession, and co-build the next generation of feasibility standards alongside a high-caliber technical team.

  • Go through a volume and a diversity of programs a traditional firm cannot offer.

  • See your work in every deliverable, and correct the tool when it gets things wrong.

  • Join a young company where methods and tools are still being built, and where your expertise shapes the way we work.

Package

  • Fixed-term or permanent contract depending on the case, to be discussed together

  • Offices in the center of Paris 2e

  • Company health insurance covered

  • Meal vouchers

  • Sports membership covered

  • 50% reimbursement of public transport

More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after:

Team

Mehdi (CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.

We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.

Why We'll Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

title: Grid Systems Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based AC/DC and DC/DC power blocks. The grid interconnection is where our system meets the utility – getting it right is fundamental to a safe, compliant and reliable product across every market we serve.

As Grid Systems Engineer, you will design and develop the medium-voltage grid interconnection aspects of our power conversion system – from prototype construction and checkout through certification and volume production. You will work closely with the Power Electronics, Firmware and Test & Field teams, and with our external test & certification partners, to ensure our systems meet grid codes and interconnection requirements across our target markets.

It is a unique opportunity to shape the grid interface of a breakthrough power electronics platform from an early stage – with direct visibility to the CTO and engineering leadership.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and develop the medium-voltage (13.8kV–35kV) grid interconnection system and related electromechanical/electronic equipment; prepare related installation, operation and maintenance specifications and instructions.

• Analyze equipment to establish operating data and conduct experimental tests on grid-interface hardware (transformers, protection, switchgear interfaces) under realistic grid conditions.

• Analyze engineering proposals and technical data to determine the feasibility of new equipment or modifications to existing designs for different grid voltage levels and markets.

• Responsible for prototype construction and checkout of grid-interconnection subsystems, supporting our Prototype and Alpha Customer milestones.

• Compile operational data and prepare customer application information and documentation for grid-tied deployments.

• Ensure compliance with grid codes, interconnection standards and utility requirements (e.g., IEEE 519, IEEE 1547, IEC 61850, UL 1741) and support certification processes together with our test & certification partners (UL, TÜV, IEC 62477).

• Collaborate with the Power Electronics and Firmware teams on protection coordination, fault ride-through, and control strategies for grid-tied operation.

• Respond to customer and partner technical requests regarding grid interconnection requirements as they occur.

• Support scaling of the grid-interface design across different grid codes and markets as we move from Alpha Customer readiness to Production and Volume Readiness.

Qualifications

• BSc / MSc in electrical engineering, power systems engineering or comparable education.

• Experience in medium-voltage grid interconnection, power systems, or utility-scale grid-tied power electronics (e.g. solar/wind/BESS inverters, solid-state transformers) preferred.

• Familiarity with grid codes and interconnection standards (e.g. IEEE 519, IEEE 1547, IEC 61850, IEC 61400, IEC 62933, VDE-AR-N, UL 1741).

• Hands-on experience with prototype build, checkout and test of electromechanical/electronic equipment.

• Strong analytical skills; comfortable designing and running experimental tests, analyzing the resulting data, and documenting the results.

• Team player, comfortable engaging directly with customers and partners on technical requirements.

• Language skills: fluent in English, spoken and written; German language skills helpful, but not mandatory.

• The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich in Switzerland. National and international willingness to travel is assumed.

Benefits

• Equity + competitive salary.

• Unique technology and market opportunity – validated prototype and first paying customers on the path to volume shipments.

• Hybrid work with flexible working times.

title: Hardware Engineer, FPGA
descriptionHtml:
Normal Computing | Build with Us

Normal is an applied AI company solving the hardest problems in AI and silicon. We build foundational hardware and software for the semiconductor industry, critical AI infrastructure, and the broader systems that power our world, in partnership with the world's most advanced institutions. We work as one team across New York City, Silicon Valley (Mountain View), and London.

The Role

Validating conventional silicon is a solved discipline. Validating silicon that computes with noise is not, and you will be the one who figures out how. As our FPGA Design Engineer, you will own the bridge between RTL and physical silicon: bringing our physics-inspired ASIC designs to life on FPGA platforms for pre-silicon validation and early software development, and building the test infrastructure for post-silicon bring-up and characterization. Your scope spans the entire FPGA lifecycle: selecting hardware platforms, implementing complex RTL, debugging in the lab, and writing the software that drives it all, working daily with our silicon, EDA, and research teams.

What You Will Own

  • FPGA Platform Ownership: Lead the selection, procurement, and bring-up of FPGA prototyping platforms (e.g., HAPS, VCU118/VPK180-class boards, or custom hardware) for pre-silicon RTL validation and software development.

  • RTL Implementation: Adapt and implement complex ASIC RTL onto FPGA targets, including multi-clock-domain architectures, CDC bridges, and timing closure on dense designs.

  • IP Integration: Integrate in-house designs with third-party and vendor IP; serve as the expert on the AMD/Xilinx ecosystem (Vivado IP Integrator, transceivers, memory controllers).

  • High-Speed Interfaces: Design, implement, and validate high-speed I/O with a focus on PCIe: our accelerators ship as PCIe cards in standard servers.

  • Post-Silicon Validation: Build FPGA-based "tester" designs for silicon bring-up, device characterization, and automated test environments.

  • Hardware-Software Stack: Develop the software layer around the hardware: Python/C++ hardware abstraction, register-map generation, and automated build and regression flows.

  • Lab Debug: Root-cause complex timing and functional issues in real time using ILA/Vivado Analyzer, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and BER/eye-diagram characterization of high-speed links.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Proven industry experience taking FPGA designs from RTL through timing closure to validated hardware, ideally in an ASIC prototyping, emulation, or high-growth hardware environment.

  • Expert-level SystemVerilog and/or VHDL for synthesis, with deep proficiency in Xilinx Vivado (synthesis, place & route, timing closure, IP catalog).

  • Hands-on experience implementing and debugging PCIe, plus AXI/AHB, SPI, UART, JTAG, and other common interfaces.

  • Strong Python for automation, test, and build tooling.

  • Strong board-level bring-up and lab debugging skills on real hardware.

  • Startup mindset: you work independently, pivot quickly, and run at ambiguous problems that span hardware, software, and physics.

Bonus Points

  • Verification frameworks like Cocotb or UVM

  • Experience deploying ML models to FPGAs (hls4ml, FINN, or custom NN-to-RTL flows), or building real-time, sub-microsecond signal processing pipelines.

  • Mixed-signal ASIC exposure: digital front-ends, ADC/DAC interfaces, or analog compute.

  • SERDES tuning and signal integrity fundamentals.

  • CI/CD for hardware (GitLab CI, Docker-based build and test).

title: hbo-stage Bedrijfskunde: Digitalisering en Procesoptimalisatie van communicatie
descriptionHtml:
hbo-afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027

Ben jij die enthousiaste hbo-student die het leuk vindt om organisatievraagstukken te onderzoeken en processen te verbeteren?

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (CBS) wil het gebruik van papieren post verminderen en de mogelijkheden voor digitale communicatie verder uitbreiden. Dit geldt zowel voor de communicatie met bedrijven als met personen. Tijdens deze stage richt je je specifiek op de communicatie met individuele onderzoekspersonen.

Op dit moment benadert het CBS onderzoekspersonen in eerste instantie vrijwel altijd via een brief op het huisadres. Digitale communicatie, bijvoorbeeld via e-mail, biedt kansen om dit proces efficiënter, flexibeler en toekomstbestendiger in te richten. Er lopen binnen het CBS al verschillende initiatieven om meer gebruik te maken van e-mailadressen, maar er zijn ook nog belangrijke vraagstukken die onderzocht moeten worden.

Denk bijvoorbeeld aan de volgende vragen:

  • Hoe kan het CBS op een effectieve manier e-mailadressen van onderzoekspersonen verzamelen en beheren?

  • Welke juridische en privacyvoorwaarden gelden voor het opbouwen en gebruiken van een e-maildatabase?

  • Welke technische aanpassingen en voorzieningen zijn nodig om digitale communicatie mogelijk te maken?

  • Hoe moeten de bestaande werkprocessen worden aangepast om digitale communicatie goed te ondersteunen?

  • Hoe kunnen we ervoor zorgen dat onderzoekspersonen op een toegankelijke en betrouwbare manier digitaal benaderd worden?

Samen met het Waarneeminnovatie Team en collega's van de afdeling Dataverzameling ga je dit vraagstuk onderzoeken. Je brengt de huidige situatie in kaart, onderzoekt mogelijkheden voor verbetering en werkt toe naar concrete aanbevelingen voor het CBS.

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Heerlen

Je gaat aan de slag in het Team Waarneeminnovatie. Dit team valt binnen de afdeling Dataverzameling. We zijn een jong, divers en vooral enthousiast team dat als doel heeft de waarneming van het CBS te vernieuwen en te verbeteren.

Dit breng jij mee

Je volgt een hbo-opleiding Bedrijfskunde of een soortgelijke opleiding.

  • Je hebt interesse in procesoptimalisatie, digitalisering en organisatieverandering.

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig, onderzoekend en neemt graag initiatief.

  • Je vindt het leuk om met verschillende betrokkenen binnen een organisatie in gesprek te gaan.

  • Je hebt een proactieve, positieve en assertieve houding en denkt in oplossingen, staat open voor feedback en gaat uitdagingen met enthousiasme aan.

Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • samen met ervaren vakmensen bestaande processen analyseert en verbeterkansen herkent;

  • zelfstandig een praktijkgericht onderzoek of experiment opzet;

  • aan de slag gaat met het in kaart brengen van verschillende organisatorische, juridische en technische belangen en randvoorwaarden rondom digitale communicatie;

  • leert om onderzoeksresultaten te vertalen naar concrete, onderbouwde en uitvoerbare aanbevelingen voor het CBS.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken.

Dit zijn onze voorwaarden

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.
Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking.

title: Head of Compliance
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Head of Compliance and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

title: Head of EMEA Sales
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. You’ll be our first person on the ground in London, and your job is to localize that business and turn it into a region.

This is a founding-leader role, not inheriting a machine. You’ll be in deals directly while making your first hires, with a mandate to scale the EMEA team to 20+ people this year across front-line leaders and sellers.

The right person for this role is a player-coach who has managed managers, sold to technical buyers, and hired quickly — and who wants to run a region before a bigger company would hand them one. If you’re energized by ambiguity, an unformed market, and building with what’s in front of you, this is one of the most consequential GTM roles at Baseten.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner closely with a US-based org across Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Solutions, and Recruiting, with significant US timezone overlap.

REQUIREMENTS

  • A proven hiring track record. You’ve built teams quickly and hired leaders, not just ICs, and you can point to the people you’ve developed.

  • Scrappiness. You’re comfortable being the only Baseten person in the region on day one — building pipeline, closing deals, and recruiting at the same time, without the bells and whistles.

  • EMEA fluency. You know the regional markets and how enterprise buying differs from the US.

  • Comfort in a fast-moving, high-intensity environment. Here, that means you Slack faster than you talk.

  • A builder’s mentality. You own problems and their solutions, and you’re at your best in high-change, unstructured environments.

 

BENEFITS

title: Head of Product (Flex)
descriptionHtml:
Head of Product 

  • Location: London (Hybrid Office - 3+ days per week)

  • Salary: £112,000 - £140,000

  • Team: Product (Flex)

  • Level: HoD

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

As Head of Product for Flex, you own the vision, strategy and commercial success of our residential VPP platform globally. You lead a product organisation of Product Managers embedded across our device integration, optimisation, monetisation and SaaS platform teams, and you sit on the Flex Leadership team alongside our Head of Engineering, jointly accountable for the performance of the whole Flex business. Specifically, you will:

  • Set and own the global product strategy for Flex, translating Kaluza's company-level strategy into a roadmap spanning device integrations, multi-asset optimisation (EV, battery, solar, HEMS), monetisation and market access, and self-serve SaaS capabilities.

  • Build and lead a high-performing product organisation - hiring, developing and retaining Product Managers of all levels, and identifying and growing the next generation of product leaders within Flex.

  • Make the trade-off calls that matter: balance the needs of our two core client segments - energy retailers and device OEMs - defaulting to retailer priorities where they conflict, in line with Flex's strategy, while protecting the long-term health of the platform.

  • Partner closely with the Head of Engineering and our Commercial and Partnerships teams to align product, technical and commercial strategy, and to make resourcing and investment decisions across Flex's product and engineering teams.

  • Define annual goals and OKRs for Flex, aligned to Kaluza's company strategy, and hold your organisation accountable for delivering measurable commercial and platform-quality outcomes.

  • Be the client-facing expert for Flex product: lead demos and pitches for prospective retailer and OEM clients, contribute to proposals and pricing, and represent Flex's product practice at Kaluza-wide and industry forums.

  • Own the long-term roadmap narrative - kept current, accessible, and able to be told confidently to prospects and clients two years out - as well as internally to engineering, design, partnerships and commercial teams.

  • Build and maintain your network with Product, Partnership, Engineering and Commercial leaders across Kaluza, ensuring insight from Flex feeds into - and benefits from - the wider Kaluza product strategy.

  • Champion product craft and ways of working across Flex, raising the bar for discovery, prioritisation and measurable impact, in a fast-moving, resource-constrained environment where judgement on trade-offs matters as much as vision.

What you’ll bring 

Ideally you’ll have/be

  • Be a proven, experienced product leader with a track record of building, leading and developing product teams and people managers, not just individual contributors.

  • Be a seasoned expert in product strategy and execution across the full product lifecycle, with a track record of translating ambiguous, complex problems into a clear strategy and roadmap.

  • Have strong commercial instincts - comfortable owning pricing input, business cases and ROI, and able to demonstrate commercial impact and business growth through your teams.

  • Be an excellent communicator, able to present complex, ambiguous problems clearly and persuasively to technical and non-technical audiences, from engineers to clients to Kaluza's leadership team.

  • Have deep experience with, or a genuine ability to quickly get up to speed in, complex multi-sided B2B / B2B2C technology platforms - direct experience in energy, DER orchestration, IoT device platforms or smart devices is a strong plus.

  • Be comfortable operating with high ambiguity, making the call yourself where appropriate and knowing when to escalate, in a fast-paced and frequently changing environment.

  • Have a track record of fostering a strong product culture and coaching others - including peers without being their formal manager - to raise the standard of product work around them.

  • Be data-driven in how you measure impact, and able to hold yourself and your teams accountable to outcomes, not just outputs.

What will set you apart 

  • Experience in energy trading, national and regional flexibility markets, or other VPP monetisation opportunity spaces (e.g. balancing markets, capacity markets, wholesale/imbalance trading, ancillary services).

  • Direct experience with VPPs, EV/battery smart charging, HEMS, or residential demand-flexibility products.

  • Familiarity with UK and/or international energy market mechanics (e.g. BSC, NEM, market settlement, DER integration standards).

  • Experience selling or supporting the sale of platform/SaaS propositions to enterprise clients.

Where you'll work
We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

title: Head of Professional Services, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

title: HR consultant
descriptionHtml:
Heb jij HR-ervaring en wil je graag jouw kennis en expertise inzetten, maar óók jezelf verder ontwikkelen? Zoek je afwisseling en uitdaging in jouw werkzaamheden?

De consultants van Buro Payroll ondersteunen klanten uit diverse branches tijdelijk op het gebied van HR en/of salarisadministratie. Als HR-consultant van Buro Payroll ga je aan de slag bij onze klanten en ondersteun je de HR-afdeling tijdelijk bij uiteenlopende opdrachten. Van het verwerken van mutaties, opstellen van contracten en het meedenken aan procesoptimalisaties in AFAS tot aan het adviseren over HR-specifieke vraagstukken en deelnemen aan HR-projecten.

Taken

In deze rol ben jij hét HR-gezicht voor één of meerdere klanten. Je voert niet alleen de dagelijkse HR-werkzaamheden uit, maar kijkt ook kritisch naar bestaande processen. Waar kan het slimmer, efficiënter of consistenter? Jij ziet verbeteringen, signaleert deze en vertaalt dit naar concreet HR-advies waar de opdrachtgever direct mee verder kan.

Onze klanten zijn divers: van gevestigde namen tot kleinere organisaties met grote ambities. Dat betekent dat geen opdracht hetzelfde is: elke werkomgeving, iedere casus en elk HR-vraagstuk biedt jou weer nieuwe inzichten. Zo blijft je werk dynamisch én ontwikkel je jezelf razendsnel.

Veel van onze klanten werken met AFAS. Heb je daar nog geen ervaring mee? Geen probleem! Wij zorgen dat jij precies de kennis krijgt die nodig is om vol vertrouwen aan de slag te gaan. Vanuit ons label Peopletrack zijn wij namelijk AFAS-partner, waardoor wij beschikken over voldoende opleidingsmateriaal om deze software eigen te maken!

En verder…

  • Onze accountmanagers zoeken opdrachten die aansluiten bij jouw kwaliteiten, interesses én groeipad.

  • Bij elke klant werk je samen met het lokale HR-team, zodat je nooit alleen staat in je opdracht.

  • Daarnaast heb je een hechte groep HR-collega’s bij Buro Payroll achter je staan: sparren, vragen stellen, samen oplossen; we helpen elkaar vooruit.

  • Minimaal één keer per maand komen we samen op kantoor voor gezelligheid, een gezamenlijke lunch en kennisdeling. Zo blijf je verbonden, geïnspireerd en onderdeel van het team.

Kortom: een rol waarin je je expertise kunt inzetten, je vaardigheden blijft ontwikkelen en tegelijkertijd impact maakt bij allerlei verschillende organisaties. Klaar om jouw HR-stempel achter te laten?

Vereisten

Wat neem je mee?

  • Minimaal 2-7 jaar relevante werkervaring op een HR-afdeling (afhankelijk van junior, medior of senior consultant rol)

  • MBO+ of HBO diploma bij voorkeur HRM

  • Pro-activiteit en aanpassingsvermogen

  • Je kunt structuur aanbrengen in je werk en prioriteiten stellen

  • Je bent communicatief sterk; je kan goed luisteren en doorvragen

  • Je vindt het niet erg om in het diepe gegooid te worden, aangezien je goed zelfstandig kan zwemmen.

  • Kennis van AFAS is een grote pré!

Benefits

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Salaris tussen de €2500,- en €4600,- afhankelijk van jouw ervaring én inzetbaarheid

  • Aantrekkelijke bonusregeling én premievrij pensioen

  • 28 vakantiedagen op basis van een 40-urige werkweek

  • Leuke, enthousiaste en hulpvaardige collega’s

  • Veelzijdige functie waarbij je diverse HR opdrachten uitvoert bij verschillende opdrachtgevers

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling

  • Hybride werken (in overleg met de klant)

  • Laptop, telefoonvergoeding en een leaseauto mét EU-tankpas of EU-laadtag (die je ook privé kunt gebruiken)

  • Ieder kwartaal een bedrijfsuitje en gezellige borrels met de collega's van Buro Payroll, Peopletrack en checkX

Wat jij leuk vindt?

  • Samenwerking met collega’s in diverse teams (intern en extern)

  • Afwisseling en dynamiek in jouw werkzaamheden

  • De HR-administratie gestructureerd en nauwkeurig aanpakken

  • Processen optimaliseren, (HR)advies geven en zelfstandig kansen pakken bij opdrachten

  • Blijvend leren van elkaar, maar ook in de vorm van trainingen

  • Gericht jouw deskundigheid inzetten en de klant adviseren

  • Jouw HR-kennis verbreden

Wil jij jouw kennis en expertise inzetten en verder ontwikkelen? Zoek je afwisseling en uitdaging in jouw werkzaamheden? Wil je werken bij een informele en ambitieuze organisatie? Kun je al deze vragen met ‘ja’ beantwoorden?  Dan is dit de functie voor jou!

title: HR Medewerker Senior (m/v/x)
descriptionHtml:
Een ervaren HR-professional die graag complexe HR-vraagstukken oppakt, kennis deelt, overzicht houdt en bijdraagt aan een goede HR-dienstverlening.

Voor onze volop in beweging zijnde HR administratie/HR-support team zoeken we een ervaren HR-professional die goed thuis is in HR operatie en graag meedenkt over uiteenlopende HR-vraagstukken. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor collega’s en steekt zelf graag de handen uit de mouwen. Met een proactieve blik kijk je verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk en zie je kansen om processen te verbeteren. Herken jij jezelf hierin en bouw je graag mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze afdeling? Solliciteer dan snel!

Wat ga je doen?

Jij zorgt er samen met je hr-collega’s voor dat de basis van onze HR-administratie op orde is, maar jouw meerwaarde zit vooral in het behandelen van complexere operationele HR-vraagstukken, het ondersteunen van HR collega’s en het samen met de teamleider verder ontwikkelen van onze dienstverlening. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor het HR-team en een vertrouwd aanspreekpunt voor NLR medewerkers en HR-adviseurs.

Als senior HR medewerker heb je een veelzijdige rol waarin HR-administratie, dienstverlening, inhoudelijke expertise en procesverbetering samenkomen. Jouw HR collega’s houden zich bezig met de dagelijkse HR-processen, waarbij jij je richt op vooral vraagstukken die meer ervaring, inzicht en zelfstandigheid vragen. Daarnaast deel je actief je kennis met collega's, denk je mee over een slimme verdeling van het werk en draag je bij aan de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening.

Jouw werkzaamheden in het kort:

  • Vraagbaak voor het HR-team: je behandelt tweedelijns HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden, personeelsregelingen en HR processen, detachering, inleen en deelt je kennis en ondersteunt collega’s.

  • Samenwerken met de teamleider HR: je werkt aan HR-projecten, verbetert processen en bewaakt de voortgang, met name bij piekmomenten.

  • Ondersteunen van de HR Adviseurs en managers: je helpt bij operationele HR-vraagstukken en zorgt voor een goede aansluiting tussen HR-processen en de praktijk.

  • Zorgen voor goede HR-dienstverlening: je bewaakt de kwaliteit van de HR-administratie en hebt contact met medewerkers. Je draagt bij aan een juiste en tijdige verwerking van personeelsgegevens en ondersteunt waar nodig bij eerstelijnsvragen.

  • Bouwen aan de HR-afdeling: je signaleert knelpunten, denkt mee over praktische/operationele verbeteringen, helpt werkprocessen te uniformeren en deelt je kennis met collega's.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken iemand die senioriteit laat zien in zowel gedrag als HR-kennis. Je hoeft niet alles te weten, maar je hebt een stevige basis, durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en weet wanneer je zelfstandig kunt handelen en wanneer afstemming nodig is. First time right is het devies, kwalitatieve en zorgvuldige HR administratie en dienstverlening vinden wij belangrijk.

Verder breng je mee:

  • Afgeronde opleiding in HRM of een vergelijkbare richting met minimaal vijf jaar relevante ervaring binnen HR, bij voorkeur in een brede HR-administratieve functie en kennis van AFAS.

  • Je hebt gedegen kennis van HR administratie en support en ervaring met het zelfstandig behandelen van HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden en personeelsregelingen.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk, toegankelijk en klantgericht. Je maakt gemakkelijk contact met medewerkers en collega’s op verschillende niveaus.

  • Je werkt graag samen, durft je eigen perspectief in te brengen en staat open voor feedback en andere inzichten.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, hebt oog voor details en houdt overzicht en helpt collega’s om werkzaamheden goed en tijdig af te ronden.

  • Je bent gewend en krijgt er energie van om in een snel groeiende en veranderende organisatie te werken.

  • Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk op C1 niveau.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij NLR krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken én jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je werkt in een innovatieve nationale en internationale hightechomgeving waar nieuwsgierigheid, samenwerking en vakmanschap centraal staan. We geloven dat mensen het beste presteren als ze de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, zich te blijven ontwikkelen en een gezonde balans te vinden tussen werk en privé.

Verder bieden we je onder andere:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4400,- en € 5000 (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek), afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring;

  • 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek);

  • 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer.

  • Een zorgtoelage van €145,- bruto (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • Volop kansen om te blijven leren met opleidingen, trainingen, coaching en andere ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • De mogelijkheid om 32-40 uur per week te werken inclusief thuiswerken.

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

Je wordt onderdeel van een breed HR-team met verschillende expertises, van HR-advies en beleid tot recruitment en Learning & Development. We sparren graag met elkaar, houden elkaar scherp en inspireren elkaar om verder te komen. Er is volop ruimte voor jouw ideeën, kennis en initiatief, met oog voor elkaar en het gezamenlijke resultaat. Samen werken we aan HR-dienstverlening die aansluit bij de behoeften van de organisatie en bijdraagt aan onze strategische ambities.

Onze HR-afdeling is volop in ontwikkeling en werkt aan verdere professionalisering en verbetering van processen en samenwerking. Dat biedt kansen, maar vraagt ook iets van jou. Je komt terecht in een HR-afdeling waar we volop werken aan het verbeteren van onze dienstverlening. We brengen meer structuur aan, maken onze processen eenvoudiger en werken steeds nauwer samen. Dat betekent dat niet alles al vastligt en dat er ruimte is om mee te denken en dingen slimmer te organiseren. Je standplaats is Amsterdam of Marknesse, maar je bent ook regelmatig op onze andere locatie voor overleg en samenwerking met collega’s.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al meer dan 100 jaar een toonaangevende kennisinstelling voor toegepast onderzoek in de lucht- en ruimtevaart. Samen met meer dan 1000 professionals werken we aan innovatieve oplossingen voor een duurzamere, veiligere en efficiëntere lucht- en ruimtevaart. We willen dat iedereen bij NLR de ruimte krijgt om zichzelf te zijn, talenten te ontwikkelen en ideeën in te brengen. Door verschillen te waarderen en van elkaar te leren, creëren we samen een inclusieve werkomgeving.

Wil jij meer weten?

Mail dan met Christel Bouwers (Recruiter) via Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal.

Solliciteren?

Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button.

Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD.

Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld!

title: HR Operations Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Your next mission

Power our growing crew from day one. Keep our people operations running sharp – so every colleague feels supported, valued, and ready to aim high.

As our HR Operations Specialist, you keep the operational heartbeat of Robin Radar steady and reliable. You guide colleagues and managers through everyday questions while managing key processes from onboarding to payroll and pensions. Working alongside the Head of HR, you turn complex regulations into clear, smooth procedures that support our international team. You play a vital part in making our workplace an environment where bright minds thrive[cite: 1, 3].

What you'll do

  • People operations and lifecycle management: Oversee essential lifecycle processes including contract management, visa and 30% ruling applications, leaves, and absenteeism. Ensure policies are followed while advising on necessary updates.

  • HR systems and digital tools: Maintain and control our core systems, including HiBob, Odoo, and Officevibe. Act as the primary go-to specialist for system knowledge and drive continuous platform improvements.

  • Onboarding and colleague support: Organise and host our monthly onboarding days to welcome new joiners. Deliver clear guidance to colleagues and managers on day-to-day queries with a customer-focused approach.

  • External partnerships and compliance: Act as the direct point of contact for external payroll, pension, occupational health, and legal partners. Track changes in labour law to keep our personnel policies and handbook up to date.

  • HR analytics and projects: Develop meaningful HR reports and analytics to inform people decisions. Lead and support projects, from implementing new systems to rolling out fresh policies.

What you bring

  • BA/MSc or HBO in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field

  • Over 5 years of experience, ideally in international/multicultural settings

  • Knowledge of Dutch employment law with a focus on migrant employment requirements

  • Familiarity with HR systems like HiBob is a plus

  • Fluent in both English and Dutch

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

  • Team player with the ability to work independently

  • Assertive and hands-on approach

  • Proactive mindset with a focus on driving improvements

  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate across diverse cultures and backgrounds

What we offer

  • Working for a Great Place to Work® certified company;

  • Comprehensive pension plan;

  • Commuting allowance;

  • 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days);

  • Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications;

  • High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role

  • An international team of 30+ nationalities, full of high performance colleagues you can exchange experiences with and learn from. As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks!

Robin Radar is a defence technology leader in detecting, tracking and classifying drones and other small airborne objects. Our radars and software protect military sites, borders and critical infrastructure from drone threats, and also help prevent bird strikes in aviation and reduce the impact of wind farms on wildlife. Our work shows up at defence and security sites, airports and wind farms around the world.

We're one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands, with a crew of bright minds across 30+ nationalities. Growth doesn't mean we lose the plot – eyes on the skies, feet on the ground. Our values keep us grounded: WE TRUST. WE OWN IT. WE AIM HIGH.

Want to work on next-level radar tech, solve real problems, and never have to pretend your job has meaning? You'll fit right in – we're saving you a seat.

title: Implementation Manager - Bilingual
descriptionHtml:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Benchling is building a world-class Professional Services team to drive implementations for our rapidly expanding customer base. Implementation Managers work with our customers, from small Biotech startups to the largest BioPharmas in the world to develop a deep understanding of their R&D Processes, and roll out solutions that transform how their research teams work together.

To be successful in this role, you will leverage your scientific background, project management skills, and product expertise to drive successful implementations of the Benchling platform. You will work hand in hand with the research scientists at our customers, and teams throughout Benchling to implement our solutions, and ensure our customers are successful. Implementation Managers lead all aspects of customer rollouts from requirements analysis and solution design, to configurations, testing, training, and onboarding users onto the system. Fluent or native French or German, plus experience supporting French- or German-speaking customers.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage initial rollouts for new Benchling customers as well as expansion projects with new teams or for new processes at existing customers

  • Own implementation success from project kickoff to go-live, leveraging strong project management skills, scientific expertise, and deep product knowledge.

  • Build and execute detailed project plans, own project activities, work with other team members to execute on project deliverables to ensure on time, on budget, high quality deployments.

  • Understand customers' scientific workflows and determine how Benchling can best be leveraged to meet their key business needs.

  • Lead requirements and design workshops, perform data modeling & application configuration, develop test plans and guide UAT execution, train and onboard users.

  • Act as a trusted advisor for customers, guiding them through the implementation ensuring they leverage and apply Benchling Best Practices.

  • Understand and document customer pain points, advocate for them internally to influence product changes.

  • Identify and work with sales on opportunities for account expansion post go-live.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • MS or Ph.D. in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Immunology, Bioinformatics, Biological Engineering or a related field.

  • At least 2 years of experience in a lab or R&D setting, ideally in antibody discovery or strain engineering or process development. You must be able to empathize with scientists and quickly understand complicated scientific concepts.

  • Software Implementation experience, preferably with a SaaS software company.

  • Strong communication skills. You must be able to quickly and effectively connect with a range of stakeholders, including scientists, IT project leads, and executives.

  • Self-starter with the ability to be successful in a startup environment.

  • Curious, creative, and tenacious. You should be excited to collaborate with customers and other Benchling teammates as a thought partner.

  • Ability to travel up to 25% based on customer and project needs.

  • Fluent or native proficiency in French or German

  • Experience using Benchling, especially if you’ve been a Benchling administrator, is preferred but not required.

HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

#BI-Hybrid

Benchling welcomes everyone.

We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences.

We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

descriptionHtml:
Shape the Future of Financial Services with Capco

At Capco, we specialize in management consulting and software development, partnering with leading international banks and insurance companies across Western Europe. Our innovative approach and collaborative culture make us the ideal place for professionals looking to make an impact in financial services technology.

Role Description

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Infrastructure Manager (m/w/d) to lead a major AI Ops implementation project for a large German bank. The ideal candidate combines strong technical infrastructure expertise with proven experience in managing complex IT projects, leading technical teams, and coordinating stakeholders in large-scale enterprise environments.

This role requires a hands-on understanding of modern IT infrastructure, automation, and operational processes, alongside strong project leadership, communication, and organizational skills.

  • Ensure the implementation aligns with existing IT architecture, operational processes, and enterprise infrastructure standards.
  • Oversee the consideration of functional and non-functional requirements, including performance, security, availability, and operational stability.
  • Manage dependencies, technical risks, and implementation challenges across different teams and workstreams.
  • Act as a key interface between technical teams, project stakeholders, and management, ensuring transparent communication and alignment.
  • Drive collaboration in ITIL-based, DevOps, and agile delivery environments.
  • Establish structured project governance, track progress, and ensure timely delivery of key milestones.

Skills and Expertise

  • Solid experience in managing IT teams in setting up and managing complex environments in large-scale IT projects in a banking environment.
  • Experience in managing IT infrastructure, networking, virtualization, containerization, and cloud technologies.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies, and test automation.
  • Understanding of both functional and non-functional test requirements (e.g., performance, security, availability).
  • Proficient in stakeholder communication and program leadership.
  • Experience working in ITIL-based, DevOps, or agile project environments.
  • High degree of ownership and structured work approach.
  • Ability to clearly communicate complex technical topics in both German and English.

title: Ingenieur* Energietechnik für erneuerbare Energien
descriptionHtml:
Du suchst einen Job mit Zukunft?

Bei der Energiebauern GmbH entwickeln, bauen und betreiben wir seit 2003 leistungsstarke Anlagen im Bereich erneuerbare Energien. Unser über 100-köpfiges Team deckt mit dem breiten Know-How die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette - von der Projektentwicklung und Finanzierung über Planung, Bau und Inbetriebnahme bis hin zu Netzbetrieb, Energiewirtschaft und Instandhaltung - ab. Neben den Photovoltaikfreiflächenanlagen umfasst unser Portfolio mittlerweile Umspannwerke, Batteriespeicher, Einspeisetrassen und Windenergieanlagen. Als familiengeführtes Unternehmen legen wir Wert auf Teamgeist und bieten dir gleichzeitig spannende Herausforderungen in einem dynamischen und zukunftssicheren Umfeld.

Bewirb dich und werde Teil unseres Teams - Begleite von unserem Standort in Aichach den Bau der modernsten und innovativsten Wind- und PV-Projekte in Deutschland!

DEINE AUFGABEN:

  • Analyse und Behebung technischer Störungen im Bereich Mittel- und Hochspannung aus dem Büro

  • Zentraler Ansprechpartner für komplexe technische Fragestellungen

  • Eigenverantwortliche Betreuung eines zugewiesenen Anlagenbestandes von erneuerbaren Energieerzugungsanlagen

  • Planung, Abstimmung und Organisation von Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsmaßnahmen

  • Mitwirkung bei der Strukturierung interner Abteilungsabläufe

WIR BIETEN:

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien – keine Konzernstrukturen

  • Keine externen Gutachter, Kunden oder Budgetplanung, da wir unser eigener Kunde sind

  • Exzellente bestehende technische und wirtschaftliche Expertise für deine Einarbeitung und Unterstützung

title: Ingénieur études CVC confirmé
descriptionHtml:
BERS est un bureau d’études CVC indépendant spécialisé en conception, exécution et audits techniques sur sites occupés (Île-de-France principalement, avec quelques projets à l’international).

Nous intervenons sur des projets tertiaires et industriels, souvent en environnement contraint, avec des installations existantes complexes et peu documentées.

Aujourd’hui, nous structurons une première équipe technique (projeteurs et apprentis) capable de produire à haut niveau.

Tu es acteur des projets qui te sont confiés, de l’analyse initiale jusqu’à la livraison finale.

Dans ton rôle, tu es aussi attendu sur :

  • La prise de décision technique sans dépendre systématiquement de validation
  • La structuration de tes sujets (priorités, organisation, clarté des livrables)
  • La montée en compétence de ton équipe (projeteurs / apprentis)

👉 Tu es responsable du résultat final.

Pas uniquement de la production.

Vos compétences

Compétences

  • Expérience en bureau d’études CVC (minimum 3–5 ans)

C’est une réalité opérationnelle :

title: Ingénieur.e de recherche pour le pilotage de l'activité hospitalière (H/F) - CDD 14 mois
descriptionHtml:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

Ce poste, ouvert au sein d’IMT Mines Albi, est rattaché au Centre Génie Industriel (CGI) qui compte à ce jour environ 70 personnes. Le centre s’intéresse à la cinétique des organisations et au développement de solutions d’aide à la décision dans des contextes hétérogènes, collaboratifs et incertains. Ceci est mis en pratique par la représentation, la modélisation et l’analyse des données de ces organisations afin de formaliser de la connaissance conduisant à la prise de décision dans des contextes hétérogènes, collaboratifs, incertains et/ou perturbés. Le CGI est structuré selon quatre axes de recherche appliquée :

  • Axe FLOWS : Systèmes logistiques flexibles pour un monde durable ;

  • Axe DISCS : Systèmes numériques pour la gestion des crises et la sécurité ;

  • Axe WHOPS : Systèmes organisationnels pour la santé et le bien-être ;

  • Axe TRACE : Résilience territoriale, agilité et économie circulaire.

Huit expertises scientifiques et techniques sont au cœur de ces axes de recherche : Ingénierie systèmes, Ingénierie des modèles, Théorie de la décision, Recherche opérationnelle, Technologies immersives, IA générative, IA symbolique, et IA connexionniste. Les chercheurs et ingénieurs du CGI exploitent et contribuent particulièrement aux paradigmes scientifiques suivants pour réaliser les projets de recherche ou formation : l’Internet Physique, la Physique des Décisions, les Jumeaux Numériques Organisationnels.

Le poste à pourvoir concerne l'un des projets de recherche de l'axe WHOPS. Le but de ce projet est de répondre à un besoin exprimé par l'Agence Régionale de Santé (ARS) et un hôpital de la région parisienne. La personne recrutée sera intégrée à une équipe de chercheurs en ingénierie organisationnelle pour la santé, ce qui garantira un accompagnement visant une montée en régime rapide et un suivi régulier des activités de l'ingénieur(e) recruté(e).

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

Le contexte général du projet concerne le pilotage des capacités hospitalières et l'anticipation des tensions sur l'offre de soins. Il s'agit d'un enjeu majeur pour les établissements de santé, les institutions en charge de la planification de l'offre de soins, et plus largement, pour l'ensemble des professionnels impliqués dans l'orientation des patients.

L'objectif général du projet est de développer et expérimenter, en s'appuyant sur des données réelles provenant du système d'information d'un hôpital, des outils innovants d'analyse et de prévision-prédiction de l'activité hospitalière, essentiels pour améliorer l'anticipation et le pilotage des capacités (ressources humaines et lits).

Parmi les outils et solutions envisagés, un intérêt particulier porte sur les principes du jumeau numérique asynchrone permettant l'analyse rétrospective des parcours patients et la simulation "in silico" de scénarios prospectifs. D'autres outils et techniques, concurrents ou complémentaires, notamment à base de projections statistiques et d'intelligence artificielle, devront aussi être explorés.

De manière générale, l'ingénieur(e) de recherche recruté(e) interviendra sur les développements et les travaux de recherche visant l'objectif général du projet. Plus précisément, la mission consiste à :

  • Analyser les données associées aux flux de patients et les déterminants organisationnels et médicaux influençant les durées de séjour et l'occupation des lits ;

  • Développer des modèles permettant d'estimer et d'anticiper l'évolution des taux d'occupation des capacités hospitalières ;

  • Développer des outils d'aide à la décision destinés aux professionnels hospitaliers et aux acteurs de la régulation ;

  • Produire une méthodologie reproductible et transférable à d'autres établissements ou territoires de soins ;

  • Documenter tous les travaux de développement dans des dossiers techniques à destination d'autres développeurs.

  • Rédiger des notices d'utilisation pour les utilisateurs finaux des modules ou application.

  • Rédiger ou participer à la rédaction de publications scientifiques pour valoriser les travaux réalisés.

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables :

  • Méthodologies de recherche et développement, incluant notamment les étapes de spécification des besoins, d’analyse de la littérature, de conception de solutions logicielles et organisationnelles, d’expérimentation, de validation, et de dissémination des résultats.

  • Connaissances fondamentales des langages, outils et méthodes de traitement et d'analyse de données ainsi que des notions en interfaçage utilisateur.

  • Compétences en simulation à événements discrets à l'aide d'outils du commerce (Witness, FlexSim, AnyLogic, …) ou à l'aide de bibliothèques de développement (SimPy, SimJulia, Salabim, …).

  • Connaissances générales du système de santé français et si possible expérience (stage, emploi) en milieu hospitalier.

Capacités et aptitudes :

  • Communication, écoute, pédagogie, et interaction avec des chercheurs du CGI comme avec des professionnels de santé à l'hôpital.

  • Esprit d'équipe, collaboration, force de proposition, synthèse, rigueur technique et scientifique, autonomie.

PROFIL RECHERCHE :

Le(la) candidat(e) devra être titulaire d’un diplôme d’ingénieur ou d’un Master M2. Son domaine d’activité se situe en génie industriel, en informatique ou en sciences de données et en intelligence artificielle.

AU-DELÀ DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT PROFESSIONNEL, POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? :

  • cadre de travail agréable dans un campus de 22 ha

  • 49 jours de congés par an

  • restauration administrative sur place

  • aide à la mobilité durable pour le transport domicile-travail
