title: Innovative Planning Manager (Data Centres/Buildings/High-tech/Infrastructure) - Germany (Hybrid)
descriptionHtml:
Are you a seasoned construction planner that is a bit tired of the standard old-fashioned wayof doing things in the construction industry?
Do you get deep satisfaction from making things run more effi ciently using a good dose ofcommon sense and maybe a bit of technology?
Have you always cared about the importance of proper planning and the connection betweenthe schedule and the real day-to-day delivery of the job?
Have you ever wanted to work a bit more fl exibly but still be hands-on in construction andimproving the industry?
Sounds like a dream. Well, it isn’t, it is actually quite real!
Read on! ____________________________________________________________ We are Laminar Projects! If you’ve already heard about us, you’re probably reading this because you’re tired of the typical, chaotic ways of doing things in construction. But in case you haven’t, we’re a high-end project management consultancy and tech developer with a focus on upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Check out our short film about it.) We bring transparency and control to projects through a pragmatic mix of the latest tech, our own processes, and a big dose of common sense. We then take our deep understanding of these projects and we invest heavily into developing the digital solutions that anyone can use to deliver their projects better. (Check out Shape, our construction management tech, to see what we’re doing.) The core of all this is our true secret sauce: our people. We only recruit the very best, both in capability and personality. We’re deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that’s optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People who join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. (Read more about our vision and missions.) This approach has allowed us to grow from just two people in 2017 to over 220 today. We have a stable, repeat client base across infrastructure and complex building projects in the UK and internationally, and we’re still growing fast. Joining us isn’t just some “job”. It’s a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. There are many diverse and interesting challenges available. It’s up to you to guide yourself into whichever areas you’re most interested – we’ll enable it. (Get to know us better by watching a few more of our videos.) Core values for a good life A life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships and challenging yourself to create a positive impact, so our values reflect the four levels of relationships that each of us has: - Grow yourself – your relationship with yourself - Care about people – your relationship with others around you - Execute to greatness – your relationship with your team - Build civilisation – your relationship with humanity and the world We enshrined our values in our vision: We exist so that everyone in our team can flourish in a high-impact community that: - Connects us with meaningful relationships - Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans - Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures By first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world. And enable the achievement of our vision through our two missions: - To fully digitalise the construction of human civilisation - To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society ____________________________________________________________ The Role Purpose of the role You will be enhancing the delivery of the most complex and interesting projects in the world through the power of project planning. You will be a senior leader in our team pushing the discipline to new heights not only within Laminar but within the industry in general. Your Team This role is part of our Project Management Consultancy which focuses on:
- Understanding what the real problems of projects are
- Implementing the best solutions to those problems
- Developing scalable best practices, tools and technology
More specifically you will be part of our Project Planning Discipline Team who are industry leaders in the planning of complex construction projects. Your initial leader will be one of our planning discipline directors. Your top 3 objectives
1. To make construction projects deliver to near perfection
2. To create scalable and repeatable solutions to common problems
3. To develop yourself and everyone around you
Your top 5 responsibilities
1. Own the plan: Own the project plan for one or more projects and ensure that the project isworking to it eff ectively. Ensure delays are mitigated and managed commercially.
2. Own the outcome: You may not be the project manager ultimately responsible for the resultsbut you are sure as heck responsible for putting in your best eff ort to ensure the project’sunderstanding and focus on the plan no matter how stubborn they are!
3. Report and inform: Provide simple actionable reports to stakeholders at all levels that helpthem deliver their part of the project more effi ciently and eff ectively.
4. Make scalable solutions: Develop scalable and repeatable best practices and tools incollaboration with the team so that long-term impact is achieved.
5. Develop everyone: Maximise the development of your team personally and professionallyand educate our clients to improve as well. Must-Have (The fundamentals)
- Mastery: Solid construction project planning capability in all aspects that take into accountstrategic objectives and the broad context you are operating in
- Communication: The charisma, infl uence and presence to get construction people to do newthings and take the best approach
- Leadership: A proven leader/coach/developer of teams
- Impact: A track record of implementing scalable and repeatable solutions in projects that hada signifi cant positive impact Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true:
- You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge
- You like to be the smartest person in the room
- You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
- You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team ____________________________________________________________ Frequently Asked Questions What kinds of projects would I be working on? It’s common for people to be exposed to several projects in their first year with us. You’ll work on some of the most complex and interesting environments in the world. We’ve delivered over 100 data centres internationally, many of them fast-tracked and multi-package. Our teams have supported flagship infrastructure programmes like HS2 through integrated planning and digital delivery, contributed to over $30bn in power generation and transmission projects, and played a key role in the development of high-containment labs and R&D campuses for some of the world’s most advanced industrial and life sciences clients. You might find yourself working in sectors such as data centres, infrastructure (including defense, rail, and highways), high tech (such as advanced manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and semiconductors), or complex building projects. These aren’t hands-off assignments. They’re dynamic, hands-on environments designed for people who want to be challenged. We bring back the lessons from every project to help our team grow and deliver the highest levels of value. (Check out our case stories.) Who are our clients? Major owners/operators and main contractors with project values between £1m and £1bn+ globally. Where would I be working? One week you might be working from home. The next, you might travel to the site to meet the construction teams and help organise them. Maybe you’ll pop into our London office for a workshop or a beer. Maybe you’ll fly out to exotic (and sometimes not!) locations in Europe or the Middle East to visit clients. It really depends on what you want to get involved in and what fits with your life. How does what I do connect with the long-term impact on the construction industry? You’re tasked with understanding and solving common problems. We don’t want to reinvent the wheel every time, so you’ll be responsible for documenting new solutions and evolving ones we’ve developed. This goes into our knowledge repository, which we’re going to open source to the industry. The knowledge you capture will be used by us to build new products. You’ll constantly test those products in the field, so we can rapidly iterate and improve them for anyone in the industry to use. ____________________________________________________________ Benefits The standard stuff: - Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance - Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft The life-changing stuff: - In-house coaching. Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally - professionally and as a human being - Equity upside. As we grow, you grow. Our generous equity scheme is especially powerful for those who stay with us on our journey. You help us build the future - and own a piece of it - Flexible working. Work where it makes sense - most of our team works from home, visiting sites or clients regularly. We care about outcomes, not clock-ins - Relentless development. Our goal is for every year here to be worth five years of development anywhere else. You’ll get a coach, a mentor, honest feedback, and a culture that challenges you to keep levelling up ____________________________________________________________ Important! Applying properly We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining: - Why you want to join us - What you’ll bring to the team We aren't a giant, faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team, so your letter will be read carefully. After that, we’ll reach out to you to schedule a casual conversation to help you get to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself. A couple of technical and personal assessments follow to understand your capability based on our own development matrix. This is to ensure that when you join, you’re starting at the right level of responsibility.

title: Integration Manager
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an Integration Manager to drive the successful rollout of innovative digital products across a growing range of markets and partners at GLS/NXT.

Your main responsibility as Integration Manager will be to lead and coordinate technical integrations between the GLS/NXT and the broader GLS corporate organization (and beyond), ensuring smooth adoption and strong stakeholder alignment.

You will work at the intersection of product, tech, and operations, ultimately aligning corporate requirements with the agile work environment at GLS/NXT. Your focus will be on reducing complexity in implementations, driving structured communication, and ensuring long-term product adoption both internally and externally.

This role is perfect for someone who is well-organized, process-driven and interested in breaking down complex technical tasks into digestible pieces.

Tasks

  • Manage integration projects: Drive international integration projects end-to-end by coordinating between GLS/NXT and internal or external stakeholders to ensure a smooth and well-structured onboarding process.
  • Ensure successful product adoption: Support customers beyond integration by helping them understand and realize the value of GLS/NXT products through user behavior analysis, feedback loops, and personal sparring
  • Bridge tech and business: Translate technical requirements into clear deliverables and timelines, ensuring efficient coordination between tech teams, ensuring that the right information reaches the right people at the right time
  • Improve integration processes: Identify gaps and pain points in the current setup and proactively drive improvements through documentation, tooling, and automation
  • Manage stakeholder relationships: Build strong, empathetic relationships with internal and external stakeholders and ensure GLS/NXT is well-represented within the corporate environment
  • Create visibility and impact: Report on integration progress and outcomes, highlighting key successes and learnings team-internal or to the leadership team

Requirements

  • ≥2 years of experience in integration, implementation, (technical) project management or customer success management in B2B
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills with a structured approach to problem-solving
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and cultures
  • Fundamental understanding of technical concepts (API, system architecture or digital platform products
  • Business-level proficiency in English, both written and spoken
  • Ability to travel within the EU (10%)
  • Permission to work in Germany

Benefits

  • Dynamic workplace: A digital environment with international projects and space to learn and grow
  • Flexible work conditions: Hybrid working mode with a tailored remote policy
  • Focus on learning: A personal budget (1.000€) for learning and development initiatives
  • Physical space for ideas: A great office space in Berlin Mitte with top-tier equipment
  • Transparent and competitive compensation: A salary package that reflects your expertise and experience.
  • Active participation: A clear bonus system enabling participation in your and the team’s performance
  • Engaging team culture: Monthly team cooking, regular events and offsites
  • Vacation policy: 30 days of yearly holiday

Even if you do not meet every single requirement, we encourage you to apply if you believe you are well-suited for the role and can contribute meaningfully to our team.

About GLS/NXT

GLS/NXT was founded with the mission to build the next generation of logistic experiences driven by technology - core, adjacent & beyond. More specifically, our sphere of interest is the Logistics and eCommerce sector. We are entrepreneurs and hence always start with the user's needs. We are located between Corporate and Startups and leverage the benefits from both (startup speed and corporate muscle). GLS/NXT inhabits different project teams, acting as startups with business responsibility and setting their own vision and mission. GLS/NXT is part of the GLS IT Services GmbH.

Commitment to Diversity

GLS/NXT is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: International Policy Intern
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

Proxima Fusion is looking for an International Policy Intern to join the Partnerships and Public Affairs Team in Munich. You will work closely with the International Policy Team and contribute to Proxima's engagement with EU institutions, national governments and international organisations. Fusion is one of the fastest-moving industries in the world and European and international policy will shape how quickly it reaches the market. This internship offers direct exposure to that process and the opportunity to take on substantive responsibility from the start and be involved across a broad range of policy files, from EU funding and industrial policy to the regulatory frameworks for fusion.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Monitor EU policy, regulatory and financial developments, and analyse their impact on Proxima's business to anticipate opportunities and risks.

  • Research and analyse policy issues relevant to fusion energy at EU and international level.

  • Prepare briefings and background documents for meetings with EU policymakers, regulators, government representatives and other stakeholders.

  • Support the development of policy proposals, position papers and consultation responses for European institutions.

  • Support the coordination of government engagement across jurisdictions in Europe and globally, including bilateral meetings, delegation visits and international forums.

  • Support Proxima's participation in industry associations and policy events.

  • Work with Proxima's business and technical teams to keep policy and business priorities aligned, and share policy insights across the company.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Enrolled in or a recent graduate of a degree program in European Studies, Political Science, International Relations, Law, Public Policy, Economics, or a related discipline.

  • Solid understanding of European Union decision-making structures and legislative procedures.

  • Exceptional analytical, drafting, and synthesis capabilities, with a track record of distilling policy subjects into business-language.

  • Full professional proficiency in English. Additional languages preferred.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)


*This role sits at "L1" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: iOS Developer
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for iOS engineers to build the native iOS experience for BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native iOS features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Make complex financial flows feel clean, fast and simple on mobile.

  • Work with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take ideas from rough concept to production release.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases, responsiveness and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve features after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native iOS experience using Swift.

  • Experience shipping iOS apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of SwiftUI, UIKit, async/await and iOS architecture patterns.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just building screens.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

 

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

 

Location

This role is based in UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our UK office at least 3 days per week.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: IT Helpdesk Specialist
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

Are you always one step ahead? The kind of person who has the new hire’s laptop ready before they arrive, notices the meeting-room camera is offline before the call starts, and, after fixing the same problem twice, makes sure nobody has to ask a third time?

We’re looking for an IT Helpdesk Specialist for our Amsterdam office. You’ll own on-site IT here and support colleagues in other hubs remotely, as part of a small global IT team across Amsterdam, Barcelona, São Paulo, Austin, and Yerevan. Our own AI helpdesk agent already answers routine questions in Slack, so your time goes to the work that needs a person: hands-on help, judgment on unclear or risky requests, and care for the people you support.

Our team is organized by domains, and you’ll grow into one of them: Access & Identity (Okta), the area behind most of our requests. Real ownership, from day one. Ready to make it yours?

YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋

Meet the IT team:

We're a small global team in Amsterdam, Barcelona, São Paulo, Austin, and Yerevan, and we keep 400+ manychatters working smoothly and securely. We're organized by domains, so everyone owns an area end to end. AI is part of how we work, including our own helpdesk agent. Our docs live in GitHub, so one good answer helps many people.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

On-site and remote support

  • Be the first person colleagues in Amsterdam reach for IT help: at your desk, in Slack, and through our service desk (Freshservice). Support colleagues in other hubs remotely.

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, and connectivity on a Mac-first fleet managed with Jamf, with some Windows devices. Escalate complex issues to IT Administrators with full context, logs, and what you've already tried.

  • Get every new hire ready on day one (laptop, peripherals, accounts, and a walkthrough of our tools), and close access and collect equipment for leavers, working with the People and Talent teams.

Office, meeting rooms, and events

  • Keep office IT running: Wi-Fi and wired network (UniFi), printers, office access control, Zoom Rooms, displays, and room schedulers. Make sure meeting rooms are ready every day, and work with the building operator, ISPs, and vendors until every issue is resolved.

  • Set up and run AV for All-Hands, internal events, and meetups: microphones, cameras, displays, and streaming when needed. Some events happen outside regular hours.

  • Keep the office hardware inventory accurate in Freshservice Assets, manage the loaner pool and spares, and support local purchases, refreshes, and decommissioning.

Access & Identity (Okta)

  • Run day-to-day Okta administration: users, groups and group rules, app assignments, password resets, MFA, and lifecycle states.

  • Keep our role-based access model clean, and connect new apps to Okta (SAML or OIDC single sign-on, SCIM provisioning) together with system owners and Security.

  • Check every access request for legitimacy and least privilege, and make sure access is right for every joiner, mover, and leaver, including contractors and partners.

  • Act as the European backup for this domain, covering access work during European hours, and grow into co-owning it.

Knowledge and automation

  • Write and maintain knowledge base articles in Markdown. Our docs live in GitHub and go through pull requests, and our helpdesk agent answers from them, so one good article saves many tickets.

  • Spot repeated requests and fix the cause with a better intake form, an article, or a small automation (Freshservice workflows, n8n, scripts). Use AI tools to research, draft, and script, and check the result before it reaches users.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 🎯

  • By day 30: you know the office, the stack, and the people. You close tickets end to end and run onboardings on your own.

  • By day 60: you add or fix knowledge base articles every week, own meeting rooms and event AV in Amsterdam, and handle routine Okta changes on your own.

  • By day 90: you can cover Access & Identity when its owner is away, and you've shipped at least one improvement that removes a recurring type of ticket.

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

You'll need:

  • 3+ years of IT support in a SaaS or cloud-first company, where you've covered a broad scope and know the full helpdesk lifecycle.

  • Strong macOS skills and hands-on Jamf (or similar MDM) experience; working knowledge of Windows.

  • Hands-on Okta administration (or a comparable identity provider such as Entra ID): groups and group rules, app assignments, SAML or OIDC app integration, SCIM provisioning, and user lifecycle.

  • Onboarding and offboarding experience: you know what "day-1 ready" means and deliver it every time.

  • Meeting room and event AV experience with Zoom Rooms or similar systems, cameras, microphones, and displays, including setting up an event space or a new office together with integrators and vendors.

  • Networking basics: Wi-Fi diagnostics, switching, DHCP, and DNS, enough to find the problem and talk to the vendor.

  • Google Workspace admin basics and experience with a service desk tool (Freshservice, Jira Service Management, Zendesk, or similar).

  • AI as part of how you work. You use tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini every day, and describe the task clearly, check the output before you trust it. This one's a must.

  • Clear writing and fluent English: short, useful answers for users, and articles a colleague can follow without asking you.

  • You notice when a request looks wrong (say, an urgent password reset for an executive), know when to stop and escalate, and stay friendly and focused on busy days.

  • You fix the cause, not only the ticket: if something happens twice, you find out why and make it stop. You pick up new tools without waiting for training.

  • Availability to work from our Amsterdam office 4–5 days a week, with occasional after-hours support for events or planned changes.

It would be great if you have:

  • An Okta certification (Certified Professional or Administrator) or experience with Okta Workflows.

  • Freshservice administration experience: workflows, catalog items, SLA policies, and reporting.

  • Light scripting or automation skills (Python, bash, n8n, or similar), or a real automation you built yourself, with or without AI help.

  • Git and GitHub basics: branches, pull requests, Markdown.

  • Experience with Q-SYS or similar audio processing, Logitech room systems, and Zoom Rooms administration.

  • Live streaming experience for meetups: multi-camera switching (ATEM, OBS, or similar), audio mixing, and streaming to YouTube.

  • UniFi networking and UniFi Access.

  • A bit of Microsoft Intune for Windows devices.

WHAT WE OFFER 🤗

We care deeply about your growth, well-being, and comfort:

  • 💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family.

  • 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow.

  • 🫶 Flexible benefits package: no one-size-fits-all perks here. You get a budget and you decide where it goes, from health and wellbeing to family and setting up your home office.

  • 🪴 Hybrid work and generous, flexible time off — planned with your team, not rationed by a rigid quota.

  • 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks.

  • 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events.

  • 🤖 AI isn't a perk here — it's how we work. Claude, OpenAI, and more are on by default from day one, and we back teams in adopting whatever makes them faster.

title: IT Support Spezialist –  Telematikinfrastruktur & Praxissicherheit (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:

Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen ihre IT-Systeme und die Telematikinfrastruktur im Praxisalltag zuverlässig nutzen können. Im 1st- und 2nd-Level-Support analysierst du Störungen, findest Lösungen und bist kompetente Ansprechperson rund um TI, Praxissicherheit und IT-Infrastruktur.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung, z. B. als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration, IT-Systemelektroniker oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen

  • Da du mit unserer technischen Infrastruktur arbeitest und unsere Kund:innen direkt unterstützt, findet die Tätigkeit vor Ort in Magdeburg statt.

Warum die HASOMED-Unternehmensgruppe?

  • Weil funktionierende IT im Gesundheitswesen entscheidend dafür ist, dass Praxen sich auf das konzentrieren können, worauf es wirklich ankommt: ihre Patient.

Dein Job für sauberere Luft. Werde Emission Partner.



IT aus dem Saterland. Wirkung im ganzen Unternehmen.

In der Gemeinde Saterland entwickeln und produzieren wir Technologien, die Schadstoffemissionen reduzieren. Unsere Katalysatoren und Systeme kommen dort zum Einsatz, wo Abgase zuverlässig gereinigt und Emissionsgrenzwerte eingehalten werden müssen.

Doch moderne Technologie braucht eine IT, auf die man sich verlassen kann. Von unserer internen Infrastruktur über Cloud-Dienste und Netzwerke bis zu IoT- und Kundensystemen: Wenn unsere digitalen Systeme sicher und zuverlässig funktionieren, können auch unsere Teams ihre Arbeit machen.

Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Als IT-Systemadministrator betreust und entwickelst du unsere IT-Landschaft weiter. Dabei bist du nicht nur dafür da, dass bestehende Systeme funktionieren. Du bekommst den Freiraum, neue Lösungen einzuführen, Strukturen zu verbessern und Themen wie Cloud, IT-Sicherheit und KI aktiv mitzugestalten.

Du möchtest nicht einfach Tickets abarbeiten, sondern Verantwortung für eine IT-Umgebung übernehmen und selbst etwas bewegen? Dann werde Emission Partner.

Was du bei uns bewirkst



Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere digitale Infrastruktur genauso zuverlässig funktioniert wie unsere Technik.

Bei uns erwartet dich eine vielseitige IT-Aufgabe mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Du kümmerst dich um klassische Systemadministration und Netzwerke, beschäftigst dich aber gleichzeitig mit Cloud-Infrastruktur, IT-Sicherheit, IoT und neuen technologischen Möglichkeiten.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit den unterschiedlichen Bereichen unseres Unternehmens zusammen und entwickelst unsere IT-Landschaft kontinuierlich weiter.

Und weil Digitalisierung bei uns nicht an der Unternehmensgrenze endet, beschäftigst du dich teilweise auch mit den IT- und Netzwerkanforderungen unserer technischen Kundensysteme.

Kurz gesagt: Du hältst nicht nur unsere IT am Laufen. Du entwickelst sie mit uns weiter.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du administrierst, betreibst und entwickelst unsere IT-Infrastruktur, Systeme, Netzwerke und Cloud-Lösungen weiter.
  • Du betreust unsere Netzwerkumgebung und kümmerst dich um Switches, Router, Firewalls, VPN, VLANs und Netzwerksegmentierung.
  • Du planst und implementierst neue IT-Systeme und Anwendungen und integrierst sie in unsere bestehende Infrastruktur.
  • Du überwachst unsere Systeme und sorgst durch Monitoring, Fehleranalyse und Störungsbehebung für eine stabile und performante Umgebung.
  • Du entwickelst unsere IT-Sicherheit weiter und beschäftigst dich unter anderem mit Zugriffskontrollen, Berechtigungen, Netzwerksicherheit und grundlegenden Anforderungen im Umfeld der ISO 27001.
  • Du unterstützt uns dabei, KI-gestützte Anwendungen und Prozesse sinnvoll und sicher in unseren Arbeitsalltag zu integrieren.
  • Du betreust unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen bei IT-Fragen und findest pragmatische Lösungen für technische Probleme.
  • Du beschäftigst dich auch mit IoT-, Netzwerk- und IT-Komponenten unserer Kundensysteme und unterstützt bei Bedarf remote oder vor Ort bei Inbetriebnahmen und Fehleranalysen.
  • Du arbeitest mit unseren technischen und kaufmännischen Bereichen zusammen und übersetzt Anforderungen in funktionierende IT-Lösungen.
  • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und erhältst den Gestaltungsspielraum, unsere IT technisch und organisatorisch weiterzuentwickeln.

Das bringst du mit



Uns ist wichtiger, was du kannst und lernen möchtest, als ein perfekter Lebenslauf oder dass du hinter jeder Technologie einen Haken setzen kannst.

  • Du hast eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium im IT-Bereich abgeschlossen, beispielsweise als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration, IT-Systemelektroniker oder Informatiker (m/w/d), oder bringst vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung mit.
  • Du kennst dich mit Systemadministration aus und fühlst dich in Windows- und/oder Linux-Umgebungen zu Hause.
  • Netzwerke sind für dich mehr als WLAN: Begriffe wie TCP/IP, VLAN, VPN, Routing, Switching und Firewall sind dir vertraut.
  • Du hast idealerweise bereits mit Microsoft 365, Microsoft Azure und Microsoft Entra ID oder vergleichbaren Cloud-Technologien gearbeitet.
  • Du hast ein grundlegendes Verständnis von IT-Sicherheit und möchtest diesen Bereich gemeinsam mit uns weiterentwickeln.
  • Du interessierst dich für KI und neue Technologien und möchtest herausfinden, wo sie im Unternehmen echten Mehrwert schaffen.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und kannst technische Probleme selbstständig analysieren und lösen.
  • Gleichzeitig kannst du IT so erklären, dass auch Kolleginnen und Kollegen außerhalb der IT dich verstehen.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.
  • Für gelegentliche Kundentermine besitzt du einen Führerschein der Klasse B.


Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem.

Wir suchen bewusst keinen Menschen, der jedes System und jede Technologie bereits perfekt beherrscht. Wenn du eine gute technische Basis mitbringst, Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest und Lust hast, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten, sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other.

Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

title: Junior AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Lemrock builds the infrastructure of agentic commerce.

Tomorrow, consumers won't just buy on e-commerce websites. They will discover, compare and purchase directly inside conversational AI interfaces like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and a growing long tail of specialized AI assistants.

For brands, this is a major shift: if they are not present in these environments, they become invisible.

Our mission: enable any brand to exist, sell and distribute in this new channel.

We raised a €7M seed round (the first in Europe on this market), with Jean-Baptiste Rudelle, founder of Criteo, on our board, and the Bpifrance DeepTech label.

Today, Lemrock is already:

  • 100M+ conversations per month

  • 150+ brand clients

  • a $100B market structuring at high speed

The role

The product works, clients renew, and every month millions of people talk to AI agents running on our infrastructure before they buy. That traffic produces a unique dataset, and we want to get even more out of it: uncover the hidden patterns in how shoppers search, compare and decide, and use them to keep improving our recommendation algorithms and campaign performance.

As our Junior AI Engineer, this is applied work: you dig into the data, find what drives performance, ship the improvement to production and measure the result. You also maintain and improve our agents in production, and build the Claude Code skills that automate operational work and save time for the business team. You work directly with our Founding AI Engineer and the founders, alongside product and engineering.

Understand what drives performance

  • Explore our conversational and behavioural data, alongside campaign performance

  • Track our key metrics, spot what moves, and find out why

  • Surface the hidden patterns that make recommendations more relevant

Ship your findings to production

  • Turn your findings into improvements to our recommendation algorithms and agents, implemented in production

  • Measure the impact directly with A/B tests, and feed the results into the next iteration

  • Industrialise the analyses you run often into automated pipelines and monitoring, reviewed by the engineering team

Improve our agents in production

  • Maintain and improve our agents: prompts, tools, evaluation, and the code around them

  • Turn client feedback into agent improvements: qualify what they ask for, and ship directly what can be handled at the agent level

Automate operations at scale

  • Build and maintain Claude Code skills that automate operational work at scale and free up time for the business team

Profile

Must-have

  • 0 to 3 years of experience, internships and work-study included. Fresh graduates are welcome.

  • Personal projects where you built LLM agents end to end (prompts, tools, evaluation), or ran a serious data analysis on your own

  • Hands-on prompt engineering: you write, test and iterate on prompts, and you measure whether a change actually made things better

  • Solid SQL and Python for analysis

  • The basics of statistics: you know how to read an A/B test and when not to trust a number

  • You use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) every day

  • Rigorous and precise: you check your numbers before you share them

  • Fluent French and professional English

A plus

  • A top engineering, business or data school, in France or abroad

  • AI courses or certifications

  • You have founded something, even small, and got real users or paying customers

  • Hackathons, open source, or side projects that went further than a weekend

  • TypeScript

  • Recommender systems, ranking or applied ML experience

  • E-commerce, advertising, growth or conversion experience

  • BigQuery, dbt, PostHog

What we offer

  • Competitive salary plus equity (BSPCE)

  • You learn next to our Founding AI Engineer and the founders, two of them repeat YC founders

  • A dataset very few people will ever see: 100M+ conversations a month between shoppers and AI agents

  • An AI-first team: Claude Code and agents are part of everyone's daily work

  • Ownership that grows fast: you start by taking real work off our plates, and take on more as you prove yourself

title: (Junior) Project Manager / Project Manager (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
LET THERE BE SOUND

If MUSIC - SOUND – EMOTIONS are your passion, this might be your opportunity to work with the best in the industry to create those vibes!

Our team expands and we are hiring a (Junior) Product Manager with prooven experience in acoustics, to help us handle all the little details that are required to make a great idea become a great product.

Tasks

Job Description : As a Project Manager (m/f/d) or (Junior) Project Manager (m/f/d) for professional loudspeaker systems, you will be responsible for the planning, coordination, and monitoring of various individual sub-areas of a new development, aligning these between the customer, R&D, and production. You will work closely with internal and external colleagues and partners to ensure the timely completion and quality of the products. Your tasks will include, among other things, scheduling, resource management, and tracking project progress. At least basic knowledge or experience in sound reinforcement or loudspeaker construction is essential.

This full-time position offers a hybrid working model with a focus on collaborative teamwork in Solingen.

Requirements

  • Acoustics: Experience in the Audio world - This is a hard requirement!
  • A solid understanding of sound reinforcement or sound systems. Experience in the design, setup or planning of loudspeakers for musicians, events, or venues.
  • Project management: Experience in the management, coordination and implementation of projects, taking into account deadlines and resources.
  • Expediting and inspection: Ability to track and ensure milestones and to perform quality controls.
  • Analytical and organizational skills, strong communication skills, commitment, and a solution-oriented approach are advantageous. Ideally, you will have completed commercial or technical training or a relevant degree.
  • Good understanding of mechanical design.
  • Excellent English skills and strong teamwork abilities.

Benefits

  • A modern working environment with flat hierarchies.
  • A friendly and open-minded team that supports each other.
  • Social benefits.
  • Relocationing support
  • The majority of our development work is done in close collaboration with some of the most renowned brands in the professional music industry. This offers you a unique opportunity to work on innovative projects and contribute to the development of the next generation of audio technologies.

Company Information

Company description: Speaker Connection is a leading cooperation and development partner of many globally renowned brands, supporting them in the conception, development, and production of high-quality, professional loudspeaker systems. We specialize in high-quality self-powered audio solutions for a wide range of applications, particularly portable and flexibly configurable sound reinforcement systems for musicians and small to medium-sized venues.Speaker Connection is a leading cooperation and development partner of many globally renowned brands, supporting them in the conception, design, development, and production of high-quality, professional loudspeaker systems. We specialize in high-quality self-powered audio solutions for a wide range of applications, particularly portable and flexibly configurable sound reinforcement systems for musicians and small to medium-sized venues.

Since 1980, we have been developing and producing high-quality speaker systems. For more than 25 years, we are manufacturing our products exclusively in our own facility in China, where more than 400 employees build products that are distributed worldwide by our OEM customers.

With state-of-the-art technology, a dedicated team, and a wide manufacturing depth, we offer innovative products that are individually designed according to the requests of our OEM customers and meet their highest standards. From customized and individual woofers and drivers over complex enclosure constructions to tailor made DSP and amplifier electronics.

Our company is characterized by professional competence, quality, reliability and long-standing, close customer relationships.

And btw., don't get fooled by our web appearance. Being OEM/ODM supplier we work in the background and let our customers stand out.

Does this sound like the perfect challenge for you? Then we look forward to receiving your application! Just send us your resume, portfolio, and a few kind words about why you are the perfect fit for this job.

title: Kaufmännischer Mitarbeiter E-Commerce (m/w/d) mit Entwicklungsperspektive zur Personalleitung
descriptionHtml:
Über uns

Wir sind die LuxusKollektion, ein wachsendes Handelsunternehmen mit Sitz in Rosenberg im Ostalbkreis. Über zahlreiche Online-Marktplätze vertreiben wir Möbel, Wohnaccessoires und Haushaltsartikel in Deutschland, Frankreich, Italien, Spanien, Österreich und weiteren europäischen Ländern.

Wir befinden uns auf Wachstumskurs: Neue internationale Märkte, zusätzliche Vertriebskanäle und stetig wachsende Anforderungen sorgen dafür, dass es bei uns nie langweilig wird.

Damit unser Wachstum auch intern erfolgreich weitergeht, möchten wir unser Team verstärken. Dafür suchen wir eine engagierte kaufmännische Persönlichkeit, die bereits Erfahrung im E-Commerce mitbringt, gerne organisiert und Lust hat, mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Du unterstützt uns bei der Betreuung unserer internationalen Marktplätze, behältst den Überblick über kaufmännische Abläufe und bringst dich aktiv in die Organisation unseres Unternehmens ein. Gleichzeitig bekommst du die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln und perspektivisch mehr Verantwortung im Personalbereich zu übernehmen.

Wenn du gerne eigenständig arbeitest, den Überblick behältst und Freude daran hast, gemeinsam mit einem Unternehmen zu wachsen, bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Deine Aufgaben

Bei uns erwartet dich eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit kaufmännischen, organisatorischen und koordinierenden Aufgaben. Du bist eine wichtige Schnittstelle innerhalb unseres Unternehmens und unterstützt sowohl unsere E-Commerce-Abläufe als auch die Organisation unseres Teams.

E-Commerce und kaufmännische Aufgaben

  • Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer bestehenden Online-Marktplätze

  • Pflege und Optimierung von Produktangeboten, Artikeldaten, Preisen und Sortimenten

  • Überwachung unserer Marktplatzaktivitäten und Sicherstellung reibungsloser Abläufe

  • Unterstützung bei der Anbindung und dem Ausbau neuer internationaler Marktplätze

  • Bearbeitung und Koordination marktplatzbezogener Vorgänge und kaufmännischer Prozesse

  • Erkennen von Verbesserungspotenzialen und eigenständiges Einbringen neuer Ideen

Organisation und Personal

  • Unterstützung bei der Organisation und Koordinierung unserer Mitarbeiter und täglichen Arbeitsabläufe

  • Mitwirkung bei der Aufgabenverteilung und Abstimmung innerhalb der Teams

  • Unterstützung bei der Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeiter und deren Integration in bestehende Arbeitsabläufe

  • Ansprechpartner für Kollegen bei organisatorischen und allgemeinen Fragen

  • Unterstützung bei personalbezogenen und administrativen Aufgaben

  • Mitwirkung bei der Weiterentwicklung interner Strukturen und Arbeitsprozesse

  • Schrittweise Übernahme zusätzlicher Verantwortung im Bereich Personalorganisation und Mitarbeiterführung

Kundenservice

  • Gelegentliche Unterstützung unseres Kundenservice bei Kundenanfragen, Reklamationen und sonstigen Anliegen

Deine Entwicklungsperspektive:

Mit zunehmender Einarbeitung und entsprechender Entwicklung übernimmst du Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung. Du wirst stärker in organisatorische und personalbezogene Themen eingebunden und erhältst die Möglichkeit, dich in Richtung Personalverantwortung und Personalleitung weiterzuentwickeln.

Langfristig möchten wir dir die Möglichkeit bieten, eine verantwortungsvolle Position im Personalbereich zu übernehmen und die organisatorische sowie personelle Entwicklung unseres Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten.

Dein Profil

Du hast bereits Erfahrung im E-Commerce oder Onlinehandel gesammelt, arbeitest gerne strukturiert und möchtest beruflich den nächsten Schritt machen. Du bist organisiert, kommunikativ und hast Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im E-Commerce, Onlinehandel oder einem vergleichbaren kaufmännischen Bereich

  • Gute Kenntnisse der Abläufe im Onlinehandel und idealerweise Erfahrung mit verschiedenen Online-Marktplätzen

  • Kaufmännisches Verständnis und eine selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Organisationstalent und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Aufgaben und Abläufe gleichzeitig im Blick zu behalten

  • Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen und an organisatorischen Aufgaben

  • Ausgeprägtes Interesse an Personalthemen, Mitarbeiterführung und Personalentwicklung

  • Eine freundliche, kommunikative und verbindliche Art

  • Eigeninitiative und die Bereitschaft, eigene Ideen einzubringen und umzusetzen

  • Lösungsorientiertes Denken und ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein

  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Gute Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

  • Sicherer Umgang mit dem Computer und gängigen Office-Anwendungen

Von Vorteil, aber kein Muss:

  • Erfahrung in der Betreuung mehrerer Online-Marktplätze

  • Erste Erfahrungen in der Koordination oder Einarbeitung von Mitarbeitern

  • Erfahrung in der Personaladministration oder bei organisatorischen Personalthemen

  • Erste Führungserfahrung oder der Wunsch, sich langfristig in Richtung Personalleitung weiterzuentwickeln

  • Erfahrung im Kundenservice oder in der Bearbeitung von Reklamationen

Du musst noch keine Führungskraft sein und auch noch keine umfassende Erfahrung im Personalwesen mitbringen. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, Freude am Umgang mit Menschen hast und das Potenzial mitbringst, dich langfristig in eine verantwortungsvolle Position im Personalbereich zu entwickeln.

Das bieten wir dir

Wir möchten, dass du dich bei uns nicht nur fachlich weiterentwickeln kannst, sondern auch gerne zur Arbeit kommst. Deshalb legen wir Wert auf ein angenehmes Arbeitsumfeld, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein gutes Miteinander.

title: Lakebase Sales Specialist, Associate Director (Germany)
descriptionHtml:
SLSQ327R341

Databricks is seeking multiple Lakebase Sales Specialists (Central) to help customers modernize their operational data foundation with Databricks Lakebase, our fully-managed Postgres offering for intelligent applications. This high-impact role sits within the Lakebase Go-To-Market team and partners closely with regional Account Executives to drive adoption of Lakebase with platform, application, and data teams.

Lakebase gives customers a unified, governed foundation for operational workloads and AI-native applications, helping them move away from a fragmented estate of point databases toward a modern, scalable, serverless Postgres service. If you want to be at the forefront of operational databases for AI and intelligent applications at one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world, this is your opportunity.

This role is based in Munich, Germany (flexible within Germany for the right candidate), and will cover customers in the Central region (Germany, Switzerland, Austria, Eastern Europe).

The impact you will have

  • Drive new Lakebase revenue by identifying, qualifying, and driving Lakebase activations and consumption within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team.
  • Lead with outcomes for key Lakebase personas — including platform teams and developers, data teams, and central IT — articulating how Lakebase helps them ship features faster, simplify operational data architectures, and improve governance and cost efficiency.
  • Sell the value of fully-managed Postgres for intelligent applications, positioning Lakebase as the optimal choice for operational workloads that power real-time, AI-driven experiences.
  • Run complex, multi-threaded sales cycles from discovery and value hypothesis through commercial negotiation and close, navigating executive, technical, and line-of-business stakeholders.
  • Orchestrate proof-of-value and POCs that validate Lakebase’s benefits for OLTP-style workloads, reverse ETL, and AI/ML-driven applications, in partnership with solution architects and specialists.
  • Compete and win against legacy and cloud-native operational databases by leveraging our compete assets, benchmarks, and customer references.
  • Align to measurable business outcomes such as performance, developer productivity, time-to-market for new features, cost reduction, and simplification of the operational data landscape.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to shape territory plans, launch plays, and co-selling motions with key ISVs and GSIs.
  • Enable the field by sharing Lakebase best practices, success stories, and sales motions with broader sales teams, helping scale Lakebase proficiency across the organization.

What success looks like in this role

This role requires the ability to operate across two key motions simultaneously:

  • Establish top strategic focus accounts by engaging application development teams to create net-new intelligent applications leveraging Lakebase.
  • Drive longer-term Postgres standardization and migration within Databricks' most strategic accounts.

Candidates should demonstrate how they can act as a force multiplier across multiple dimensions of the business.

Success in this role requires strength in four areas:

  1. Business ownership – Operate at a business-unit level by tracking revenue, pipeline, and key observations, and by identifying areas needing additional focus or support.
  2. Strategic account engagement – Partner with account teams to engage priority accounts across the global DB700, driving strategic opportunities from initial engagement through successful outcomes.
  3. Field, account, & customer enablement: Align customers and the field on the value of Lakebase by equipping AEs and SAs with the messaging and execution motions needed to confidently own accounts without specialist intervention.
  4. Market voice and thought leadership – Develop an internal and external presence by contributing to global AMAs and internal forums, and by representing Databricks at key first- and third-party events.

The interview process is designed to evaluate candidates across all four of these dimensions.

What we look for

  • 7+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, consistently exceeding quota in complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
  • Proven success selling data platforms, operational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, cloud-native DBaaS), or adjacent data/AI infrastructure to technical buyers and business leaders.
  • Strong understanding of modern data and application architectures, including cloud-native services, microservices, event-driven systems, and how operational data underpins AI and analytics strategies.
  • Ability to sell to both technical stakeholders (developers, architects, data engineers) and business stakeholders (product leaders, operations, line-of-business owners).
  • Demonstrated experience leading specialist or overlay motions, working jointly with core Account Executives to create and progress opportunities.
  • Executive presence with the ability to whiteboard architectures, lead C-level conversations, and build trust with senior decision makers.
  • Strong value selling skills: adept at discovering pain, building a business case, and tying technical capabilities to clear, quantified outcomes.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and negotiation skills, with comfort presenting to both large and small audiences.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience selling Postgres, operational databases, OLTP workloads, or transactional cloud database services, ideally within large or strategic accounts.
  • Familiarity with data platforms, lakehouse architectures, and cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP), including how operational databases fit within broader data and AI strategies.
  • Understanding of reverse ETL, real-time decisioning, and operational analytics use cases, and how they drive value for customer-facing and internal applications.
  • Exposure to AI-native and agent-driven applications that depend on low-latency, highly scalable operational data services.
  • Prior experience in a high-growth, category-creating environment, helping shape new plays, messaging, and customer narratives.
  • Experience collaborating with partners and ISVs to drive joint pipeline and co-sell motions.

This description is intended to outline the core responsibilities and qualifications for the Lakebase Sales Specialist role. Actual responsibilities may evolve as the Lakebase product and go-to-market motions continue to grow and mature.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Lead Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Platform Engineering is the centralised team that builds, provisions and runs the infrastructure every other engineering team at Allica depends on. Whether a product serves a business banking customer or a colleague inside the bank, it lands on a platform this team designed. The team owns both halves of that, building the platform and running it, against the availability and resilience standards a regulated bank is held to. Well-architected is the operating standard, not an aspiration: reliability, security, cost and operational excellence are design inputs from the start.

The job is to make the right thing the easy thing, through paved roads, self-service provisioning, sensible defaults, and controls encoded in the platform rather than bolted on afterwards. Every control the platform enforces is one a product team does not have to think about, and one we can evidence on demand. Role Description The Lead Platform Engineer is the senior technical leader for a core domain of Allica's platform. You set its technical direction, you are accountable for how it behaves in production, and you build it yourself.

This is a hands-on role. Expect to spend a real share of your week in infrastructure as code, pipelines and live systems, and the rest setting standards, reviewing designs and making the calls that are too consequential to delegate. Your customers are internal. Product engineering and data engineering choose whether to use what you build, so adoption and the friction you remove are the measures that matter.

Principal Accountabilities

Platform Architecture and Engineering

  • Own the architecture of Allica’s Cloud platform: landing zones, subscriptions and network topology, container runtime, and the integration and resilience patterns that sit on top. Design again Cloud Adoption Framework and Well-Architected Framework as working disciplines. 

  • Build the reusable core: Terraform modules, deployment templates and platform services that let a team stand up production-grade infrastructure without reinventing the security, networking and observability plumbing each time.

    Infrastructure as Code and Automation 

  • Deliver and manage all infrastructure through Terraform and secure CI/CD, so that every change is automated, repeatable, version-controlled, tested, and reversible. Drive manual change and configuration drift towards zero. 

  • Set and evolve engineering standards for the function: code quality, peer review, policy as code and, release management.

    Security, Governance, and Compliance 

  • Embed security, governance, and compliance throughout the platform lifecycle, implementing effective policies, access controls, encryption, vulnerability management, monitoring, and configuration standards. 

  • Collaborate with Allica’s Security, Engineering, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure platforms meet organisational, regulatory, and control requirements, supported by clear documentation and auditable evidence. 

  • Identify and manage architectural risks, security vulnerabilities, control gaps, and technical debt, ensuring remediation actions are prioritised, tracked, and completed.

    Platform Operations and Service Ownership 

  • Own availability, reliability, and run cost for the platform, backed by service objectives, monitoring you can operate from, and tested recovery arrangements.

  • Lead the response to complex incidents, own the root-cause analysis, drive out repeat causes rather than repeat fixes. 

  • Use service data, operational experience, and FinOps practices to continuously improve platform automation, resilience, engineering standards, cost visibility, forecasting, and resource optimisation.

    Team Leadership 

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of platform engineers while remaining personally hands-on in architecture, design reviews, and the hardest technical problems. 

  • Set the technical bar and raise it, through coaching, design review and the example of your own work.

    Personal Attributes & Experience 

  • A strong track record architecting, and running production Azure environments at scale.

  • Fluent in landing zone and subscription design, private networking, containerised compute, API management and resilience patterns across zones and regions.

  • Line Management Experience

  • Extensive hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure at scale, infrastructure as code, containerised runtimes, identity and observability. 

  • Has carried production accountability for systems that matter. Comfortable in handling incidents. 

  • Treats developer experience as a product.

  • Talks to engineering teams, watches how they actually work and designs for adoption rather than mandate. 

  • Treats regulatory and security requirements as engineering constraints to design around, not obstacles to route past.

  • Prior regulated or high-assurance experience helps but is not a prerequisite. 

  • Gets adoption by building things engineers want to use and by making a clear case, not by escalation. 

  • Prefers the boring, well-understood solution unless the problem genuinely demands otherwise. Willing to remove things.

    Desirable Experience 

  • Architecture or engineering experience with Google Cloud Platform. 

  • Experience working in complex, regulated, or security-sensitive environments.

  • Knowledge of Kubernetes, container platforms, serverless services, and cloud-native application patterns. 

  • Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable CI/CD technologies.  Familiarity with FinOps, operational resilience, regulatory compliance, and cloud-control frameworks.  Relevant Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Terraform, security, or architecture certifications.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

Don’t tick every box?

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Lead Software Engineer, Integrations (TypeScript)
descriptionHtml:
Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

Vocca in a few words

Vocca is an AI voice agent that answers 100% of the calls of medical centres. The patient calls, the AI books the appointment or answers the question, and the medical secretaries keep their time for the cases where a human is really needed.

  • $20M raised, with the founders of Alan and Datadog as investors

  • Close to 1 million calls a month going through the platform

  • Opening the US market

The problem

Every medical practice runs on software that holds its calendar and its patients. There are dozens of different ones. Most were built twenty years ago and some have no API at all. To book an appointment during a call, our AI agent has to read and write in that software in real time, while the patient waits on the line. On several of these systems, Vocca is the only integrator in the world.

This is the work with the most direct impact on the business. A clinic whose software is connected to our agent does not switch. Retention, pricing power, our lead over competitors: it all depends on these integrations. Every software we cannot connect is a clinic we cannot sign.

The next step is writing back. Today the agent reads and books. Tomorrow it updates records in EHR, PMS and RIS systems, which raises the reliability bar a lot. In the US, we are opening the dental software ecosystem, with the compliance work that comes with it (HIPAA, SOC2).

There is no product manager on this scope. You would be the one deciding.

What you will own

  • The architecture of our booking layer. Today it is code written provider by provider, under pressure, partly in Python. It is becoming one unified layer in TypeScript that handles the rules of each medical centre, where adding a new software takes days, not weeks.

  • Speed and reliability at close to 1M calls a month. A call to a clinic software can take several seconds, and the patient cannot wait. You decide how we detect a booking failure in a clinic within 24 hours and what a healthy integration looks like.

  • The roadmap of your scope. You decide which software we connect first, with the sales, ops and support teams and the clinics themselves, and you prove it worked with a number: bookings that go through, failures caught, clinics signed.

  • The relationship with the software vendors, in France and in the US. The hard integrations are the ones nobody else wants to do. They are what makes Vocca hard to replace.

  • The team. You define how this scope works (reviews, documentation, technical decisions), you take part in hiring the next engineers and you help them ship in their first week.

How we build

  • Experimental, not R&D. You test, you prove with data, you ship. Challenging a decision means coming back with a result, not a debate.

  • Ship, then fix the last 1%. We ship the version that works, then fix the last 1% when it shows up. With AI, this trade off is much cheaper than before. The judgment about what not to touch is yours.

  • AI, seriously. Agents in every workflow, Claude Max provided. A migration estimated at 3 months was done in 2 weeks.

  • Close to the field. You talk every day with the ops team that deploys clinics, the support team that hears when something breaks and, when it matters, the clinics and the software vendors themselves.

Stack

TypeScript everywhere (Node, monorepo), PostgreSQL, REST and SOAP APIs from software vendors. We are migrating our last Python services to TypeScript over the coming months.

Who does well here

  • 6 to 10 years building products in production, mostly in startups that were growing fast, with at least one place where you stayed long enough to see your system live in the long run.

  • You have built something that mattered: an early engineer at a startup that took off, a system you launched that real users depended on. You can tell us who it was for, what problem it solved and which number moved.

  • You have integrated systems you did not control and you know the difference between a clean API and the real world.

  • Strong in TypeScript and Node, comfortable across the stack.

  • You think about the product and the business as much as the code. You can say no, reduce the scope and explain a technical decision to a founder in two minutes.
