title: Senior Customer Success Manager (German-speaking)
descriptionHtml:
Are you a German-speaking Customer Success professional with a passion for learning and technology? Do you thrive on building strong customer relationships, spotting opportunities for growth, and helping customers succeed? Then the Senior Customer Success Manager role at Kahoot! might be just the right fit for you. Come join us in making learning awesome!

The Role

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you will play a key role in helping medium to large enterprise customers succeed and getting the most out of our products. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will help customers achieve tangible business results with our products while identifying opportunities to strengthen relationships, drive retention, and grow accounts.

You will be part of our International Customer Success team, working with customers across one or more products in the Kahoot! Group's portfolio.

Fluency in German is essential for this role, as you will work closely with customers in DACH.

This role can be based in Copenhagen, Denmark; Oslo, Norway; or work remotely in Germany. You will report to the regional Manager, Customer Success.

Responsibilities

Portfolio Ownership and Customer Outcomes

  • Own a portfolio of mid-sized to large Enterprise customers and drive measurable progress towards their business objectives.
  • Manage the full customer lifecycle: handover from Sales, onboarding, adoption, value realisation, business reviews (QBRs/EBRs) and renewals (in collaboration with Account Management, where applicable).
  • Build and maintain success plans and account plans with clear, customer-agreed success metrics and ROI.

Strategic and Commercial Impact

  • Use strong business acumen and our MEDDIC-based methodology to run discovery, uncover customer pain points and their business impact, and map stakeholders, champions and decision-making processes.
  • Build multi-threaded relationships, including at executive-sponsor level.
  • Own or support renewals and retention targets (GRR/NRR), forecast renewals accurately, and identify expansion opportunities in partnership with Account Managers and Account Executives.

Risk and Health Management

  • Monitor customer health and product usage data to spot risks early, and lead mitigation and retention plans.
  • Act as the customer’s escalation point, coordinating with Support, Product and leadership to resolve critical issues.
  • Analyse customer churn and losses, and share key learnings.

Scaling and Enablement

  • Partner with Customer Education to deliver one-to-many programmes, including webinars, live training and help center content.
  • Support Sales and Events as a product expert and trusted advisor during customer calls and events.

Voice of the Customer and Advocacy

  • Bring structured customer feedback to Product, Sales and Customer Experience to shape our products and services.
  • Develop customer advocates through references, case studies and community engagement.

Leadership and operational excellence

  • Mentor and coach less experienced colleagues alongside your manager.
  • Help develop CS playbooks, processes and best practices.
  • Keep CRM data, account plans and forecasts accurate and up to date.

Requirements

  • Fluency in German and English, written and spoken.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Consulting, Sales, or from other similar roles.
  • Proven track record of managing a portfolio of medium to large enterprise customers, delivering measurable customer value, and driving retention and account growth.
  • Commercially minded, with a strong ability to build lasting customer relationships and identify opportunities for growth.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels.
  • A proactive, ambitious, and results-driven approach, with the ability to thrive in a fast-growing environment.
  • A collaborative team player who works well in an international, distributed environment.
  • Experience in SaaS and having industry domain knowledge are a plus.
  • Familiarity with the MEDDICC methodology is a plus.

Benefits

  • A competitive compensation package
  • Buddy program
  • Being part of a vibrant, diverse and passionate team
  • Social and company events

About Kahoot!
The Kahoot! Group is on a mission to make learning awesome! We want to empower everyone, including children, students, and employees to unlock their full learning potential. Our Kahoot! learning platform makes it easy for any individual or corporation to create, share, and host learning sessions that drive compelling engagement.

Since launching in 2013, Kahoot! has become a global leader, hosting hundreds of millions of sessions with over 12 billion cumulative participants across 200+ countries and regions. The Kahoot! Group includes Clever, the top US K-12 EdTech platform, and popular learning apps like DragonBox, Poio, Drops, Actimo and Motimate. Headquartered in Oslo, Norway, we also have offices in the US, UK, France, Finland, Australia, Singapore, Japan, Estonia, Denmark, Spain, and Poland. Let’s play!

Our K!rew

At the Kahoot! Group we champion a positive culture of collaborative learning and innovation. With a global team of more than 600 employees representing over 50 different nationalities, we’re a diverse and fun bunch of people! We work hard and celebrate our wins, tackle challenges with original ideas and learn something new every day.

We are driven by our mission and guided by our values: playful, curious and inclusive.

If you talk to anyone working in the Kahoot! Group, they will tell you that one of the greatest perks is being able to see how the work you do puts a smile on the face of kids, teachers and learners all around the world.

Does this sound like the right opportunity for you? We'd love to hear from you!

title: Senior Data Analyst, ML & Experimentation (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Architecting Intelligence to Optimize 200M+ Daily Decisions

As the intelligence core of our engineering organization, our Data Science team doesn't just deploy models, we engineer the fundamental decision engine that powers our platform. At a scale of 770 million users and 100,000+ predictions per second, we are solving a multi-objective optimization problem that balances user incentives, advertiser ROI, and long-term platform health in real time.

Our architecture is built on a 1PB+ behavioral data lake, providing the high-fidelity input necessary to train deep learning models that predict individual user engagement with precision. We aren't just optimizing clicks, we are dynamically calculating optimal reward structures to sustain a global value exchange.

Engineered for performance, our stack leverages PyTorch for model training, NVIDIA Triton to achieve sub-100ms inference. We own the full ML lifecycle from high-level research and feature engineering to deployment and A/B experimentation. Here, you will find the autonomy, the data depth, and the massive scale required to solve the most complex optimization challenges in the adtech ecosystem.

The data infrastructure behind this runs at real scale: 2TB ingested in real time every day, 100+ Airflow jobs and data pipelines, and ML models handling p99 latency of 100ms across 100,000+ predictions per second.

What you will do:

  • Analyze and evaluate the performance of our machine learning models using user-level and aggregated data, identify inefficiencies and failure patterns, and turn findings into actionable recommendations for our Data Science teams.

  • Define and improve metrics for measuring ML model performance and business impact, working closely with Data Scientists and Product Managers to ensure we optimize for the right outcomes.

  • Design, prepare and analyze A/B tests and other experiments to measure the impact of new models, features and algorithmic changes. Assess statistical significance, experiment quality and practical business impact.

  • Act as a strategic analytical partner to Product, Data Science, and Business leads. You proactively translate ambiguous business challenges into analytical roadmaps and turn complex ML insights into clear recommendations that shape product strategy.

  • Challenge product and technical decisions with data, bringing an independent analytical perspective to model development, experimentation and product strategy.

  • Drive analytical projects with end-to-end ownership: from initial scoping and hypothesis generation to stakeholder alignment and post-decision impact. Establish reusable frameworks and best practices that raise the bar for how we use data across teams.

  • Mentor and guide other analysts on the team, fostering a culture of high analytical standards, strong business intuition, and effective communication.

Who you are:

  • You have a degree in mathematics, statistics, physics, computer science, economics, analytics, or a similar quantitative field.

  • You have 5+ years of relevant experience in Data Analytics, Product Analytics, Experimentation, or Data Science, with a proven track record of delivering measurable business impact and working closely with senior cross-functional stakeholders.. Experience in AdTech, mobile apps or ML-driven products is a strong plus.

  • You’re proficient in SQL and comfortable working with large datasets.

  • You have strong Python skills and are comfortable using them for data analysis and statistical modelling.

  • You have a solid understanding of statistics and experimentation, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, statistical significance and A/B test analysis.

  • You have an understanding of machine learning concepts and model evaluation and are comfortable working with Data Scientists. You don't necessarily need to build ML models yourself, but you should understand how to assess their performance and limitations.

  • You have excellent data visualization skills and experience building dashboards using tools such as QuickSight, Power BI, Tableau, Streamlit or similar.

  • You can articulate complex algorithmic and behavioral insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders, align differing viewpoints, and comfortably present recommendations to leadership.

  • You thrive with ambiguity and have a high degree of ownership. You proactively identify high-value opportunities instead of waiting for tasks to be assigned, and you take pride in seeing initiatives through to real-world outcomes.

We support every ambition—from learning German to a relocation bonus that helps you settle in and make Hamburg feel like home.

Enjoy 30 vacation days, 3 weeks of remote work per year, and free access to an in-house gym with lots of different fitness classes and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

descriptionHtml:

About the Role

At NinjaOne, we're looking for a skilled Senior Data Engineer to join our Emerging Products team and help build the foundation of our modern data platform. You'll play a critical role in designing and scaling lakehouse architectures, building robust streaming and batch pipelines, and ensuring data flows reliably to the analysts and data scientists who depend on it. This is an exciting opportunity to work on greenfield infrastructure using a cutting-edge stack — Kafka, Spark, Iceberg, and Databricks — collaborate with cross-functional teams, and help shape how we harness data to power our next generation of products.

title: Senior Data Scientist - Experimentation
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Data Science organisation sits at the heart of Deliveroo powering decision-making across our 3 sided marketplace.

Our Analytics community is highly active, with guest lecturers, study groups, mentorship programmes and a robust technical review process.

Our data scientists come from all kinds of backgrounds but have excellence in common.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our London team (working hybrid, 3 days in the office). In this role, you’ll enable high-quality human-led decision-making to maximise impact.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Senior Data Scientist at Deliveroo, your goal is to maximise business impact within one of our product areas. A core part of the role is designing, running and interpreting experiments, and using causal inference to guide product decisions in complex, real-world settings.

You will go beyond simply answering “did this feature work?” and instead focus on understanding what the true impact is, why it worked or did not work, and how results generalise across users, markets and time.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Driving Strategy/insights through Experimentation: Leading the design of both simple and complex experiments and proactively translating findings into strategic direction.

  • Master Causal Inference: Apply advanced techniques to estimate long-term and heterogeneous treatment effects.

  • Drawing reliable conclusions in settings with selection bias or imperfect randomisation.

  • Drive Deep Product Insights: Uncover the fundamental drivers of experiment performance, determining why features succeed and how results generalise across different users, markets, and timeframes.

  • Using insights from past experiments to improve future decision-making.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

  • Strong experience designing, running and interpreting A/B experiments in production environments

  • Solid understanding of causal inference concepts

  • Ability to apply statistical thinking to messy, real-world product problems, not just ideal experimental setups

  • Great communication skills in person, in writing and in code, with both technical and non-technical audiences

  • A problem solver with a deep analytical mindset

  • Ability to think creatively and insightfully about business problems

  • Familiarity with SQL

  • Excellent people skills as you will be meeting with stakeholders to translate business needs into data science problems

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

​​💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

About the Role

As a Senior DevOps Engineer at Ledgy, you'll build the infrastructure and tooling that help our engineers ship quickly and reliably. You'll join our Platform team, collaborating with engineers and InfoSec to improve CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure for a product that helps companies manage equity.

Our challenge is to make delivery faster, production easier to operate, and AI-assisted development safer - while keeping complexity and costs in check.

Location: We hire remotely across Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania.

The team you'll join: Platform - Builds the infrastructure and tooling that help our engineers ship quickly and reliably, working with InfoSec to improve CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure.

What You'll Work On

  • Cloud infrastructure. Evolve our GCP and Kubernetes cloud architecture and setup with Terraform, improving reliability, simplicity, and cost visibility and enabling scaling to multiple availability regions.
  • CI/CD and developer experience. Speed up feedback loops, reduce flaky builds, and turn recurring support requests into self-service tooling.
  • Observability. Reduce alert noise, define meaningful SLOs, and make production issues easier to diagnose.
  • Security and automation. Partner with InfoSec on secure delivery, access controls, and guardrails for AI-assisted workflows.

You'll also join our incident-response on-call rotation during working hours and help prevent recurring issues. As we expand our servicing of public companies and jurisdictions, this on-call might evolve to compensated 24h/7 hour rotation.

You'll Thrive in This Role If You

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. These are the things that would make you an especially good fit.

  • Have strong DevOps / SRE background designing and operating cloud infrastructure and production systems
  • Have worked with Kubernetes and infrastructure as code, ideally GCP and Terraform
  • Enjoy building fast, reliable CI/CD pipelines and improving developer experience
  • Can diagnose issues across networking, infrastructure, and application code
  • Write maintainable code and bring a practical approach to observability and security
  • Value collaboration, mentorship, and thoughtful trade-offs between reliability, complexity, and cost
  • Are curious about supporting AI-assisted development safely - no AI specialism required

Experience with Node.js, MongoDB or Temporal is a plus.

Our Tech Stack

We work in TypeScript: React, Tailwind CSS, and tRPC on the front end, and tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, and Temporal on the back end. Infrastructure runs on GCP, Terraform Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, and GitHub Actions. For observability and incident response we use Grafana, Sentry, and PagerDuty.

You don't need to know all of it. We don't expect proficiency in every part of this stack. Strong infrastructure fundamentals and the ability to learn matter more than knowing every tool already.

What Your Journey Could Look Like

First 30 days:

  • Get to know Ledgy, the Platform team, and our internal users with an onboarding buddy
  • Explore our infrastructure and delivery workflows, and ship your first improvement
  • Analyze current state of our cloud infrastructure and propose meaningful enhancements

First 3 months:

  • Independently deliver improvements to CI/CD, observability, or infrastructure design
  • Share operational ownership and help reduce recurring friction for engineers
  • Contribute to architecture discussions and document what others need to operate our systems

First 6-12 months:

  • Own DevOps and SRE function and DevOps initiatives from problem definition through rollout and adoption
  • Deliver measurable improvements to developer experience, reliability, or cost
  • Help shape our platform's direction and mentor other engineers

The interview process

  • Getting to know you (45 min): Meet with someone from our people team to talk about your experience and to ask questions about the role
  • Live Coding (60 min): An equity domain problem to solve collaboratively using your preferred language and IDE. We want to see how you think, so this step does not allow AI. But you can freely look up syntax questions if you need to.
  • System Design (60 min): A system design session where you will design an architecture for a problem from the Ledgy domain using a visual tool of your choice
  • DDSA (45 min): A Deep Dive into real System Architecture that you have built, owned and monitored.
  • Culture Interview: A chance to meet one of our founders and your hiring manager for a 30-minute chat about Ledgy's mission and values
  • Offer 🎉

Being part of Ledgy means

  • Recharge and re-energize with flexible working hours, 25 days of vacation, and up to 40 days of remote work from outside your home country.
  • We make space for your own professional development, with a generous yearly learning & development budget.
  • This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. All salaries are aligned with competitively benchmarked ranges based on work location and levelling.

title: Senior Director, AI Creative Operations
descriptionHtml:
At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

The Senior Director for AI Creative Operations (UK/EMEA) will lead the practical evolution of AI-powered creative operations across the region, working across Strategy, Creative, Production, Delivery, Product and Commercial teams to redesign workflows and operating models around the opportunities AI and agentic technology create.

This requires a deep understanding of how creative design and production work end to end, from briefing and creative development through to production, adaptation, localisation and delivery. The role will identify where processes can be simplified, automated, connected or reconfigured through Pencil and agentic workflows, while protecting creative quality and commercial effectiveness.

Crucially, this is not about imposing a single production model across every client. It is about understanding different client requirements, systems, processes and ways of working, then designing the right combination of people, technology and workflows to deliver effectively within each environment.

The role will turn these opportunities into practical, repeatable and commercially effective solutions, working with regional delivery teams and the wider Global Production Capability to validate approaches, embed new ways of working and scale proven models across clients and markets.

 

Your primary responsibilities will include:

 

AI Delivery Excellence

  • Lead the development of scalable AI creative workflows, operating models and delivery standards across Jellyfish.

  • Optimise end-to-end workflows, identifying friction, duplication and manual processes that limit speed, quality or scalability. Driving connection and coordination cross Pencil to ensure we are aligned on a connected product roadmap and creative excellence in our delivery.

  • Establish best practices for AI-powered creative origination, design, production, adaptation, versioning and localisation.

  • Validate workflows in real client environments, ensuring solutions perform as promised before wider rollout.

  • Embed appropriate AI governance, quality assurance, risk management and client compliance standards.

Commercial Optimisation

  • Identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency, reduce operational overhead and increase margin through AI.

  • Analyse workflows to understand where time, cost and resource are being spent, translating findings into actionable improvements.

  • Measure the impact of AI adoption on productivity, delivery performance, profitability and client value.

  • Build scalable delivery models that enable Jellyfish to increase output and capability without simply increasing resource.

  • Ensure AI-enabled efficiencies translate into tangible commercial benefits rather than additional operational complexity.

title: Senior Director, Head of Quality & Responsible Person, International
descriptionHtml:
Mavericks Wanted 

When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on 
  
In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible.  
  
Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work. 

What You’ll Do

The Sr Director, Head of Quality & Responsible Person, International, leads quality for infigratinib, and will be the designated Responsible Person on the entity's wholesale distribution authorisation. The role reports to the Head of Quality, QED, with a dotted line to local managing director, and is based in the Netherlands. If the entity becomes the marketing authorisation holder for infigratinib, the role also covers the related MAH quality duties. The role holds an unrestricted right of escalation to the entity's full board and is independent of commercial operations and of manufacturing/supply with EU-GDP guidelines, relevant EU directives (including the Falsified Medicines Directive), Dutch Medicines Act, and public service requirements. This role acts as a QA liaison of BridgeBio's contract service providers (CSPs), providing oversight of lot release activities. This role includes reviewing and approving batch records, certificates of analysis, and compliance documents, providing quality review of deviations, change controls, and CAPAs related to assigned CSPs, collaborating closely with CSPs and internal teams such as quality control, manufacturing, regulatory affairs, and supply chain. The role builds and leads a small quality team (deputy RP, QA compliance/QMS, QA operations/GDP), owns the quality management system across the Skeletal Dysplasia assets, and leads WDA licensing, inspection readiness and potentially subsequent MIA readiness, if needed in the future.

Responsibilities

Major Responsibilities / Accountabilities

  • Serve as the named Responsible Person on the WDA: release for distribution, recall decisions, and GDP compliance of the entity
  • Leads and develops the entity's quality team: deputy RP, QA compliance/QMS, and QA operations/GDP; and QP
  • Manages and improves the Quality Management System (QMS) across the entity's assets in alignment with the established QMS
  • Lead the WDA application and IGJ inspection readiness; prepare subsequent MIA readiness (QP recruitment, import and batch-certification processes)
  • Own the quality agreement matrix: includes Quality oversight of contract service providers, 3PLs, distributors and intercompany interfaces
  • Act as a Quality liaison and provide oversight and quality support of assigned contract service providers
  • Perform quality review of assigned quality events such as deviations, change controls, supplier notifications
  • Review master manufacturing batch records, including related documents such as specifications, analytical and microbiological methods, stability study protocols, and label proofs
  • Manage lot release activities and communication of lot release schedules to key stakeholders
  • Communicate manufacturing deficiencies/non-conformances to management and work with CSPs to ensure timely resolution
  • Review process and method validation protocols and reports
  • Review analytical test results to ensure compliance with approved specifications
  • Assist in updating CMC sections of regulatory and quality documents
  • Participate in internal and external project team meetings

Other QA/Responsible Person related responsibilities

  • Ensure accuracy of quality of records per GDP requirements including GDPs are implemented and maintained in the quality management system requirements for WDA license
  • Support and coordinate return, rejected, falsified products, recall operations of medicinal products
  • Provide oversight of GDP and GMP activities of active pharmaceutical ingredients (API)
  • Ensure WDA and API registration is current with commercial supply chain
  • Participate and leads EU/ROW regulatory inspections
  • Participate and oversee GMP vendor qualification program
  • Oversee the EU/ROW internal audit program, internal training program and ensure data integrity
  • Write and review governing procedures as needed (e.g., SOPs, WIs, etc.)
  • Other duties as assigned

Where You’ll Work 

  • This is a Netherlands based remote role
  • Travel 30% of time is expected

Who you are

  • BS/MS degree preferably in operations, science, pharmacy
  • A diploma, certificate, or other evidence of formal qualifications on completion of GDP/GDP-API training required for registration as an RP by the competent authorities in the Netherlands
  • 10+ years in pharmaceutical quality, including significant GDP / distribution quality experience; prior appointment as (or eligibility to be) a Responsible Person strongly preferred
  • Experience leading regulatory inspections with EU competent authorities (IGJ preferred)
  • Prior experience of managing third party vendors (CMOs, CTLs, 3PLs, etc.)
  • Prior relevant knowledge and experience related to the distribution of medical products
  • Strong understanding of supply chain concepts, supplier management, inventory management
  • Extensive knowledge of US/EU GMPs /GDPs and associated guidance
  • Working in a highly regulated environment
  • Proven leadership of quality teams; experience building quality functions or systems
  • Understanding the EU and particularly IGJ regulations in relation to the wholesale distribution of medicines
  • Strong planning and time management skills with ability to prioritize workload
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail
  • Proficiency in document and presentation office tools (Microsoft Office, Google Docs, etc.)
  • Basic understanding of data concepts and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems e.g., SAP
  • Ready to embrace company core values and diverse corporate culture

Rewarding Those Who Make the Mission Possible

We have high expectations for our team members. We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return.

  • Market leading compensation
  • Hybrid work model - we value your flexibility in how you work, but encourage time in the office to strengthen our culture, collaboration, and sense of community
  • We provide career development through regular feedback, continuous education and professional development programs
  • We celebrate strong performance with financial rewards, peer-to-peer recognition, and growth opportunities.

As a global company, our comprehensive benefits may vary based on location.  We have high expectations for our team members. We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return.

For BridgeBio Full-Time U.S Based Roles:

Financial & Rewards  

  • Market-leading compensation   
  • 401(k) with employer match   
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions, plus Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)  
  • Fertility & family-forming benefits  
  •  Expanded mental health support (therapy and coaching resources)  
  • Hybrid work model with flexibility  
  • Flexible, “take-what-you-need” paid time off and company-paid holidays

Skill Development & Career Paths:

title: Senior Director Sales Strategy & Operations (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Help shape how AutoScout24 Group sells, serves its customers and drives commercial performance across international markets. 

Reporting to the CEO of Europe, you will lead around 20 colleagues across Commercial Program Management, Revenue Operations & CRM, and Sales Analytics. You will shape our commercial operating model, transform dealer interactions through AI and deliver strategic programs across functions and markets. Working through experienced team leads and closely collaborating with Country Managers, you will combine strategic thinking with people leadership and responsibility for ongoing operations. Your core remit is European, with global stakeholder interfaces. The team is predominantly based in Munich, making regular presence there important. 

What You Will Do 

  • Shape our commercial operating model: Improve sales, customer care, customer success and market steering. Partner with local leaders to define shared ways of working, meaningful KPIs and reporting that support commercial decisions across markets. 
  • Transform dealer interactions across sales and customer care with AI: Work with commercial, Product, Engineering and AI teams to identify valuable opportunities, guide experimentation and drive adoption of solutions that improve productivity, customer experience and commercial performance. 
  • Drive strategic projects and commercial programs: Turn complex challenges into clear programs with priorities, owners and success measures. Lead multidisciplinary initiatives across markets, connecting actions and operational inputs to commercial outcomes and staying accountable through implementation and adoption. 
  • Lead and develop your team leaders: Coach managers, develop talent and set clear priorities across a broad remit. Give specialist leaders direction and support while holding them accountable for delivery. 
  • Turn new products into commercial success: Lead commercial go-to-market planning and execution with Sales, Product, Product Marketing and Marketing, from preparation through launch and post-launch performance. 
  • Guide Revenue Operations and CRM: Set the agenda for Salesforce and the sales, customer care and billing processes it supports. Partner with specialist teams and Engineering to improve processes while keeping ongoing operations running reliably. 
  • Make data a stronger driver of decisions: Guide revenue and customer analytics, data governance and reliable data products. Help teams use dashboards and insights to understand performance and decide where to act. 
  • Build alignment across functions and markets: Understand local realities, challenge constructively and influence without direct authority. Communicate recommendations, progress and results clearly to senior management and shareholders. 

What You Bring 

  • Strong conceptual and analytical thinking: You structure ambiguous problems, use data to support decisions and identify the KPIs that matter. You combine this toolkit with sound commercial judgment, whether developed in management consulting or another demanding business environment. 
  • A track record of delivering complex projects: You have owned commercial programs or organisational change across functions and markets in an international matrix. You can show your personal contribution, how you secured adoption and the outcomes achieved. 
  • A solid understanding of commercial processes: You understand how initiatives and operational inputs drive customer and revenue outcomes. You are familiar with CRM and data-driven environments and can guide specialists in RevOps and analytics; deep technical expertise in Salesforce is not required. 
  • Experience managing managers: You have developed team leads, set priorities across competing demands and delivered through their teams. You bring the credibility to lead experienced specialists without needing to be the expert in every discipline. 
  • The ability to influence senior stakeholders: You build trust across functions and markets, understand local challenges and create commitment when priorities differ and colleagues do not report to you. 
  • Comfort with breadth and pace: You have worked in a complex, ambitious and fast-moving environment. You can switch between strategic programs, people leadership and ongoing operational responsibilities. Marketplace, classifieds or automotive experience can help, but is not essential. 
  • An interest in practical AI applications: You are motivated to improve sales and customer care through AI. Experience implementing AI solutions or leading related transformation is a plus. 
  • Excellent English communication and presentation skills: German and other European languages are helpful, but not required. 

What We Offer 

  • Benefits & flexibility: AutoScout24 offers benefits that allow our employees to work as freely and effectively as possible. We provide flexible office attendance and working hours, 30 days paid vacation and state-of-the-art, modern offices to name a few. Our goal is to support you in doing your best work. 
  • Diversity & inclusion: At AutoScout24 we appreciate different lifestyles and cultural backgrounds. We welcome diversity as a strength. We know that mixed teams work more successfully. Our organization is made up of more than 50+ different nationalities, all working together inclusively and respectfully. 

If this appeals to you, but you are in doubt about how exactly your skills match our requirements – we value personality, ambition, and an open mind. Don’t hesitate to get in touch and present your personal strengths to us.

title: Senior Embedded Linux Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
TYTAN Technologies

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Senior Embedded Linux Engineer to join the Core team within our Platform Team. You build and scale the embedded Linux platform our products run on and make it the common foundation for every new product, from bring-up to the field.

Your roadmap to make an impact

  • One platform: Build a shared base distribution with clean per-product and per-board layers, so new hardware gets secure boot, identity, updates and observability by configuration, not by fork

  • Product onboarding: Bring new hardware onto the platform together with the product teams: BSP integration, device tree, drivers and validation

  • Platform contract: Define boot flow, partition layout, system services and versioned platform releases that product teams build on

  • Chain of trust: Secure boot from ROM to userspace, verified root filesystems, measured boot and encrypted storage

  • Device identity: Hardware-backed keys, provisioning in production and enrollment into a PKI

  • Field updates: A/B or atomic image updates, signed and delta artifacts, automatic rollback, robust over intermittent links

  • Node integration: Provide the platform hooks the node agent builds on: boot and update state, hardware identity, health sources and logs

  • Supply chain: Reproducible builds, SBOM, CVE triage and a patch path that reaches the whole fleet

  • Hardware CI: Automated flashing, boot and integration tests across all supported boards for every change


  • Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • 6+ years of embedded Linux in production, including ownership of a BSP from bring-up to series production

  • Built and maintained a shared embedded Linux platform for several products or hardware families, consumed by other teams

  • Shipped a connected device fleet with field updates and device provisioning, and supported it after launch

  • Deep Yocto/OpenEmbedded including multi-machine and multi-product layer architectures (or equivalent depth in Buildroot or NixOS)

  • Embedded Linux on ARM and/or x86: device tree or ACPI, driver development and debugging across I2C, SPI, PCIe, USB, Ethernet and CAN

  • Boot stacks: U-Boot, UEFI, Arm Trusted Firmware, OP-TEE

  • Secure boot on ARM SoCs or UEFI Secure Boot, dm-verity, LUKS or fscrypt, TPM 2.0 tooling

  • Update frameworks such as RAUC, SWUpdate, Mender or OSTree

  • Expert C, good C++, Python and shell; debugging with JTAG, ftrace and perf

  • Reads schematics and datasheets, comfortable with oscilloscope and logic analyser

  • Thinks in platforms: designs for reuse across products, names the trade-offs, makes build versus buy decisions and designs for the day a deployed unit fails in the field

  • Fluent in English & Willingness to undergo a German security clearance

Nice to haves

  • Real-time Linux (PREEMPT_RT, CPU isolation) or AMP setups with Zephyr or FreeRTOS on companion cores

  • Heterogeneous SoCs from vendors such as NXP, TI, Qualcomm or Intel

  • Rugged COTS compute platforms

  • Container runtimes on embedded devices

  • Mainline kernel or U-Boot contributions

  • Product security frameworks such as IEC 62443 or the EU Cyber Resilience Act

  • Defense or aerospace products

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation

  • Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

At Stark, our embedded engineering team is responsible for bridging cutting-edge autonomy with resilient, real-world execution. We design and deliver the embedded control architecture, sensor integration, and secure communications backbones that keep our platforms connected, responsive, and safe.

YOUR MISSION

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Software Engineer with strong low-level C/C++ skills and practical experience integrating software, electronics, and communications in embedded control systems.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Assemble control hardware and configure firmware. Test with launchers and C2 systems
  • Design and improve control system hardware taking it from prototype system to hardened field ready and mass producible product
  • Manage software code base and move towards certifiable system
  • Produce custom PCBs and enclosures to better package control system and increase reliability
  • Produce documentation for system and produce build/operation manuals

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Strong low-level C/C++ development skills, proficiency in Python, and experience working with Linux.
  • Experience programming and configuring embedded microcontrollers, PLCs, and single-board computers such as Raspberry Pi.
  • Experience developing, integrating, and debugging drivers for hardware devices and peripherals.
  • Strong ability to read and interpret hardware schematics, and produce clear interface schematics and system diagrams.
  • Practical experience configuring network infrastructure, routers, and connected devices using Ethernet, TCP/IP, CAN bus, and UART.
  • Familiarity with MAVLink, PX4, drone flight controllers, and autonomous systems.
  • Experience with secure data streaming and encrypted communications over internet and satellite links, including Starlink.
  • Proficiency with hardware debugging equipment, including logic analysers and oscilloscopes.
  • Ability to troubleshoot issues across software, hardware, and communications interfaces.
  • Strong hands-on experience with ARM-based embedded platforms and low-level interfaces, particularly Ethernet, CAN bus, SPI, I2C, and UART.
  • Demonstrated experience writing, integrating, and validating low-level Ethernet and CAN drivers on ARM architectures.

  • Experience with custom PCB design, manufacturing, and board bring-up.

title: Senior Engineer - Athlete Performance
descriptionHtml:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We're hiring Senior Engineers to join one of our cross-functional product teams in our Athlete Performance group, which is focused on building cutting-edge solutions for athletes and sports teams that directly impact how they train, compete and achieve peak performance. In this role, you'll build hardware-agnostic ingestion layers and time-series architectures that fuse live video with biomechanical data streams, solving complex real-time data sync and ML inference challenges to give elite coaches and medical teams instant, objective insight into injury prevention and matchday tactics.

As a Senior Engineer, you'll:

  • Work with a cross-functional team. You'll collaborate with Engineering, Quality Assurance, Product, Design and Scrum disciplines to deliver full-stack web features. 
  • Develop and deliver. Your team has the autonomy to make a meaningful impact across the entire product area, listen to customers' needs and deliver game-changing features to push the boundaries of what they can achieve. Your team is empowered to take ownership of the user experience to support our coaches and athletes.
  • Test new ideas. At Hudl, we iterate rapidly, deploying changes to the product hundreds of times daily across our Engineering team. In addition to working on concrete features, you'll have the opportunity to propose solutions to more ambiguous technical problems and provide guidance to less experienced engineers.
  • Mentor. You'll share your expertise and educate others on development best practices and trade-offs, setting an example in planning, designing and delivering complex projects. 

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We're currently considering applicants within commuting distance of London. You'll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have  the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team. We're also open to remote candidates in the UK.

Must-Haves

  • Experienced. You have either led or played a key role in developing large-scale applications.
  • A team player. You understand that problem-solving is a team effort and will help others on our Engineering team learn and develop their skills.
  • User-focused. You're excited to have your work used by real people to solve real problems.
  • Willing to learn. You have solid engineering skills but are always willing to dive into specific areas to gain the expertise needed to be successful in your role.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Tech stack knowledge. Our core stack is C#/Node, React, TypeScript, MongoDB/SQL/ElasticSearch and AWS, so experience with these is ideal.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you'll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We're lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We'll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you're at the office or working remotely, we'll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.
  • Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you're located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.

Compensation

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices. 

This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Rivia

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

 

Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.

 

Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

 

About the Role

As Senior Infrastructure Engineer at Rivia, you own the AWS platform that everything runs on: EKS clusters, CI/CD, identity, costs, backups, internal tooling. You are our first dedicated infrastructure hire, embedded in the engineering team. The scope is broad: AWS cost analysis one day, a flaky CI runner or a Keycloak upgrade the next. You fix problems, then automate the cause so they stop coming back. We expect you to work AI-native: leveraging AI agents to elevate our ability to improve security, reduce costs, and resolve performance issues. You work that way by default and keep expanding what the agents can do for us.

 

What excites you

  • Full ownership: Owning the complete infrastructure of a company that moves clinical trial data for dozens of customers.

  • Fixing things for good: Working through a real backlog and removing root causes so the same problems stop coming back.

  • AI-native operations: Directing AI agents to do infrastructure work is already how you operate, and you want an environment that pushes it further.

  • Improving a live system: Making an existing platform cheaper, faster, and more reliable step by step, rather than rebuilding it from scratch.

  • Defining a function: Shaping what infrastructure at Rivia becomes as the company grows.

Responsibilities

  • Own our AWS platform end to end across staging and production: EKS, RDS, MemoryDB/Redis, S3, DynamoDB, IAM, networking.

  • Understand and reduce our infrastructure costs, from the Spark data pipeline to backups, and keep unit economics improving as customer volume grows.

  • Own CI/CD and developer productivity: faster pipelines, fewer flaky tests, better internal tooling.

  • Keep our Kubernetes workloads stable and scalable, including the services behind our AI features.

  • Run identity and secrets management: Keycloak, SSO, OIDC.

  • Build AI-agent workflows for infrastructure work, such as recurring audits of AWS for cost, security, and performance findings.

  • Support external penetration tests and provide infrastructure evidence for ISO 27001 and client audits.

  • Document core systems and runbooks so the platform does not depend on any single person.

 

What Excites us

  • Experience as the sole or first infrastructure owner at a startup.

  • 5+ years of hands-on infrastructure or DevOps experience with deep AWS expertise, including cost optimization work.

  • Production Kubernetes operations experience.

  • A proper software engineer: you write production-quality code and can diagnose and fix problems inside application codebases when needed (JVM experience a plus).

  • You have owned complex CI/CD end to end (GitHub Actions or equivalent).

  • An AI-native way of working: you use agents (Claude Code or similar) for real infrastructure work and can show concrete examples.

  • Comfortable being the only infrastructure specialist on the team: self-directed, you find and fix problems without being asked.

Bonus

  • Keycloak or similar identity provider operations (OIDC, SSO, secrets management).

  • Spark or large-scale data pipeline infrastructure experience.

  • Exposure to regulated environments (ISO 27001, audit support).

  • Datadog or a comparable observability stack.

Our Values

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team. If you are driven to exceed targets, eager to shape the future of clinical trials, and passionate about making a meaningful difference in the biotech industry, Rivia is the place for you.

  • In it to Win it: Approach every challenge with determination, resilience, and a drive, aiming for the best outcomes and solutions.

  • Embrace change: We see change as an opportunity for growth, innovation, and improvement, continuously evolving to stay one step ahead

  • Why not?: Asking why not, instead of why, allows us to show our curiosity, allowing us to challenge assumptions and explore new possibilities.

  • Find the gap: We are curious and we proactively approach identifying opportunities and solving problems before they arise.

  • Collective accountability: We are one team, on one mission and we are committed to shared responsibilities and mutual support, enabling trust and collaboration.

  • Value add solutions: Know better. Act better. We are dedicated to delivering meaningful and impactful results.

title: Senior Integrated Media Director
descriptionHtml:

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

The Integrated Media Senior Director is a senior leadership role accountable for the effective delivery, performance, and integration of all paid media activities across an assigned account or portfolio of accounts. The role is responsible for ensuring strategic alignment, investment effectiveness, operational excellence, and cross-channel collaboration across the client portfolio.

While channel specialists remain directly managed within their respective functions, they maintain a dotted-line relationship with the Integrated Media Senior Director to support client-centric accountability and integrated media delivery.

Leadership & Governance

  • Serve as the primary point of accountability for paid media delivery and performance across assigned accounts.

  • Translate client business objectives into integrated, cross-channel media strategies.

  • Establish clear performance goals, KPIs, and measurement frameworks to evaluate media effectiveness.

  • Drive operational excellence through consistent implementation of processes, infrastructure, workflows, pacing disciplines, and optimization routines.

  • Ensure alignment and coordination across all paid media functions to deliver a seamless client experience.

Strategic Investment & Planning

  • Partner with Strategy teams to define roles, responsibilities, and planning approaches based on client needs and organizational structure.

  • Lead cross-channel media planning and investment allocation to maximize business outcomes.

  • Collaborate with Client Teams to identify optimization opportunities and innovative media solutions.

  • Oversee forecasting, budget pacing, and performance reporting across assigned accounts.

  • Partner with Investment Analytics to improve the adoption and effectiveness of reporting and pacing solutions.

  • Champion the use of data, automation, and platform capabilities to maximize return on investment and efficiency.

Cross-Functional Integration

  • Facilitate cross-channel planning, learning, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

Client & Partner Leadership

  • Translate complex media performance data into actionable business recommendations.

  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve media effectiveness and client outcomes.

 

Success Measures

The success of the Integrated Media Senior Director will be evaluated against the following key performance indicators:

Performance Efficiency

  • Achieve or exceed client spend and performance targets.

  • Ensure budget pacing and optimization activities align with client objectives and agreed benchmarks.

  • Measured through quarterly and annual business reviews.

Client Satisfaction & Retention

  • Achieve a client Net Promoter Score (NPS) of 9 or higher within the first year.

  • Drive proactive performance insights and continuous improvement in client communications.

  • Assessed through semi-annual client feedback and satisfaction surveys.

Operational Excellence

  • Deliver media plans, forecasts, and pacing reports accurately and on schedule.

  • Maintain greater than 95% accuracy in forecasting and less than 2% variance against agreed projections.

  • Evaluated through monthly performance and delivery reviews.

Team Alignment & Capability Development

  • Facilitate quarterly cross-channel planning and learning sessions.

  • Lead monthly performance review discussions with relevant stakeholders.

Innovation & Growth Contribution

  • Develop and implement innovation initiatives, automation solutions, or process improvements that enhance client results or team efficiency.

  • Demonstrate measurable business impact within 12 months.

  • Reviewed as part of annual performance and goal-setting processes.

Reporting Structure

Reports To: Integrated Media VP

Direct-Line Relationships:

  • Search Directors

  • Social Directors

  • Programmatic Directors

  • Retail Media Directors

Key Stakeholders & Partnerships:

  • Client Leadership Teams

  • Strategy Teams

  • Project Management

  • Investment Analytics

  • Partnership Teams

  • Channel Leadership Teams

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

The ideal candidate has run a multi-country close, is fluent in the difference between a US GAAP reporting package and a local statutory filing, and would rather design the process than inherit it. Join us in our mission to disrupt the defense industry and elevate your career with a team dedicated to making a significant impact on a global scale.

  • Own the accounting workstream on new entity and country launches, partnering with Legal on incorporation and registration and with Business Operations on site readiness.

  • Partner with Tax, Treasury, and Payroll on VAT and local tax filings, transfer pricing support, intercompany settlement, cash forecasting, and payroll approvals across the region.
  • Support the configuration and ongoing maintenance of the region’s legal entities within the Company’s ERP, including any local statutory reporting basis.
  • Identify and execute opportunities for process improvement, including the adoption of automation and AI tools, so that the function scales faster than its headcount.
  • Partner with regional operational and program leaders to support business decision-making.
  • Work on ad-hoc projects with accounting and finance teams across the Company, from leases and fixed assets to inventory, intercompany, and tax provision support.

  • Excellent leadership, team management, and interpersonal skills, with a track record of hiring and developing accountants.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to keep multiple jurisdictions and workstreams on schedule.
  • Comfortable building process where little exists today, with a proven ability to manage competing priorities in a high growth organization.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a mindset for continuous improvement.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with colleagues across time zones.
  • Fluency in English; additional European languages a plus.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.

title: Senior Key Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense. Tu seras amené(e) à travailler plus particulièrement sur Vertical Expense, notre solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais qui accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leur transformation digitale.

Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…).

Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous renforçons l'équipe Sales de Vertical Expense. Tu y prendras en charge le développement de grands comptes publics et privés, sur des ventes complexes à forts enjeux.

Tu auras pour mission de :

  • Piloter le cycle de vente de bout en bout : qualification des opportunités, proposition de valeur différenciante, accès aux décideurs, négociation et closing.

  • Développer de nouvelles opportunités par une prospection ciblée, en complément des leads apportés par le Marketing et par nos équipes Alliances & Channel.

  • Analyser les besoins de tes prospects et présenter la solution, avec l'appui de l'avant-vente sur les projets complexes.

  • Rédiger les réponses aux appels d'offres publics et privés (dont le mémoire technique), en t'appuyant sur les équipes internes.

  • Assurer une passation fluide vers les équipes projets et CSM, et suivre les projets en appui après la signature.

  • Participer aux réflexions stratégiques : veille concurrentielle, tendances du marché, différenciateurs produit.


Ce qu'on va attendre de toi :

  • Tu as une expérience significative et récente en vente complexe SaaS B2B auprès de grands comptes.

  • Tu as déjà mené des cycles de vente longs, dans des organisations multi-décideurs, en travaillant avec des partenaires et des influenceurs.

  • Tu as un vrai goût pour la chasse : aller chercher de nouveaux clients te motive.

  • Tu es à l'aise face à des interlocuteurs C-level et tu sais adapter ton discours à chacun (idéalement DAF, DRH, Travel Manager, DSI…).

  • Tu sais répondre à un appel d'offres avec rigueur, de la réponse au mémoire technique.

  • Tu comprends les solutions SaaS, web et mobiles.

  • Tu es autonome, organisé(e) et tenace, et tu sais rebondir face à un deal perdu.

  • Tu aimes travailler en équipe avec le Marketing, l’équipe Alliance/Channel, les équipes projets et le Produit.

  • Tu es à l'aise avec des déplacements réguliers chez les clients (environ une fois par semaine).

C'est un plus si :

  • Tu connais l'univers des notes de frais ou du voyage d'affaires.

  • Tu parles anglais.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Un poste stratégique, au cœur de notre développement sur les grands comptes publics et privés.

  • Pas que de la prospection à froid : une partie des leads vient du Marketing et de nos partenaires.

  • Une vision complète du cycle de vente, jusqu'au suivi du projet client.

  • Une équipe stable, fière de ses grands comptes, avec le sens du service et de l'excellence.

  • Une ambiance où l'on ne se prend pas au sérieux : team building réguliers…

Processus de recrutement :

  • Entretien téléphonique RH.

  • Entretien avec le manager.

  • Mise en situation : étude de cas sur un compte client fictif.

  • Entretien final avec la Direction.

Localisation : Montagnat (01), avec 2 jours par semaine sur site et des déplacements ponctuels à Aix-en-Provence.

Rémunération : fixe : 60K € - 80K€ + variable

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Biologics
descriptionHtml:
About Boltz

Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible.

Boltz began as an MIT spin-out. Our founders built Boltz-1 at MIT, and it became the first fully open-source model to match AlphaFold 3's accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes.

We focus on two things:

  • Open foundation models. Boltz-1, Boltz-2, and BoltzGen are open models trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations.

  • Boltz Lab. Our commercial platform runs our latest models and design agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules, while we provide the compute, infrastructure, and collaboration layer so their scientists can move faster.

The two feed each other: open-source adoption earns scientific credibility and community insight, and Boltz Lab turns that into real impact on our partners' discovery programs.

You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our manifesto.

About the role

As a Machine Learning Engineer on Biologics, you will own the engineering that turns our protein and antibody design models into fast, low-cost, hands-off pipelines. A near-term goal is to halve the cost of our current protein design pipeline and have it run with no human intervention on most enterprise-relevant targets.

You will work closely with the Biologics team's research scientists and computational biologists, our Post-training team, Research Engineering, our Product and Platform engineers, and our pharma and biotech partners.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys making complex ML pipelines robust and efficient, and wants to see the antibodies, nanobodies and peptides they help design tested in the lab.

What you'll do

  • Productionize our protein design pipeline: cut cost and runtime, and remove the manual steps between generation, structure prediction, scoring and candidate selection.

  • Build training, fine-tuning and evaluation pipelines for our next antibody, nanobody and peptide design models.

  • Make design runs scale to large campaigns, with reliable, reproducible outputs and clear failure handling.

  • Run and adapt pipelines for partner pilots and customer projects, and take them into Boltz Lab with Product and Platform engineers.

  • Feed what you learn about performance and failure modes back to research scientists and the product team.

About you

Minimum Requirements

  • Senior or Staff-level experience building and shipping machine learning systems in production.

  • Strong Python and PyTorch, and experience with distributed or high-throughput ML workloads on GPUs.

  • Working knowledge of protein ML or biologics design (e.g. structure prediction, ProteinMPNN, RFdiffusion, BoltzGen), and comfort working with biologists.

  • A track record of taking models from research to production, with measurable gains in cost, speed or reliability.

  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: clean, tested, maintainable code and reproducible pipelines.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience on antibody, nanobody or peptide design programs, or with binding and developability data.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration, Kubernetes or cloud GPU infrastructure; early-stage startup experience.

  • Experience using Boltz models, or open-source contributions.

We know great people don't always tick every box. If this role excites you and you meet most of the minimum requirements, we'd like to hear from you.

What we offer

  • Build the pipelines that design biologics for leading discovery teams.

  • Work alongside one of the most talent-dense teams in the field.

  • Significant ownership and independence, with responsibility for driving projects from concept to deployment.

  • Highly competitive salary with meaningful equity in a public benefit company.

  • Benefits:

    • 25 days plus bank holidays a year

    • Annual team offsite trip

    • Private healthcare (BUPA), covering pre-existing conditions

    • Pension program

    • Paid parental leave

    • Wellhub gym membership

    • Free lunch every day

    • Travel expenses

How we hire

  1. Initial screen with a member of the Talent team

  2. Technical interview

  3. Onsite in London or virtual onsite with the team

  4. Offer + Onboarding

Our commitment

Boltz is committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, tell us at [email] and we'll make it work.

  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us.

We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.
