title: Senior Manager Energy Strategy & Portfolio Development (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über EUPD Research Sustainable Management GmbH

Seit dem Jahr 2000 entwickelt die EUPD Research Sustainable Management GmbH innovative und ganzheitliche Lösungen für Nachhaltigkeitsmärkte. Auf Basis von Primärdaten, Analysen, Zertifizierungen und Publikationen strukturiert und multipliziert das Team erfolgreiche Geschäftsstrategien in den Bereichen Photovoltaik, Energiespeicher, Wärmepumpen, Elektromobilität, ESG sowie Corporate Health.

Gestalte die Weiterentwicklung unseres Energy-Geschäfts – strategisch, datenbasiert und mit klarem Blick auf Portfolio, Markt und Umsetzung.

Du möchtest nicht nur einzelne Projekte begleiten, sondern mitgestalten, welche Themen, Produkte und Geschäftsfelder im Bereich erneuerbare Energien künftig relevant werden? Du kannst Markt-, Technologie- und Kundenentwicklungen einordnen, Prioritäten ableiten und unterschiedliche Fachperspektiven zu belastbaren Entscheidungen zusammenführen?

Dann werde Teil der EUPD Group und gestalte gemeinsam mit uns die nächste Entwicklungsphase unseres Energy-Portfolios.

Als Senior Manager Energy Strategy & Portfolio Development (m/w/d) verbindest Du Markt- und Technologieintelligenz, Research, Produktentwicklung und kommerzielle Anforderungen zu einem konsistenten Gesamtbild. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit den jeweiligen Fachverantwortlichen unser Portfolio weiter, bereitest strategische Entscheidungen vor und sorgst dafür, dass neue Ideen in realistische, wirtschaftlich tragfähige Angebote und Prioritäten übersetzt werden.

Deine Aufgaben

• Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Management die strategische Ausrichtung und das Portfolio des Energy-Bereichs weiter und übersetzt Markt-, Technologie- und Kundenentwicklungen in klare Prioritäten und Handlungsfelder.

• Du steuerst die Weiterentwicklung unseres Studien-, Daten-, Analyse-, Zertifizierungs- und Advisory-Portfolios und bewertest bestehende sowie neue Angebote hinsichtlich Marktbedarf, strategischem Fit, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Skalierungspotenzial.

• Du entwickelst neue daten- und researchbasierte Produkte und Beratungsansätze von der ersten Idee über Value Proposition und Business Case bis zur Pilotierung und strukturierten Übergabe in die operative Umsetzung.

• Du integrierst Inputs aus Market Intelligence, Technology & Product Intelligence, Research und Sales in belastbare Portfolio- und Managemententscheidungen.

• Du bereitest Priorisierungs-, Investitions-, Ressourcen- und Stop/Start-Entscheidungen datenbasiert vor und machst Auswirkungen auf Kapazität und Wirtschaftlichkeit transparent.

• Du unterstützt bei strategisch relevanten Kunden- und Partnergesprächen, insbesondere wenn komplexe Markt- oder Kundenbedarfe in neue Research-, Data- oder Advisory-Lösungen übersetzt werden müssen.

• Du entwickelst Governance, Entscheidungslogiken und Arbeitsweisen weiter, damit neue Initiativen mit klarer Verantwortung, realistischer Kapazität und messbarem Nutzen umgesetzt werden.

• Du nutzt digitale Tools, KI und Automatisierung aktiv für Marktbeobachtung, Portfolioanalyse, Entscheidungsunterstützung und die Entwicklung skalierbarer Arbeitsweisen.

Deine Qualifikationen

• Abgeschlossenes Studium, z. B. in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Energiewirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Sozialwissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.

• Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung in Strategie, Portfolio-/Produktmanagement, Consulting, Market Intelligence, Research oder Business Development – idealerweise im Energy-Umfeld.

• Gutes Verständnis der europäischen und internationalen Energiewende und idealerweise Erfahrung mit Photovoltaik, Energiespeichern, Wärmepumpen, Elektromobilität oder angrenzenden Märkten.

• Erfahrung in der Entwicklung oder Weiterentwicklung von Studien, Datenprodukten, Beratungsangeboten oder anderen erklärungsbedürftigen B2B-Lösungen.

• Sehr gutes wirtschaftliches Verständnis und die Fähigkeit, inhaltliche Chancen auch hinsichtlich Aufwand, Preislogik, Ressourcenbedarf und wirtschaftlichem Potenzial zu bewerten.

• Starke analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten sowie Sicherheit in Management-Präsentationen und Entscheidungsunterlagen.

• Erfahrung in der Steuerung erfahrener Expert:innen und cross-funktionaler Teams – auch ohne jede operative Ressource selbst disziplinarisch zu führen.

• Sehr hohe digitale Affinität; Du nutzt KI-Tools, Automatisierung und datenbasierte Analysewerkzeuge aktiv und kannst deren Nutzen und Grenzen kritisch bewerten.

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Deine Benefits

• Ein vielseitiges Aufgabenfeld mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum in einem dynamischen Zukunftsmarkt.

• Individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und gezielte Weiterbildung.

• Mögliche Zusatzleistungen wie z. B. Jobticket, Essensgutscheine oder eine monatliche Gutscheinkarte als steuerfreier Sachbezug, je nach individueller Vereinbarung.

• Betriebliche Altersvorsorge sowie eine ergänzende betriebliche Krankenversicherung nach den jeweils geltenden Regelungen.

• Team- und Afterwork-Events für ein starkes Miteinander.

Warum wir?

Weil Du bei uns nicht nur eine bestehende Roadmap verwaltest: Du gestaltest mit, welche Energy-Themen, Produkte und Geschäftsmodelle wir weiterentwickeln – und sorgst dafür, dass Ambition, Kundennutzen, Kapazität und Wirtschaftlichkeit zusammenpassen.

title: Senior Marketing Manager, Channel Sales
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Not every seller comes to Square directly. A growing number reach us through resellers who sell Square on our behalf, and through independent contractors who represent Square in their own communities. Together these two motions make up our channel sales function.

As Senior Marketing Manager, Channel Sales, you will own marketing for both motions worldwide. You will be the primary marketing point of contact for the global channel sales team, turning what they need into programmes that scale. Most of your time will go into building scalable solutions that equip every reseller and contractor to sell Square well. The rest will be spent working shoulder to shoulder with our highest-performing resellers on activity that grows both their business and ours.

You will partner closely with channel sales leadership, events, content and regional marketing teams.

You Will

  • Serve as the marketing point of contact for the global channel sales team, triaging incoming requests, prioritising them and shaping them into a coherent programme of work.
  • Build and run a scaled co-marketing hub that gives resellers and independent contractors the campaigns, content and guidance they need to sell Square in their own markets.
  • Partner directly with our top-performing resellers on demand generation campaigns that grow and convert their pipeline.
  • Equip both motions to sell effectively, including through content and events.
  • Work with our independent contractor and reseller network to extend Square's brand presence and build awareness / credibility in the communities they serve.
  • Review incentive programmes that reward the strongest-performing resellers and contractors, partnering with the cross-functional teams who deliver different components of the programme to ensure and report back on success against objectives.
  • Define how co-marketing funds work for this channel, setting out how funds are allocated, spent and measured.
  • Work with sales to define an effective recruitment programme for resellers and independent contractors.
  • Build a valued community that our resellers and independent contractors are proud to be a part of.
  • Measure and report on programme performance.

You Have

  • 8+ years of relevant marketing experience.
  • Direct experience marketing through a channel, reseller, distributor or independent sales model.
  • A strong background in B2B marketing, ideally within technology companies.
  • Experience building enablement and co-marketing programmes that partners adopt and use at scale.
  • Proven ability to own programmes end to end, from design through to execution and measurement.
  • Experience designing incentive or reward programmes in partnership with a sales team.
  • Experience working across international markets and with globally distributed teams.
  • Strong stakeholder, communication and project management skills.

Application Guidelines

Candidates may submit up to 9 active applications within a 60-day period. Reapplications to the same role are accepted 90 days after a previous application has been reviewed.

Use of AI in Our Hiring Process

We may use automated AI tools to evaluate job applications for efficiency and consistency. These tools comply with local regulations, including bias audits, and we handle all personal data in accordance with state and local privacy laws. 

Contact us here with hiring practice or data usage questions.

Every benefit we offer is designed with one goal: empowering you to do the best work of your career while building the life you want. Remote work, medical insurance, flexible time off, retirement savings plans, and modern family planning are just some of our offering. Check out our other benefits at Block.

Block, Inc. (NYSE: XYZ) builds technology to increase access to the global economy. Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people. Square makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers. Cash App is the easy way to spend, send, and store money. Afterpay is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time. TIDAL is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs. Bitkey is a simple self-custody wallet built for bitcoin. Proto is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services. Together, we’re helping build a financial system that is open to everyone.

title: Senior Mechanical Design Manager
descriptionHtml:
Senior Mechanical Design Manager

 

Location – London

 

Role Summary

 

As Senior Manager, Mechanical Design, you will be a senior mechanical technical authority within STACK Infrastructure's EMEA Design & Engineering function, helping define, govern and continuously improve the mechanical engineering standards that shape our European data centre platform.

You will own key elements of STACK’s cooling strategy, mechanical plant standards, thermal performance and energy efficiency approach, ensuring the European Reference Design is applied consistently across regions while remaining scalable, commercially optimised and ready for future customer requirements.

Working closely with Engineering, Design, Development, Delivery, Commercial, Construction, Commissioning and regional project teams, you will bring senior technical oversight, practical challenge and clear guidance to complex mission-critical data centre projects across EMEA.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Act as the senior mechanical technical authority for STACK EMEA, defining and maintaining the mechanical components of the European Reference Design and future iterations.

  • Own the mechanical cooling strategy and plant standards, including air-cooled solutions, chilled water systems, liquid cooling integration and hybrid deployment approaches.

  • Define modular mechanical building block principles that support scalability, phasing flexibility, resilience and STACK’s platform design philosophy.

  • Provide senior technical review at key RIBA stage gates, challenging consultant designs for compliance with standards, energy efficiency, constructability and operability.

  • Review and approve structured deviations from mechanical standards, ensuring design decisions are clearly governed, documented and aligned with platform objectives.

  • Support regional design and delivery teams with complex mechanical issues during design, PCSA, construction and commissioning phases.

  • Provide technical input into client specification reviews and support structured responses to changes in rack density, inlet temperatures, flow rates and other hyperscale requirements.

  • Monitor emerging cooling technologies, higher-density deployments and AI-driven load growth, helping define a future-ready roadmap for liquid cooling and next-generation mechanical systems.

  • Support sustainability and energy optimisation initiatives, including plant sizing, PUE performance, capacity planning and improvements that enhance MW yield and platform competitiveness.

  • Partner with commercial, development and investment teams to explain mechanical CapEx drivers, quantify the impact of specification changes and support informed decision-making.

  • Develop and maintain mechanical design standards, technical guidance notes, Basis of Design alignment, QA checklists, peer review frameworks and BIM-related mechanical requirements.

  • Translate complex mechanical engineering topics into clear, practical insight for senior stakeholders, regional teams and cross-functional partners.

 

What You'll Bring

 

  • Significant experience in mechanical engineering within mission-critical, hyperscale data centre or similarly complex technical environments.

  • Deep technical expertise across chilled water systems, plant optimisation, air-cooled and hybrid cooling solutions, liquid cooling integration, thermal modelling and capacity planning.

  • Strong understanding of data centre cooling strategy, resilience, scalability, partial-load and full-build-out assumptions, energy efficiency and PUE optimisation.

  • Experience reviewing and challenging consultant designs, leading technical governance and reducing design changes during construction.

  • Confidence working across regional and cross-functional teams, including Design, Engineering, Development, Delivery, Commercial, Construction and Commissioning.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to turn technical complexity into clear recommendations for technical, commercial and executive audiences.

  • A degree or equivalent experience in Mechanical Engineering. Chartered status, or progress towards chartership, would be advantageous.

  • Experience in a developer, hyperscale, investor-backed or large-scale infrastructure platform would be beneficial.

  • A structured, collaborative and improvement-focused approach, with the judgement to make clear decisions under pressure.

 

What We Offer

 

  • Work on critical digital infrastructure, supporting the development and operation of some of the world's most advanced data centre environments.

  • Build your future with STACK, gaining exposure to large-scale projects and clear opportunities for professional growth across a fast-growing European platform.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits designed to support you both professionally and personally.

  

About STACK Infrastructure

 

STACK is a proven, trusted partner for the world's most innovative companies, designing, developing and operating sustainable global digital infrastructure. Backed by an unmatched record of reliable delivery and development expertise, STACK brings speed, scale, certainty and responsibility to the demands of a rapidly evolving digital infrastructure landscape.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer (OptiArray)
descriptionHtml:
Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

Within our Underwater Security business we develop sensing technologies that help detect and monitor underwater threats. Our solutions include OptiBarrier, designed for immediate, over-the-horizon threat detection, and OptiArray, our low-power optical thin-line towed array for unmanned underwater vehicles and submarines.

The Role

As a Senior Mechanical Engineer at Optics11, you are responsible for the development and engineering realization of the OptiArray system. Your primary objective is to develop robust, structural, easy to manufacture solutions that ensure the array can be easily manufactured, deployed, and operated throughout their intended service life.

You translate allocated product and system requirements into engineering solutions that provide structural integrity, mechanical robustness, corrosion resistance, manufacturability, and reliable offshore deployment.

You work closely with Product System Engineering, Product Integration, Verification & Validation, Lifecycle Engineering, manufacturing partners, offshore contractors, and specialized suppliers to ensure the array is successfully developed and realized as part of the overall product.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and realize the OptiArray subsystems throughout the product development lifecycle.

  • Translate allocated product and system requirements into robust, easy to manufacture structural solutions for offshore deployment and long-term subsea operation.

  • Integrate subsystem assemblies / design into a functioning, robust product.

  • Adapt structural designs to accommodate varying sea conditions and deployment environments while maintaining product integrity and standardization where possible.

  • Produce subsystem specifications, engineering drawings, interface documentation, calculations, and design records.

  • Improve subsystem robustness, manufacturability, maintainability, and lifecycle performance throughout development.

  • Develop prototypes and engineering models to evaluate structural performance and manufacturability.

  • Perform engineering analyses and testing to evaluate structural integrity, lifting loads, fatigue performance, hydrodynamic behaviour, and environmental robustness.

  • Join design reviews, DFMEA sessions of submodules. Give input to improve overall system performance / to meet system requirements.

  • Support Verification & Validation by providing technical expertise during structural verification and qualification activities.

  • Support fabrication suppliers and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) activities by providing technical expertise and assessing structural assemblies against engineering specifications.

  • Share engineering knowledge, lessons learned, and best practices to strengthen team capability and improve future engineering execution.

  • Provide constructive feedback and support peers in solving technical challenges.

  • Contribute to a collaborative and knowledge-sharing engineering culture.

What we offer

  • Join one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech scale-ups.

  • Real impact: your work directly shapes our growth and success.

  • A great team in an international organization with colleagues from more than twenty nationalities.

  • A competitive salary and benefits package.

  • 30 days of holiday per year.

  • Fresh team lunches five times a week, plus regular team activities and company events.


Requirements

  • BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, or related engineering discipline.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience developing mechanical systems that are used in harsh environments.

  • Hands on design experience for systems / products that requires qualification against military (environmental) standards.

  • Proficiency in working with SolidWorks or equivalent CAD systems to develop and review mechanical designs, assemblies, engineering drawings, and technical documentation.

  • Experience designing marine products or subsea mechanical systems.

  • Experience performing structural calculations, load analysis, fatigue assessment, and mechanical interface design.

  • Experience working with fabrication suppliers and manufacturing partners.

  • Experience working within multidisciplinary product development teams.

  • Strong analytical and structured engineering problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Eligible to obtain EU/NATO security clearance.

Preferred

  • Experience with corrosion protection, cathodic protection, offshore coatings, or subsea structural design.

  • Hands-on experience with SolidWorks for mechanical design, assembly modelling, and detailed production drawings.

  • Experience taking ownership of a system or significant technical workstream within multidisciplinary engineering projects.

  • Familiarity with systems engineering, product lifecycle management, verification, and configuration management.

Screening

You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements.

title: Senior Medewerker Finance & Accounting
descriptionHtml:
Krijg jij energie van een financiële administratie die tot in de puntjes klopt? Heb je ruime ervaring met boekhouding en houd je graag overzicht over financiële processen? Bij Normec Foodcare zoeken we een ervaren Senior Medewerker Finance & Accounting die zelfstandig de financiële administratie beheert, afwijkingen signaleert en bijdraagt aan een correcte maand- en jaarafsluiting.

Jouw rol

Als Boekhoudkundig Medewerker ben je verantwoordelijk voor een correcte en tijdige verwerking van de financiële administratie. Je houdt je bezig met debiteuren, crediteuren, cashmanagement en grootboekcontroles. Daarnaast bereid je de maand- en jaarafsluiting voor en werk je nauw samen met de Financial Controller en andere collega's binnen Finance. Je maakt deel uit van een Finance-team van zeven collega's en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan Patricia Pouw, Finance Manager.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn verder:

  • Debiteuren- en crediteurenbeheer: Je beheert de openstaande posten, verwerkt ontvangsten en inkoopfacturen en onderhoudt contact met klanten en leveranciers over betalingen en factuurverschillen.

  • Cashmanagement: Je verwerkt bankmutaties, bewaakt de geldstromen en bereidt betalingen voor. Ook ondersteun je bij de liquiditeitsplanning.

  • Voorbereiden van de maand- en jaarafsluiting: Je zorgt dat de administratie volledig en tijdig is bijgewerkt. Je bereidt boekingen, reserveringen en balansspecificaties voor en ondersteunt bij de jaarafsluiting en accountantscontrole.

  • Grootboek en financiële controles: Je controleert grootboekrekeningen en financiële aansluitingen, onderzoekt afwijkingen en bereidt correcties voor.

  • Aanvullende administratie: Je houdt je bezig met intercompany-afstemmingen, vaste activa en de voorbereiding van btw-aangiften.

  • Procesverbetering: Je signaleert knelpunten, doet verbetervoorstellen en helpt de kwaliteit en efficiëntie van de financiële administratie verder te verbeteren.

Daarnaast ben je een inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor collega's bij complexere boekhoudkundige vraagstukken en ondersteun je hen met jouw kennis en ervaring.

Ons aanbod

Een afwisselende functie bij Normec Foodcare, met ruimte om zelfstandig te werken, mee te denken en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Je komt terecht in een betrokken team waarin samenwerking centraal staat. Wat je verder mag verwachten:

  • Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband

  • Een salaris tussen € 4.000 en € 4.500 bruto per maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring

  • Een dienstverband van bij voorkeur 40 uur per week. Een dienstverband van 32 uur per week is ook bespreekbaar

  • Hybride werken en flexibele werktijden: je kunt je werkdag indelen tussen 07.00 en 19.00 uur

  • 25 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantietoeslag

  • De mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen te kopen

  • Een goede pensioenregeling

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding

  • De mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan het fietsplan

  • Een continu ontwikkelprogramma waarin je wordt gestimuleerd om je talenten verder te ontwikkelen

  • Een collectieve ziektekostenverzekering bij VGZ

  • Een actieve personeelsvereniging die het hele jaar door diverse leuke activiteiten organiseert

Jouw profiel

Je bent een positief kritisch ingestelde en betrokken professional, die graag meedenkt en bouwt aan onze Finance-afdeling.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • Mbo+/hbo werk- en denkniveau in een financiële of boekhoudkundige richting

  • Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring als Boekhouder, Financieel Administratief Medewerker of in een vergelijkbare financiële functie

  • Ruime ervaring met zelfstandig boekhouden, debiteuren- en crediteurenbeheer en het voorbereiden van maandafsluitingen

  • Een goed begrip van grootboekadministratie, balansposten, btw en de samenhang tussen boekingen en financiële rapportages

  • Goede vaardigheden in Excel en ervaring met een ERP-systeem. Kennis van Exact Online of Business Central is een pré

  • Je hebt een goede beheersing van de Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk

  • Een nauwkeurige, gestructureerde en proactieve werkwijze. Je voert niet alleen werkzaamheden uit, maar onderzoekt ook zelfstandig afwijkingen en denkt mee over oplossingen

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om prettig samen te werken met klanten, leveranciers en collega's. Je deelt graag je kennis en ondersteunt anderen waar nodig

  • Je bent bij voorkeur 40 uur per week beschikbaar

Over Normec

Normec Foodlab Ede is onderdeel van Normec, toonaangevend in de Testen, Inspectie, Certificering en Compliance (TICC) industrie. Onze expertise raakt essentiële gebieden zoals water-, lucht- en bodemkwaliteit, brandveiligheid en voedselveiligheid, waarbij we de hoogste normen van kwaliteit en veiligheid garanderen in verschillende sectoren. Normec is opgericht in 2016 en is een ambitieuze, onafhankelijke en snelgroeiende organisatie.

We bieden onze collega’s de kans om actief bij te dragen aan onze missie én tegelijkertijd hun eigen carrière te ontwikkelen binnen een dynamische en snelgroeiende organisatie. Samen werken we aan impactvolle oplossingen voor onze klanten en aan een duurzame toekomst. De cultuur binnen Normec is informeel, open, energiek en ondernemend en is verankerd in onze GROWTH-principes. Middels ons The Normec Fit-programma, waarmee de deze principes tot leven brengen, zorgen we ervoor dat niet alleen ons bedrijf groeit, maar ook iedereen die er deel van uitmaakt.

Interesse? Laten we kennismaken!

Ben je geïnteresseerd in deze vacature? Dan kijken we uit naar jouw sollicitatie! We behandelen jouw gegevens vertrouwelijk en zorgen ervoor dat je binnen vijf werkdagen een reactie van ons ontvangt.  Voor vragen over deze vacature kun je contact opnemen met team Recruitment, via . Zij helpen je graag verder.

De procedure:

  • Eerste telefonische screening en verdere bespreking van de vacature

  • Persoonlijk gesprek bij Normec

  • Referentiecheck (na jouw goedkeuring)/ assessment

  • Tweede gesprek/bespreken arbeidsvoorwaarden bij Normec

  • Gefeliciteerd, je hebt je nieuwe uitdaging gevonden

Op zoek naar een nieuwe uitdaging binnen de voedingsmiddelenindustrie, maar is deze functie niet helemaal wat je zoekt? Volg Careers at Normec Foodcare op LinkedIn en blijf op de hoogte van al onze vacatures.

title: Senior Network Engineer - Low Latency Trading
descriptionHtml:
The Networks team designs, builds and maintains all the communications infrastructure that allows our high-capacity, low-latency trading and data research environments to run 24/7.  This network spans over 25 countries and 100 locations. We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer with experience designing and managing large environments to fulfill the high-performance and availability requirements of a premiere algorithmic trading firm operating in global financial markets. 

This position requires both project management and deep technical skills. Working together with some of the brightest minds in our industry, you’ll be responsible for everything from product selection and design to routing configuration and troubleshooting. You will work closely with our Systems and Trading Operations teams as well as others at HRT to build, manage, and monitor our low-latency trading network. You’ll have broad responsibilities with freedom to analyze and solve problems, and your solutions will have an immediate impact on our worldwide operations. 

We’re looking for someone with a love for technology and an excitement for tackling big picture problems. You will work on a wide variety of projects to enhance the performance and capacity of the global trading and research platforms and contribute to both high-level strategy and the technical nitty-gritty of our global network architecture.

Qualifications

  • BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related IT field
  • 5-10 years of relevant experience, preferably in low-latency and high-frequency trading environments.
  • In depth understanding of common layer 2 and layer 3 network protocols and best practices; working knowledge of OSPF, BGP, PIM, IGMP
  • Experience managing Arista, Cisco, and other common networking devices on a day-to-day basis
  • Familiarity with low-latency microwave networks and/or optical transmission systems, such as Adva, Ciena is desirable
  • Experience in designing enterprise networks, capacity planning, and full lifecycle project management
  • Experience with packet decoding and analysis tools such as tcpdump and Wireshark
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills: able to distill complicated issues into clear and concise terms and to create and maintain effective technical documentation
  • Experience with Unix/Linux command line utilities and networking stack
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills on a wide range of networking issues, including common ethernet LAN problems, multicast market data distribution, and global WAN
  • Understanding of basic power consumption and cooling issues in a datacenter environment
  • Knowledge of fiber optics technology and cabling standards. Ability to sort through specs and make recommendations on appropriate purchases
  • Willingness and ability to solve small technical problems in the field yourself.
  • You have excellent collaboration skills and a willingness to admit mistakes.

Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. title: Senior Operational Research Scientist

Relay's in-house solver has carried the business through more than 100x growth, built by a team of Operational Research Scientists who designed the decision architecture the network runs on. You'll join them and take it further.

Optimisation Highlights

  • Routing, pricing and scheduling decisions made in real time and under uncertainty.

The Opportunity

title: Senior Optical Packaging & Assembly Engineer
descriptionHtml:
PsiQuantum’s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers—machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems. 

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries. 

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry—including partners like GlobalFoundries—we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don’t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure. 

In 2024, PsiQuantum announced government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining—and that now is the time to scale. 

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies—including Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical—to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact. 

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift—and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we have a clear path to make it real. 

Come join us.

The Senior Optical Packaging Engineer is responsible for developing & implementing high-performance, robust & scalable opto-electronic packaging workflows for a variety of chip-based photonic integrated circuits.   • Work with external vendors and suppliers to source required materials and provide feedback on evolving requirements.

descriptionHtml:
Join a French Foodtech Superstar!

At HelloFresh, we're shaking up the way people eat in France with our meal kits!

Our ambition? To revolutionise our subscribers' everyday lives by promoting a more sustainable way of cooking and introducing them to delicious, creative and balanced recipes. The perfect blend of technology and gastronomy, with plenty of flavour!

HelloFresh operates in more than 15 countries. France is one of our youngest markets, launched in 2019, where we've experienced tremendous growth, establishing ourselves as the market leader. Joining our team means having a real impact within one of France's most promising scale-ups!

How do we make all this happen? Through a talented and dynamic team, strong values rooted in kindness and diversity, and an inspiring, stimulating work environment.

If you'd like to be part of this exciting human, international and entrepreneurial adventure, come and join us!

The Role : What’s in the Box

The France Marketing & Product Analytics team is a small team at the core of HelloFresh France's performance management. It measures marketing and product performance, keeps the underlying data reliable, and supports the Growth and Product teams with analyses that guide daily and long-term decisions. ROI and customer lifetime value (CLV) sit at the center of marketing decisions.

The team works closely with Marketing, Product, Finance, Operations and Global Analytics (Berlin).

The Senior Product Analyst divides their time equally between Product and Marketing. On the product side, they are the analytical reference for product decisions in France, working with the Culinary, Menu Planning and Strategy & Product Development (SPD) teams. On the marketing side, they shape growth strategy with data, weighing investment allocation and acquisition versus retention trade-offs, and explaining what drives marketing performance.

Cross-cutting responsibility: design and maintain internal analytical tools (scripts, dashboards, automations) that support the Culinary, Menu Planning, SPD and marketing workflows, and sponsor agentic analytics and AI tools across both areas.

What You'll Do : The Recipe

Product responsibilities (50%)

  • Product performance reporting: present regular summaries on menu performance, recipe adoption and assortment rotation to feed management reviews, with key KPIs defined and tracked.
  • Customer analytics through a product lens: analyze menu and recipe performance together with customer behavior and preferences (satisfaction, repurchase, retention by menu or recipe choice) to inform assortment decisions, and identify high-impact opportunities to feed the product strategy.
  • Strategic projects: lead the analytical and operational side of strategic projects that improve the product.

Marketing responsibilities (50%)

  • Strategic analyses: collaborate closely with our CMO and marketing leadership to drive strategic decisions (analyses on growth strategy, investment allocation and acquisition versus retention trade-offs).
  • Top line performance deep dives: investigate the root causes behind changes in marketing performance, and explain them from a customer and purchase behavior perspective (customer segmentation, discount applied, box taken, purchase behavior over time).
  • Management summaries: turn these deep dives into concise, top-level insights for management review.

What You'll Bring

  • You have graduated from a top-tier engineering or business school, or hold a university degree in Data, Statistics or a related field.
  • You have at least 4 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence or data science, ideally in an e-commerce, FMCG or food-tech environment.
  • You have advanced SQL skills; Python is a plus.
  • You have experience with BI tools (Tableau preferred) and excellent command of Google Sheets.
  • You have experience using AI/ML tools for exploratory analysis (e.g. anomaly detection), as well as leveraging LLMs to boost analytical productivity.
  • You can turn complex analyses into clear, concise and actionable recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
  • You are organised, rigorous and detail-oriented, with the ability to prioritise multiple topics while giving each the attention it deserves.
  • You are proactive: you know how to ask the right questions, not just find the answers.
  • You are fluent in French and have a good command of English, both spoken and written.
  • Bonus: You have a genuine passion for food and an interest in culinary or FMCG-related topics.

What we offer

  • A dynamic and international environment, with a strong corporate culture and DNA
  • Delicious discounts on HelloFresh meal kits
  • A steep learning curve guaranteed!
  • A supportive, passionate, proactive, and dynamic French team
  • Central Paris offices (1st arrondissement)

We'll review your CV and cover letter. If your profile looks like a good match, we'll invite you to a series of interviews and ask you to complete a case study. We'll do our best to keep the process moving quickly, so we can hopefully welcome you to HelloFresh soon!

Your first steps at HelloFresh:

When you join us, we'll put together a tailored onboarding programme to help you meet each manager and get to know how HelloFresh works. You'll also have time to get to know your team before diving into your new role!

title: Senior Product Analyst, Unit Economics
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Most delivery companies sell on price and volume, and find out later whether a client made them money. Sales teams are measured on what they sign, not on what a signing is worth. Relay wants every client, and every new shop in the network, to be one we'd choose again.

That is harder for us than for most, because what a client is worth depends on how their parcels flow through a network that's still growing. Engineering and analytics engineering build what you design.

Sales Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what a client or shop is worth and which signings sales should chase. The sales lead acts on your calls.

  • What is a new client or a new shop worth, when its value depends on where it sits in a network that changes every month? What would you build so sales knows before it signs?

  • Which signings become partners who do well with us, and what does that tell sales to look for?

  • The quarter's target is set. What has to close by when for it to hold, and what would tell you early that it won't?

  • A whole area, not a slice: you decide how sales values what it wins, and the result shows in what we sign next.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Product Analyst, Unit Economics at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Sales problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Sales decides: which signals count, what a client or shop is worth, and what good looks like.

  • Tell the sales lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the numbers and the street disagree: a new shop, a client's parcels at the sort centre.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove whether each change worked. In a year, sales chooses what to go after on measures you built, and can see whether the quarter will land before it ends.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned B2B pricing or commercial decisions and their number, rather than maintaining sales dashboards.

  • Have built, hands on, the first version of how a company values a customer or a deal: unit economics, lifetime value, or what it costs to win one.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or sales went after different deals because of it.

  • Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes.

  • Can say early whether a quarter will land, and what would tell you it won't.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

descriptionHtml:

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. SCALABILITY, RELIABILITY & EXECUTION ENGINE

descriptionHtml:
About us:

BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.

We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.

Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.

Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.

By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.

We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.

We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:

  • CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)
  • FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)
  • Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)
  • LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)

Location: We offer a Hybrid/Remote working policy.

FUNCTION: Product

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Fiat product team and own the operational backbone of our fiat payment flows.

Every day, BVNK moves money for enterprise customers across SEPA, SWIFT, ACH, RTGS and instant payment schemes. Getting a payment out of the door is only half the job. What happens next (a return, a recall, a rejected payment, a compliance hold, an investigation or a customer query) is where trust is won or lost. Your mission is to make those processes fast, reliable, automated and compliant, at scale.

You'll own the product strategy for the post-initiation and exception lifecycle of fiat payments: returns, recalls, rejections, repairs, investigations, compliance-driven holds and releases, and the tooling our operations teams use to manage them. You'll work hand in hand with payment operations, compliance, financial crime, treasury, finance and our banking partners to turn manual processes into well-designed product capabilities.

You'll partner with senior product managers, engineers and architects and with small, autonomous engineering squads, and you'll take products from discovery and design all the way through to launch. We see AI as a key lever in how we build and operate, and we expect you to use it in your day-to-day work.

Key Areas of Responsibilities:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for FIAT payment operations, covering the full exception lifecycle of payment flows across all schemes we support: SEPA (SCT and SCT Inst), SWIFT, ACH, Fedwire, FedNow, RTP and Faster Payments.
  • Design and deliver scheme-compliant handling of returns, recalls, rejections, cancellations, payment repairs and investigations, including the related ISO 20022 messages (e.g. pacs.004, camt.056, camt.029) and their equivalents on non-ISO rails.
  • Build compliance processes into payment flows from the start: sanctions and transaction screening outcomes, holds and releases, Requests for Information (RFIs), Verification of Payee / Confirmation of Payee, Travel Rule and fraud-related recalls, working closely with Operation, compliance and financial crime teams.
  • Drive straight-through processing and automation. Reduce manual intervention, define clear exception queues and SLAs, and give operations teams the internal tools, workflows and visibility they need.
  • Ensure the ledger, reconciliation, treasury and reporting stay correct when a payment changes state, so funds are reversed, returned or re-credited accurately and customers are informed through clear API events, webhooks and statuses.
  • Run the full product lifecycle from discovery to launch: problem definition, user research with internal and external users, solution design, PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, delivery with engineering, launch readiness, go-to-market, pricing input, documentation and enablement for sales and support.
  • Work with banking partners and scheme providers to understand rulebooks, cut-offs and scheme changes, and translate them into product requirements. Keep BVNK ahead of regulatory and scheme updates.
  • Define and track the measures that matter, such as exception rates, time to resolve returns and recalls, recall success rates, STP rates, operational cost per transaction, SLA adherence and customer satisfaction. Use data to decide what to build next.
  • Make sure capabilities are built once, on one shared BVNK platform, so every scheme, entity and partner benefits.

What we need from you:

  • Several years of product management experience, including owning complex B2B products in payments or fintech end-to-end, from discovery and design through to launch and commercialisation.
  • Solid knowledge of a product framework you've applied in practice: discovery, prioritisation, delivery, launch, go-to-market and post-launch iteration.
  • Hands-on experience with fiat payment schemes such as SEPA, SEPA Instant, SWIFT, ACH, Fedwire, FedNow, RTP and Faster Payments, and a deep understanding of how payments behave after initiation.
  • Experience with payment operations processes: returns, recalls, rejections, investigations, exceptions and reconciliation. You know the scheme rules, reason codes and timelines, and you know where things break in practice.
  • A track record of building compliance- and operations-heavy products in regulated environments, working closely with compliance, financial crime and operations teams on topics such as sanctions screening, payment holds, RFIs and fraud.
  • Strong technical skills. You're comfortable working with engineers on APIs, ledgers, event-driven systems, payment messaging (ISO 20022, JSON), data models and integrations, and you can reason about technical trade-offs without needing to write the code.
  • Excellent communication skills. You write clearly, present confidently to senior leaders, explain complex topics simply, and keep operations, compliance, engineering and commercial teams aligned.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. You bring structure to complex, cross-functional problems and keep things moving.
  • An AI-native mindset. You're an early adopter of AI tools and agentic workflows, and you use them to research, analyse, write specifications and design solutions, including spotting where AI can automate operational work.
  • Bonus: experience building internal operations tooling, case management or workflow products.
  • Bonus: experience working directly with sponsor banks, payment service providers or scheme operators.
  • Bonus: experience with products that run across several regulated entities or jurisdictions (e.g. UK, EU, US).

What you can expect from us:

  • Fair and competitive salary at every stage of your growth
  • Flexible working hours, with hybrid working at its heart
  • A culture built on passionate, growth-minded people
  • A flexible approach to holiday
  • Opportunities to travel to our offices around the world
  • An open and creative environment where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets.

At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we’d encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team.

descriptionHtml:

The difference you’ll make

You’ll sit in the Product Marketing team, reporting to the Head of Product Marketing. You’ll work closely with our international commercial teams alongside Product, Design, Research, and Engineering to champion our international customers, identify what drives their booking choices, and uncover where loveholidays can win. Together, the team will turn customer empathy and market intelligence into high-impact proposition improvements and rapid experimentation that accelerate growth across key international markets, starting with a strong focus on Germany and the Netherlands.

The Product Marketing team acts as the critical bridge between local market dynamics and core platform execution. Collectively, the team combines qualitative customer research with deep commercial analytics to evaluate competitor models, diagnose performance gaps across the end-to-end booking journey, and define high-value opportunities that scale effectively across borders.

Product Marketing sits within our Platform function, which builds the technology and shared capabilities that power the loveholidays experience. By creating scalable products, systems and tools, Platform helps the wider organisation move faster, work more independently and deliver better outcomes for customers.

Your day-to-day:

International customer and competitor expertise

  • Build a deep understanding of customers in each international market: their needs, motivations, booking habits, expectations and barriers to choosing loveholidays. With a specific focus on Germany and the Netherlands.

  • Get hands-on with customer research, feedback and the end-to-end holiday journey, building real empathy and bringing the international customer’s voice into decisions across the business.

  • Understand competitor propositions and business models in detail. Experience their products, assess how well they meet local customer needs and identify where we need to close gaps or offer something more compelling.

  • Share customer and competitor insight broadly, helping teams distinguish between needs shared across markets and differences that require a local approach.

Market performance and opportunities

  • Understand performance by market, customer segment and stage of the journey, working with commercial and analytics teams to connect customer behaviour with conversion, repeat booking, customer satisfaction and commercial outcomes.

  • Identify where our proposition and experience are strong or weak, combining performance data with customer and competitor evidence to understand why.

  • Prioritise opportunities with clear recommendations on the customer problem, expected impact and how we will measure success.

Hands-on experimentation and improvement

  • Propose and run tests with international commercial and platform teams, taking opportunities from an initial hypothesis through to execution, measurement and a decision on what happens next.

  • Test changes to our proposition, messaging and customer experience, from how we explain our value to how customers search, book and manage their holiday.

  • Use results to refine our approach, stop ideas that do not work and build evidence for wider investment in those that do.

A platform that scales internationally

  • Translate international customer needs and market opportunities into clear proposition and experience requirements for product, design and engineering teams.

  • Work with platform teams to influence priorities and shape solutions that address local needs while building capabilities we can reuse across markets.

  • Identify where our platform limits international growth, including gaps in localisation, content, payment options, trust and the post-booking experience, and work with teams to test and address them.

  • Bring evidence from current markets into future market planning, helping teams understand what can scale, what needs to adapt and what we should validate before launch.

Your skillset:

  • You have significant experience in product marketing, proposition development, growth or a closely related discipline within a consumer-facing digital business, including work across international markets.

  • You are a customer expert. You go beyond research decks, spend time understanding real behaviour and can explain how needs differ between markets and customer segments.

  • You understand competition at the proposition level: why customers choose one provider over another, how different businesses deliver value and what that means for our own choices.

  • You are confident working with data. You can interpret market and customer performance, ask the right questions and combine quantitative and qualitative evidence into a clear point of view.

  • You have a track record of hands-on experimentation. You can turn an opportunity into a testable hypothesis, work with others to deliver it and use the results to decide what to do next.

  • You know how to work with product, design and engineering teams, translating customer needs into clear problems and requirements and balancing local relevance with platform scalability.

  • You communicate clearly and lead through influence. You build momentum across commercial and platform teams and challenge assumptions constructively.

  • You are comfortable moving between setting direction and doing the work. You bring curiosity, sound judgement and personal ownership of results.

At loveholidays, we focus on creating an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute, grow and succeed. We value the different perspectives, experiences and ideas each person brings, because they help us work better together, challenge our thinking and make stronger decisions.

title: Senior/Staff Data Scientist - Measurement, Experimentation & Causal Inference
descriptionHtml:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Role Overview:

As a Senior / Staff Data Scientist, you will help shape how PlayStation measures the impact of products, features and commercial initiatives through world-class experimentation, causal inference and applied data science.

Working at the intersection of data science, machine learning, product and commercial strategy, you will develop innovative measurement methodologies, define best practices, and provide technical leadership that enables teams across PlayStation to make faster, more confident business decisions.

This role goes beyond traditional A/B testing. You will solve complex measurement problems where controlled experiments are difficult or impossible, applying modern causal inference, statistical modelling and machine learning techniques to generate robust business insights. You will collaborate closely with product, engineering, analytics and business teams to raise the standard of experimentation and evidence-based decision-making across the organisation.

This is an opportunity to influence strategic decisions impacting millions of PlayStation players while helping establish best-in-class measurement practices across one of the world's leading entertainment companies.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Develop innovative measurement methodologies across experimentation, causal inference and advanced analytics that improve the quality, reliability and scalability of business decision-making across PlayStation.
  • Design robust measurement approaches across randomised experiments, quasi-experimental methods and observational causal inference where controlled experimentation is impractical.
  • Research, evaluate and prototype statistical, machine learning and AI techniques to solve complex real-world measurement challenges.
  • Apply advanced data science and machine learning techniques where appropriate to complement experimentation and support complex business decisions.
  • Define and promote best practices for experiment design, statistical analysis and causal measurement across multiple product and business teams, helping scale experimentation across PlayStation.
  • Partner closely with senior business leaders, product managers, engineers and analysts to identify high-impact measurement opportunities and ensure product and commercial decisions are supported by rigorous evidence.
  • Partner with engineering teams to influence the evolution of PlayStation's experimentation platform and measurement capabilities, ensuring statistical best practices are embedded into future platform development.
  • Provide technical leadership across multiple product and commercial domains, influencing measurement strategy, analytical standards and long-term technical direction through expertise and collaboration.
  • Mentor and develop analysts and data scientists, helping raise technical capability and analytical excellence across the team.
  • Champion a culture of evidence-based decision-making by educating stakeholders, sharing best practices, and communicating advances in experimentation, causal inference and applied data science.
  • Stay current with emerging developments in statistics, machine learning and AI, identifying opportunities to improve measurement capabilities and analytical workflows.

What We're Looking For:

  • Experience applying advanced data science, machine learning and statistical modelling techniques to solve complex business problems.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and SQL for large-scale analytical workflows.

Preferred:

  • Experience with modern business intelligence and data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Domo or Power BI.
  • Experience applying AI tools, including large language models (LLMs), to improve data science workflows and analytical productivity.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership through mentoring, publications, conference presentations, open-source contributions or internal communities of practice.

What You'll Influence:

title: Senior / Staff Engineer (Routing & Optimisation)
descriptionHtml:
About HIVED 📦

At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing.

Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery.

A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better.

Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.

Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures, Maersk Growth, Pale Blue Dot VC, Eka Ventures, NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.

 


Role Overview 📝

We're looking for a Senior or Staff Engineer to take on some of the hardest problems at HIVED: the planning systems that decide how every parcel moves through our 100% electric delivery network.

You'll join the Routing Squad, which owns HIVED's entire planning pipeline: demand forecasting, capacity planning and scheduling, sortation, our collections network and large-scale route optimisation. Most of the work is backend engineering on distributed, production-grade systems, built in close partnership with data scientists, analysts and our operations teams. If your depth is in operations research or machine learning and you want to see your models plan a real delivery network every day, we'd love to hear from you too.

This is a hands-on role with a lot of technical ownership. You'll shape how the pieces of the pipeline fit together and your work shows up in the routes our drivers take, the cages filled at our depots and the parcels that arrive on time.

The problems are as varied as they are hard. How much volume will each depot see next week, and how many drivers and vehicles do we need to meet it? How should parcels flow through sortation and our collections network so nothing is handled twice? How do we turn each day's parcels into routes that are efficient, reliable and on time? And how do we model the cost and geography of our network as we expand into new cities?

 

What You'll be Doing 🚀

  • Build the planning pipeline. Design, build and run the distributed systems behind routing, capacity planning, sortation and our collections network.

  • Turn ambiguity into designs. Take complex operational problems, break them down, and see them through from first investigation to production.

  • Shape the architecture. Shape how the planning pipeline fits together, and coordinate with other squads where our systems meet theirs.

  • Put models into production. Build and productionise optimisation, forecasting and ML models, making them robust, observable and ready for peak volumes.

  • Stay close to the operation. Work directly with operations teams, see how plans perform on the ground, and close the loop with data.

  • Raise the bar. Lead design and code reviews, mentor engineers, and set the standards for testing and reliability.

  

What We're Looking For 🔎

  • Typically 5+ years of software engineering experience, building and operating production systems.

  • A track record of technical ownership beyond your own work: you've shaped the architecture or direction of systems spanning multiple components or teams.

  • The ability to translate complex, ambiguous operational problems into technical solutions with measurable impact.

  • Proficiency in Python or Go, or another language with the ability to ramp up quickly on HIVED's stack.

  • An appetite for hard optimisation problems: routing, scheduling, forecasting, supply-demand matching, or other constraint-heavy domains.

  • Strong collaboration and written communication skills, with the confidence to work across engineering, data science, analytics and operations.

You also bring depth in at least one of:

  • Backend and distributed systems: strong system design skills in distributed, production-grade environments, including event-driven architectures, cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), and reliability and performance at scale.

  • Optimisation / operations research: linear and integer programming, constraint programming or heuristics, and integrating solvers such as OR-Tools or Gurobi into production systems.

  • Machine learning: forecasting and predictive models that feed planning decisions, from development to monitoring in production.

 


Technologies we use 💻

  • Python, Go

  • AWS (Lambda, ECS Fargate, Step Functions, SQS, EventBridge, Aurora PostgreSQL), CDK (TypeScript)

  • GCP, BigQuery, Looker

  • Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Prometheus

  • GitHub, GitHub Actions

  • Claude Code

  • Event-driven architecture and domain-driven design

 


Our interviewing process 🪜

  • Intro call with the hiring manager

  • Live coding challenge solving a problem

  • A take home case study, followed by a discussion

  • On-site interview at our Shoreditch HQ (role and culture)


Our Values

  • 💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started. We never fight the urge to be inquisitive, to understand the world around us and to explore where others might not.

  • 🌍 We Are Resourceful - Our planet's resources are scarce and our future depends on our ability to use them wisely. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have.

How we reward our team 🎁

title: Senior/Staff Site Reliability Engineer (Server Infrastructure)
descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role

Server Infrastructure is a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team responsible for the full lifecycle of Nebius Cloud hardware: from newly delivered bare metal through provisioning, operation, maintenance, and decommissioning. Almost every Nebius service runs on servers within our domain. Our mission is to make the hardware layer fast, reliable, and invisible.

We apply software engineering to infrastructure operations. We build services and automation that bring servers into the cloud, keep them healthy, recover them from failures, and retire them safely. Our work spans CPU and GPU platforms, the base GNU/Linux system, and the infrastructure supporting our hardware fleet.

As a Senior / Staff Engineer, you’ll take ownership of complex infrastructure challenges and help shape the team’s technical direction. You’ll combine hands-on engineering with architecture, mentoring, and coordination across teams, turning operational needs into reliable services and automation.
You’ll work closely with data center engineers, capacity managers, cloud compute developers, networking teams, and hardware suppliers. Your work will directly affect the reliability and capacity of the entire cloud platform.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Design, build, and operate services for netboot, provisioning, maintenance, automated recovery, and decommissioning.
  • Lead technical initiatives from problem definition and design through implementation and production operation.
  • Help shape the technical roadmap, balancing reliability improvements, new hardware integration, and long-term engineering work.
  • Define meaningful reliability indicators and service level objectives, using them to guide engineering priorities.
  • Reduce operational toil by turning recurring failures and manual procedures into reliable automation.
  • Improve on-call practices, incident response, and learning through blameless incident reviews.
  • Strengthen fleet observability, alerting, testing, deployment safety, and operational readiness.
  • Drive support for new CPU and GPU platforms and improvements to the base GNU/Linux system.
  • Mentor engineers, provide thoughtful design and code reviews, and help the team develop sound engineering practices.
  • Coordinate delivery across teams, communicate technical tradeoffs, and resolve dependencies.
We expect you to have:
  • Strong software engineering experience in Go and a solid understanding of Linux systems.
  • Experience designing, building, and operating infrastructure services, including distributed systems and failure handling.
  • A track record of owning complex technical initiatives and bringing them into production.
  • Practical knowledge of SRE principles: service level objectives, observability, incident management, capacity planning, and toil reduction.
  • Sound technical judgment and the ability to guide architecture and investigate difficult production problems.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and improving engineering practices through collaboration and technical example.
  • Clear communication and the ability to work effectively across engineering and operational teams.

We welcome candidates at senior and staff levels. The scope of ownership and technical influence will reflect your experience.
Experience with hardware provisioning, bare metal infrastructure, GPU platforms, or large server fleets would be valuable.
Familiarity with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, GitOps, SaltStack, and Terraform is also useful.
We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture

title: Software Engineer (Data)
descriptionHtml:
About Codat

Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.

Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time.

The Role

Some of the biggest commercial banks in the world already work with us. Their relationship managers want to spend their time with clients, not digging through the books to find out what's changed. We're building the thing that does the digging for them.

It's called the Advisory Intelligence Platform. It puts Codat's client intelligence inside the assistant a banker already uses, starting with Microsoft Copilot. Ask it anything about a client and it answers from that client's actual books. Don't ask, and it tells you anyway when something important changes.

Every one of those answers sits on data. Someone has to get that data in, shape it, define it and serve it, so the number the assistant quotes is the right one. That's you. You write production software, and you care about the data it moves as much as the code that moves it.

This role is for an engineer who's growing fast and wants room to grow faster. You'll ship from your first weeks, own what you build once it's live, and work alongside data and AI engineers who'll push you. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS, and we work that way ourselves: agents take the repetitive work, engineers take the interesting problems.

What You'll Work On

  • The data behind every answer. Services and pipelines that take raw data from accounting platforms, banks and payment systems and turn it into something a model can trust. When a source sends rubbish, your code notices.

  • The semantic layer. The definitions the model is allowed to use: what counts as revenue, when a month ends, which currency. Get it right and every answer agrees with every other answer.

  • The signal layer. Spotting when something changes for a client: a customer paying later, cash running tighter, a supplier quietly becoming critical. You'll help build the detection and make it fast and reliable.

  • The tools the assistant calls. MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and APIs that serve data to agents. You'll build them, test them and find out how they break before a banker does.

  • Keeping the numbers honest. Tests, data checks and observability that prove a number is right, and catch it the moment it isn't.

You'll Probably Have

  • Shipped production software that real people depended on, and written most of it yourself. Services, APIs or data systems with tests, not notebooks or config.

  • Had data be the hard part. A source that sent duplicates, a schema that changed under you, two teams who meant different things by "customer". You fixed it, and you'd design it differently now.

  • Good engineering habits in Python, C# or another general-purpose language. Tested, modular code the next person can change without fear.

  • An eye for SQL. You can read a query and tell whether it's right, whoever or whatever wrote it.

  • Stayed on the hook for something after it went live. You found out why it broke, fixed the cause, and added what would have caught it sooner.

  • Some time with CI/CD, Docker and cloud (we're on Azure). You've changed a pipeline, not just pushed to one.

  • A habit of asking why. If someone asks for a number the data can't support, you say so.

  • AI as part of how you work, and you can explain and defend what it helped you build.

  • Momentum. More ownership with each move, new stacks picked up quickly, things built that nobody asked for.

  • Useful, not essential: fintech, lending or accounting; Spark, Databricks or dbt; anything that puts data in front of an LLM.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We're more interested in what you've built and how fast you're growing than in a perfect match.

How We Work

We're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather ship something useful and improve it than polish it in private. What you build is yours from start to finish.

There's no return-to-office mandate, and you can work hybrid or fully remote. We trust you to be around when the team needs you and to deliver what you said you would. What we don't want is anyone staying online late to prove a point.

Compensation: £75K – £95K • Offers Equity
