  • You map client IT landscapes, design complex integrations (SSO, AFAS, SAP, Learning Hub/DMS and others) and visualise data flows in professional architecture diagrams.

  • You navigate and translate security & privacy frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, BIO, DORA, Archives Act) into concrete product proof-points and commercial advantages.

  • You act as the bridge between Sales, Engineering, Product and Compliance — harvesting tribal knowledge, feeding market insights back into the roadmap and turning technical complexity into reusable commercial assets.

  • You use AI tools as your daily operating system: analysing lengthy RFPs, generating first-draft responses, accelerating narrative writing and building custom assistants while keeping human-in-the-loop quality and security standards.

  • You measure success by technical wins secured, sales cycles de-risked, time saved for the commercial team and long-term institutional trust built with enterprise clients — not just documents delivered.


Who you are

  • You have 3 to 7 years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Pre-Sales, Technical Consulting or a similar role at a scaling B2B SaaS company, preferably EdTech or tech. You’ve moved beyond standard demos into complex enterprise solution design and tender support.

  • You have hands-on experience configuring platforms, scoping integrations, working with APIs and data models, and shipping working technical answers under tender deadlines.

  • You’re fluent in both the commercial conversation (with Account Executives and SDRs) and the technical conversation (with architects, CISOs and engineers).

  • You’re AI-native and product-minded: you diagnose requirements, design solutions, ship documentation and iterate with commercial outcomes in mind. AI is your building material.

  • You’re structured, detail-oriented, proactive and able to keep overview across multiple parallel tenders and stakeholder groups.

  • You think commercially — about which technical choices increase win probability, reduce risk and create long-term trust, not just technical elegance.

  • You’re a strong team player with excellent communication skills and the ability to make complex topics accessible and exciting.

  • You speak and write excellent Dutch (English is a plus).


What we offer

  • €60K - €80K a year including holiday allowence + 10K variabel.

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Hybrid working (3 days at the office / 2 days at home).

  • 25 holidays + an extra day off on your birthday.

  • A 3% pension contribution paid by Studytube via A.S.R.

  • A fully equipped gym at the office — work out before or after work and skip the trip to Basic-Fit.

  • €1,000 L&D budget per year, of which 50% can go towards wellbeing or your home-office setup.

  • In-company training via our own Studytube Academy: LevelUp.

  • A beautiful office in the Houthavens with a view over the IJ.

  • A company laptop (MacBook Air) + €10 allowance for using your own phone.

  • For a small contribution: a fully catered lunch with a choice of a hot meal, sandwiches or salad bar when you’re at the office.

  • The nicest colleagues, with a team outing every quarter and an annual company party.

About Studytube
Studytube makes professional development as accessible, easy, fun, and successful as possible. We believe it’s essential for companies to invest in employee development, now more than ever. That’s why we offer an all-in-one learning platform that inspires employees to grow—and we do so successfully. Our customer portfolio includes over 300 clients across various industries, ranging from 200 to 30,000 employees. Companies like Bol.com, ASR, CZ, Manpower, VolkerWessels, and Eneco are already inspiring their employees with our platform. Together with 200+ diverse and passionate colleagues, we focus on creating the best learning experience for our clients. Our goal? To become Europe’s #1 platform for professional development.

title: Spécialiste Support Services Financiers allemand courant (Télétravail depuis Mulhouse) H/F
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

  

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Services Financiers, tu te positionnes comme un expert des services financiers et du compte professionnel.

Tu es l’interlocuteur privilégié de nos clients qui utilisent Pennylane pour gérer leur activité et leurs flux financiers au quotidien.

Tu les accompagnes notamment sur les sujets liés :

  • à l’ouverture et à la gestion de leur compte professionnel ;

  • au dépôt de capital ;

  • à l’encaissement de leurs clients ;

  • aux moyens de paiement et aux flux financiers associés ;

  • au suivi et à la résolution de leurs demandes liées aux services financiers.

Grâce à ta maîtrise de l’allemand et du français, tu accompagnes les clients dans ces deux langues, notamment ceux situés en Allemagne.

Tu interagis également au quotidien avec nos partenaires bancaires sur les sujets liés aux comptes professionnels, au dépôt de capital, à l’encaissement et, plus largement, aux flux financiers de nos clients.

Tu joues ainsi un rôle de coordination entre les clients, les équipes internes et nos partenaires bancaires, afin de faciliter le traitement des demandes et d’assurer leur suivi jusqu’à leur résolution.

 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que membre de l’équipe Support Services Financiers, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients dirigeants, leurs équipes, nos partenaires bancaires et les équipes internes de Pennylane.

Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherches à comprendre leurs demandes et les situations qu’ils rencontrent concernant leur compte professionnel et les services financiers.

Après investigation, ton objectif est d’apporter une réponse claire ou une solution adaptée à ton interlocuteur. Lorsque cela est nécessaire, tu transmets la demande aux équipes internes ou aux partenaires concernés et assures son suivi jusqu’à sa résolution.

Au quotidien, tu :

  • échanges avec les clients dirigeants et leurs équipes ;

  • comprends et qualifies leurs demandes ;

  • les accompagnes sur les sujets liés au compte professionnel, au dépôt de capital et à l’encaissement ;

  • interagis avec nos partenaires bancaires sur les demandes et opérations liées aux services financiers ;

  • coordonnes les échanges entre les clients, les équipes internes et les partenaires concernés ;

  • analyses les situations et identifies les prochaines étapes ;

  • apportes une réponse claire ou une solution adaptée ;

  • formalises les informations utiles au traitement des dossiers ;

  • assures le suivi de chaque demande jusqu’à sa résolution ;

  • veilles à maintenir une communication claire avec le client à chaque étape.

Tu traites les demandes en allemand et en français, notamment celles émanant d’Allemagne, et tu collabores avec les équipes internes et nos partenaires bancaires en anglais.

 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

Au démarrage :

  • Tu intègres la CSM Academy et tu te formes en continu sur Pennylane et ses services financiers.

  • Tu développes tes connaissances sur le compte professionnel, le dépôt de capital, l’encaissement et les moyens de paiement.

  • Tu apprends tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision et nos différents départements.

  • Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu’avec les différents départements.

  • Tu te familiarises avec notre réseau de partenaires bancaires et les interactions liées aux différents services financiers.

  • Tu commences à répondre aux demandes des clients liées à nos services financiers : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

  • Tu commences à traiter les demandes en allemand et en français, avec l’appui de l’équipe.

 

Après quelques mois :

  • Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends progressivement en charge ton portefeuille de demandes.

  • Tu gères des demandes clients de plus en plus complexes concernant les comptes professionnels, les dépôts de capital et les encaissements.

  • Tu analyses les demandes, identifies les informations nécessaires et recherches la solution la plus adaptée.

  • Tu échanges directement avec nos partenaires bancaires sur les sujets liés aux comptes professionnels, au dépôt de capital et à l’encaissement.

  • Tu assures la coordination et le suivi des demandes nécessitant l’intervention de plusieurs parties prenantes.

  • Tu échanges avec les équipes internes et nos partenaires bancaires en anglais.

  • Tu formalises les éléments utiles au traitement des dossiers et à leur résolution.

  • Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition des clients, notamment en allemand, afin de développer leur autonomie.

  • Tu partages avec tes collègues tes connaissances et ton expérience de terrain.

  • Tu portes la voix et les usages des clients, notamment ceux situés en Allemagne, et partages aux équipes internes des retours construits.

  • Tu contribues à fluidifier les échanges entre Pennylane, les clients et notre réseau de partenaires bancaires.

 

Et ensuite...

  • Tu deviens une personne référente sur les services financiers et le compte professionnel.

  • Tu aides ton équipe à gagner en efficacité en identifiant les axes d’amélioration.

  • Tu contribues à des projets liés à l’amélioration de l’expérience client et des processus financiers.

  • Tu portes la voix des clients auprès des équipes Produit et Opérations.

  • Tu participes à l’amélioration continue de l’accompagnement des clients germanophones.

  • Tu contribues à renforcer la qualité des échanges avec nos partenaires bancaires.

 

Profil recherché

  • Tu maîtrises l’allemand et le français l’écrit comme à l’oral, au minimum au niveau B2. Le niveau C1 est apprécié.

  • Tu es capable d’accompagner les clients en allemand et en français, et de collaborer en anglais avec les équipes internes et les partenaires.

  • Tu disposes de plusieurs années d’expérience au sein d’une néo-banque, d’une banque en ligne, d’une banque traditionnelle ou d’une FinTech.

  • Tu as une excellente compréhension du système bancaire.

  • Une expérience sur des sujets liés aux comptes professionnels, aux moyens de paiement ou à l’encaissement est particulièrement appréciée.

  • Une expérience précédente en support B2B est souhaitée.

  • Tu sais expliquer des sujets financiers ou administratifs de manière simple et claire.

  • Tu es à l’aise pour comprendre une situation, analyser une demande et en assurer le suivi.

  • Tu fais preuve d’écoute, de pédagogie et de rigueur dans tes échanges avec les clients.

  • Tu apprécies les échanges avec des partenaires externes et sais maintenir une communication professionnelle et efficace.

  • Tu es à l’aise avec des échanges téléphoniques quotidiens avec les clients.

  • Une expérience de travail en direct avec des dirigeants est un plus.

  • Tu sais collaborer avec différentes équipes pour faire avancer une demande.

  • Tu es disponible pour des horaires roulants et adaptés aux besoins des clients.

  • Tu t’intéresses aux nouveaux services financiers et aux solutions qui facilitent la gestion quotidienne des entrepreneurs.

  • Un intérêt pour la technologie est un plus, notamment une bonne connaissance des produits proposés par les FinTech actuelles.

Poste ouvert au télétravail avec 2 jours de déplacement à Paris au sein de nos locaux ponctuellement, frais pris en charge.

 

Process de recrutement

  • Entretien en visio avec Simon Peraldo, Senior Recruiter : 30 minutes

  • Entretien en visio avec Vincent Lambert, Responsable de l’équipe : 1 heure

  • Test pratique en allemand : lecture d’un message client et rédaction d’une réponse

  • Dernier échange en visio avec Nathan Robinet, Senior Team Lead Customer Support, Financial Services : 45 minutes

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

title: Sr Agent Architect (Germany)
descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role

As a Sr Agent Architect at Parloa, you will act as a solution architect for enterprise AI Agent deployments. You will design end-to-end system architectures that connect Parloa's platform to complex enterprise environments, solve multi-system integration challenges, and apply systems thinking to build reliable, scalable AI solutions for global enterprise clients.

You will also shape the conversational experience layer, using prompt engineering and your knowledge of LLMs to translate customer requirements into agent behavior. Architecture and integration depth are the core of this role. Conversational design skills are valued and can be developed on the job.

Areas of ownership

  • Design end-to-end solution architectures for AI Agent deployments, mapping how Parloa's platform integrates into customers' enterprise systems (CRMs, ERPs, ticketing systems, contact center platforms).

  • Build and configure integrations using integration platforms and APIs, applying systems thinking to solve complex, multi-system data flows.

  • Collaborate with Forward Deployed Engineers on complex or custom integration scenarios that go beyond standard integration capabilities.

  • Apply structured testing approaches to validate architecture, integration reliability, and AI agent performance under real-world conditions.

  • Identify and resolve blockers together with other departments at Parloa (e.g., Product, Solution Engineering, Sales) and the customer.

  • Scope AI Agent deployments, providing strategic architecture advice and execution support to customers and partners.

  • Use your knowledge of LLM internals (e.g., embeddings) to analyze customer requirements and design prompts for reliable, user-aligned agent behavior.

  • Translate complex customer workflows into structured conversational components that LLMs can execute reliably.

  • Fine-tune conversational flows and voice output (e.g., SSML, Lexicons, Regex) to align with customer brand standards.

  • Document best practices, how-to guides, and product capabilities for internal and external audiences, representing the expertise of the Agent Architect team.

Who you are

  • 3+ years of experience in enterprise customer-facing roles, with proven expertise in solution architecture, systems architecture, or enterprise integration.

  • Strong systems thinking, with a track record of solving complex technical problems across multiple systems and data sources.

  • Experience with complex SaaS implementations at scale (CRMs, ERPs, contact center platforms, ticketing systems).

  • Proficiency in REST API design, JSON/XML data structures, API testing tools (e.g., Postman), and API authentication patterns (OAuth, API keys, JWT).

  • Experience reading and consuming API documentation across enterprise SaaS platforms, including data transformation and field mapping logic.

  • Analytical and critical thinker with expertise in risk assessment and problem-solving.

  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with a passion for meeting milestones and effective communication.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with initiative, results orientation, and ability to identify opportunities for impact.

  • Ability to analyze customer requirements and translate them into LLM prompts and conversational flows, with attention to subtle conversational nuance and A/B testing to assess agent performance. 

  • Prior conversation design, prompt engineering (e.g., chain-of-thought, few-shot learning), or A/B testing experience is a plus, not a requirement - we will train this.

  • Fluency in German and English is required 

Our Recruiting Process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. title: Staff Data Scientist, Trust & Safety
descriptionHtml:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

You'll join Vinted's Trust & Safety domain, whose mission is to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. Across several detection, moderation and sanctioning teams, we run a growing set of machine learning models, rule engines, and LLM agents. They score every new listing, account and message at Vinted's scale, and many of them act on members automatically.

We're looking for a Staff Data Scientist to shape the architecture and effectiveness of our detection systems as a whole. You'll tackle problems that individual teams cannot solve independently: how to maximize detection coverage, combine different models into coherent risk decisions, and allocate computational resources where they reduce the most harm. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with scope across Trust & Safety and Security domains. You'll set technical direction, challenge existing approaches, prototype solutions and work with teams to bring them into production.

It's an opportunity to shape how a large-scale, increasingly AI-driven safety system is built, evaluated and improved.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Design the end-to-end ML architecture for detection, risk scoring, routing and decision-making.
  • Develop cost-efficient, layered inference strategies that combine broad, low-latency screening with deeper, more expensive analysis where it adds the most value.
  • Establish approaches to continuous risk assessment across the member lifecycle, from registration and listing creation to ongoing activity.
  • Define how we measure end-to-end detection effectiveness, including precision, coverage, missed harm and computational cost. Use these measurements to identify the highest-impact improvements.
  • Turn siloed, team-level models into a coherent, calibrated detection system by addressing the technical and organisational barriers that lead to local optimisation.
  • Identify and close detection coverage gaps, ensuring that relevant signals and outcomes are available for evaluation, diagnosis and continuous improvement.
  • Set shared technical standards and architectural direction across teams, working with engineering and data science leaders to translate them into production systems.
  • Prototype critical components, test architectural assumptions empirically and build reference implementations that teams can scale.
  • Explain complex ML trade-offs to senior technical and business leaders as clear choices about harm reduction, cost, and engineering investment.

About you 

  • Have 8+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or a similar role, including significant time owning production models or model evaluation at scale.
  • Have led cross-team technical work without formal authority, and you're comfortable setting standards that other teams adopt.
  • Have deep expertise in statistical inference and experimentation: A/B testing, measuring precision and recall under imperfect or biased labels, sampling for ground truth, and causal reasoning.
  • Understand the ML lifecycle in production: evaluation, threshold setting, retraining, drift, feature stores and monitoring.
  • Have hands-on experience evaluating LLM-based systems, or a strong interest in building rigorous methods for them.
  • Are highly proficient in SQL and Python and comfortable working in a modern data stack (e.g. BigQuery, dbt).
  • Can turn messy, cross-system problems into a clear plan, and can explain trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
  • Are fluent in English, both written and spoken.
  • Nice to have: experience in Trust & Safety, fraud prevention, content moderation, or risk management.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

title: Staff Product Analyst, Driver Supply
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Delivery companies have always bought capacity by guesswork. Book too few drivers and parcels wait; book too many and you pay for empty vans. Most carriers accept that waste as the price of being reliable. Relay is building a marketplace where it isn't. You can't schedule drivers. You can only design what's on offer, and measure what happens.

Every part of our network runs on decisions. The next two years are about building the systems that make them well, and proving they do. Engineering and operational research build what you design.

Marketplace Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what Marketplace changes on booking, matching and shifts, and recommend on pay. Our scientists' models and experiments feed your calls, and the squad lead acts on them.

  • Drivers choose when to work. What makes a shift worth booking early, and how do you prove what works when a clean experiment isn't possible?

  • Every booked shift is paid, used or not, and every unserved route means late parcels. Where should each area sit between the two, and what would let the network get there on its own?

  • Local shops hold our parcels while running their own businesses. Where does the network need more of them, what should a shop be paid, and how would you see a closed shop coming?

  • A whole area, not a slice: no playbook, and the result is on the street the next morning.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Staff Product Analyst, Driver Supply at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Marketplace problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Marketplace decides: which signals count, and what good looks like for booking, matching and pay.

  • Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove whether each change worked. In a year, Marketplace's booking and pay decisions run on a system you designed.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned the decisions a matching, pricing or incentive model fed, in a two-sided marketplace or gig platform, rather than building the model itself.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for.

  • Can trace why drivers or couriers stop booking or cancel, and can read the experiments behind a pricing or incentive change, including when a clean test isn't possible.

  • Have been through real change, such as a pivot, fast growth or a new market, and rebuilt something because of it.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and happy to build their own analysis apps, monitors and alerts.

  • Would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

descriptionHtml:

Elle est engagée dans un programme de transformation, qui touche ses métiers, ses méthodes et ses outils. L'IA en est l'un des leviers. Des outils sont déjà déployés et l'équipe de transformation digitale du groupe SOGECLAIR travaille sur le sujet.

Ce que nous recherchons, c'est une personne qui fasse le lien entre ces possibilités et le quotidien des équipes : comprendre les besoins réels, prouver la valeur par des cas concrets, et donner envie à chacun de s'en emparer.

MISSIONS :

Votre rôle : être le catalyseur de l'adoption de l'IA dans toute la société. Vous travaillerez en lien étroit avec l'équipe de transformation digitale du groupe.

  1. Comprendre le terrain. Mener des entretiens dans toutes les équipes (ingénierie, projets, commerce, support client, etc..) pour identifier les irritants réels et les cas d'usage à fort potentiel.
  1. Poser un cadre. Cartographier les données par niveau de sensibilité et proposer des règles d'usage claires : quel outil pour quelle donnée.
  1. Prouver par l'exemple. Concevoir et déployer des POC sur les cas d'usage prioritaires, définir les indicateurs de gain et les mesurer.
  2. Embarquer les équipes. Rendre l'IA compréhensible et utile pour chacun : démonstrations sur le travail réel des équipes, ateliers, formations.
  1. Construire la feuille de route. Élaborer une feuille de route IA couvrant toutes les équipes et la présenter au CODIR.

En 6 mois : une feuille de route IA pour toutes les équipes, des POC déployés et utilisés, et un CODIR qui maîtrise réellement les possibilités de l'IA.

  1. Mois 1 : immersion et diagnostic. Entretiens dans toutes les équipes, cartographie des cas d'usage et des données, cadre d'usage proposé, indicateurs de gain définis et situation de départ mesurée.
  2. Mois 2 à 4 : preuves de valeur. POC déployés sur les cas d'usage prioritaires, premiers gains mesurés, premiers référents IA formés, session de sensibilisation du CODIR.
  3. Mois 5 et 6 : passage à l'échelle. Feuille de route IA présentée au CODIR, kit de réplication pour les sites à l'international, documentation pour assurer la continuité après le stage.

Requirements

Vous êtes en dernière année d'école d'ingénieurs, idéalement avec une double compétence management, et vous avez déjà construit des choses avec l'IA générative.

  • Formation : école d'ingénieurs (option data, IA ou informatique), ou double diplôme ingénieur et manager.

  • Pédagogie : vous savez expliquer simplement et donner envie, y compris à des personnes éloignées du sujet.
  • Écoute : vous êtes à l'aise pour mener des entretiens et comprendre un métier qui n'est pas le vôtre.
  • Autonomie et sens politique : vous savez prioriser, avancer seul(e) et embarquer des interlocuteurs de tous niveaux.
  • Anglais courant : la réplication se fera avec des équipes en Inde, en Australie, au Canada et au Royaume-Uni.

Benefits

title: System Engineer - System Architecture - Contra
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 

The role

As a Systems Engineer for C-UAS System-of-Systems, you own the high-level architecture of a distributed air defence capability.

You define the top-level architecture (L0 and L1), partitioning the capability into network, sensor, and effector subsystems and the interfaces between them. The architecture is open and hardware agnostic: any qualified node can join the network. It is controlled centrally but is designed to keep operating when nodes are lost or contested, so that no single point of failure breaks the chain. This is the layer that enables engage-on-remote and launch-on-remote, where the effector need not sit with the sensor that cued it.

This is a role for someone who thinks at the level of the whole system. Your decisions on architecture, networking, and interfaces determine whether a distributed capability performs as one coherent whole under real operational conditions.

The day-to-day

  • Own the top-level (L0/L1) architecture of the C-UAS system-of-systems, partitioning the mission into network, sensor, and effector subsystems

  • Specify the network capabilities that let distributed nodes share a common air picture and coordinate engagements, including decentralised operation when the central command node is degraded or absent

  • Derive network, sensor, and effector requirements from the operational concept, and own the trade-offs between coverage, resilience, latency, and cost

  • Translate operational concepts into a coherent system architecture and clear engagement concepts, then hold that architecture consistent as the design matures

  • Keep the architecture open and hardware agnostic, establishing the interfaces that let any qualified node join the network

  • Enable engage-on-remote and launch-on-remote by defining how cueing, track handover, and fire control flow across nodes

  • Produce a structured architecture that can be exposed externally to partners and customers at the right level of abstraction, without disclosing sensitive detail

  • Collaborate daily with the situational awareness and interceptor integration teams, and with AI, software, and hardware engineers, to keep the system-of-systems coherent

You should apply if you

  • Have hands-on experience architecting distributed systems or systems-of-systems, ideally for defence, air defence, C-UAS, or comparable networked mission systems

  • Can define top-level architectures and derive network, sensor, and effector requirements from an operational concept

  • Understand distributed and decentralised system design: how nodes share state, degrade gracefully, and coordinate without a single point of failure

  • Have a strong foundation in requirements management and interface definition

  • Can communicate an architecture clearly to both internal engineering teams and external partners and customers

  • Hold a university degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace, Computer Science, or a related field

  • Are business fluent in German and English

  • Are willing to travel

  • Your personal values match ours: ownership, initiative, dedication to mission, speed and inclusiveness

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Nice to Have

  • Working knowledge of tactical networking, mesh communications, or resilient data links in contested environments

  • Familiarity with air defence engagement concepts, kill-chain design, or NATO C-UAS framework

Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 

  • Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns

  • The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world

  • Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward

  • In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts

  • We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and VSOP options

  • Relocation support: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation

  • Learning: €500/£450 yearly allowance

  • Health & wellness: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)

  • Social: regular company events and monthly social allowances

  • Enhanced parental leave: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers

  • Family support: 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work

  • A hands-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled “Infraduction”), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one 

Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

Reporting to the VP of Tax, you will turn agreed tax strategy into practical structures and oversee technical quality across transactions, international tax and non-US tax operations.   • Oversee the non-US compliance and reporting framework through the Compliance and Operations Senior Manager, reviewing significant tax accounting and indirect tax judgements.

  • Direct external advisers on agreed workstreams, challenge recommendations and fees, and maintain clear records of decisions and implementation requirements.

  • A recognised tax, accountancy or legal qualification, such as CTA, ACA, CA or an equivalent qualification.

Werde Teil unserer Mission, werde Teil von Doctolib!

Über eine halbe Million Gesundheitsfachkräfte und Millionen von Patient:innen nutzen Doctolib täglich. Damit unsere Kund:innen den vollen Wert unserer Lösungen ausschöpfen, suchen wir in Berlin eine Führungskraft, die unser Customer Success & Account Management Team für den Bestandskundenbereich leitet – in Vollzeit.

Die Rolle vereint zwei Verantwortungen: Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Bestandskund:innen nach der Implementierung erfolgreich mit Doctolib arbeiten, und Du verantwortest gleichzeitig das Wachstum in diesen Accounts. Dein Team von 6-10 Customer Success Manager:innen und Account Manager:innen trägt ein gemeinsames Retention- und Expansion-Ziel – Du führst es dorthin.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Führung und Weiterentwicklung eines Teams von 6-10 Customer Success Manager:innen und Account Manager:innen – von Coaching und Zielsetzung über 1:1s bis zur Rekrutierung neuer Teammitglieder

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer Upsell- und Cross-Sell-Strategie für unser Bestandskundenportfolio – mit klarem Fokus auf langfristigem Kundenerfolg statt kurzfristigem Abschluss

  • Sicherstellung einer exzellenten Kundenbetreuung nach der Implementierung: Dein Team ist erste Anlaufstelle und sorgt für nachhaltige, optimale Nutzung unserer Software

  • Aufbau von Prozessen, die Retention und Wachstum planbar machen: Segmentierung, Health Scoring, Eskalationswege, Übergaben zwischen Sales, Implementation und Support

  • Steuerung anhand relevanter KPIs (u. a. Net Revenue Retention, Churn, Upsell-Umsatz, Aktivierungsgrad) und regelmäßiges Reporting an die Bereichsleitung

Dein Profil

Du bist überzeugt, dass Du das Richtige mitbringst? Dann bewirb Dich – auch wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst. Vielleicht bist Du genau die/der richtige Doctoliber:in für diese oder eine andere Stelle.

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit:

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der disziplinarischen Führung eines Teams im Customer Success, Account Management oder Vertrieb – idealerweise mit Berührungspunkten zu beiden Welten

  • Verhandlungsgeschick und Überzeugungskraft, auch in schwierigen Kundensituationen und auf Entscheider-Ebene

  • Ausgeprägte kommunikative Fähigkeiten im Umgang mit Kund:innen, angrenzenden Abteilungen und internationalen Teams

Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem:

  • Erfahrung im SaaS-Umfeld, insbesondere mit erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten und wiederkehrenden Umsätzen

  • Kenntnisse des deutschen Gesundheitswesens oder Erfahrung im Vertrieb an Praxen, MVZ oder Kliniken

title: Tech Lead - New Customers Team
descriptionHtml:
Tech Lead - New Customers Team

Hybrid in London, UK

We’re looking for a Tech Lead

You'll lead the engineering behind how new businesses become iwoca customers – the application they fill in, the checks they go through, and the offer they get.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The New Customers team owns everything from a business's first application to a funded loan: the application flow, the logic that routes each application, the documents we ask customers for, and the models that set loan amounts and pricing. Its measure of success is the customer lifetime value it adds between sign-up and first loan.

The team sets its own goals and direction. It brings together engineers, data scientists, and product and strategy people. It partners closely with credit risk on the trade-offs behind every lending decision. Knowledge sharing is central to how the team works, supported by regular forums to share findings, and dedicated research and development time.

You'll lead two engineers and report to the head of engineering for iwoca's customer journey, from first application to repeat lending.

The role

As the Tech Lead, you'll spend most of your time building. The team is moving its offer logic out of a legacy monolith into a new service. It's the biggest change in a decade to the system behind iwoca's lending decisions. The next phase is yours to lead.

  • Autonomy and ownership. You'll shape what the team builds, decide how to build it, and own what goes live. You'll set its engineering roadmap, including what to pull out of the monolith, what to rewrite, and in what order.

  • Technical complexity. You'll design the team's part of the new service, which turns models and rules into a lending decision and optimises each offer across amount, duration, fee, and interest rate. You'll keep it reliable in production, easy to change as the models evolve, and able to show how it reached each decision.

  • Experimentation and learning. You'll build the systems that let data scientists test new models on live applications. Some experiments run for years, until each loan reaches the end of its term. You'll see the long-term results of the team's lending decisions.

  • Influence. You'll get colleagues across iwoca behind technical work that competes with new features for time.

  • Leadership and growth. You'll line-manage and coach the team's engineers, setting context and helping them own projects end to end. As the team grows, you'll decide the skills and make-up it needs, and hire the engineers to match.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Technical leadership. You've led a team of engineers for at least two years, including line management, while still remaining hands on.

  • Backend engineering. You have deep expertise in at least one object-oriented language. You've designed, built, and run customer-facing backend systems in production.

  • Commercial or product thinking. You take a business goal, get to the root of what's needed and why, and turn it into a technical plan. You can explain a trade-off in terms of what it means for customers and the business.

  • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to deliver engineering work you couldn't have done alone. You help your team do the same. You judge where it's useful. You check its output before it reaches production.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Lending or payments experience. You've worked in lending, payments, or another domain where engineering decisions carry financial risk.

  • Experimentation. You've built systems that run controlled experiments, especially long-running ones.

  • Legacy migration. You've moved business-critical logic out of a complex legacy monolith and kept everything that depends on it working.

  • Working with data scientists. You've worked with data scientists from prototype to production, and know their work well enough to challenge it.

  • Python stack. You've worked with Python, Django, and PostgreSQL.

  • Frontend. You've built frontend features as well as backend services.

The salary

We expect to pay from £100,000 to £130,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: Technical Product Lead - AI Finance App
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

title: Technical Product Manager - Consumer Platforms
descriptionHtml:
Our vision is to give everyone the belief they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler, by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust, and belief to make it happen.

We’re home to the UK’s largest choice of properties and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what’s on the market. 

The Role 

Joining the Consumer Platforms team, you’ll help make Rightmove fast, consistent and easy to build on, so that our consumer product teams can ship great experiences with confidence. The team owns the shared foundations behind our website and apps: SEO and AI discoverability, site performance and accessibility, the design system, cross-team technical standards, client storage and analytics and tracking, and the third-party tooling that powers experimentation and CRM. 

Your customers are mostly internal: Product Managers, Engineers, Security, and Data and Analytics colleagues. You’ll learn where they struggle, turn that into a clear roadmap, and prove the impact in terms of both team productivity and outcomes. 

You’ll work day to day with the team’s Engineering Manager, Principal Engineers and Technical Architects. You’ll need to be as comfortable debating implementation detail with them as you are shaping priorities with product leaders. 

What you’ll own 

Our platform covers a lot of ground. Your main focus will be: 

  • Search and AI discoverability: establishing the framework that gives product teams clear visibility of how SEO and AI search (GEO) are performing, so they can act on it earlier. You’ll be the central point of contact for our dedicated SEO agency, and you’ll know enough about SEO and GEO to represent them well and help teams make good decisions 
  • Shared foundations: the design system, accessibility, and technical standards that product teams build to 
  • Data and tooling: analytics and tracking, client storage, and third-party tools such as our experimentation and CRM platforms, including how well they perform, what they cost and how they’re used 

How you'll spend your time

title: Technical Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
Rematiq helps healthcare and life sciences companies move faster through complex regulatory and quality workflows with AI. Our mission is to reduce the complexity that slows medical innovation down and help more products reach patients faster.

We already work with leading healthcare and life sciences companies, including Novartis, solving real regulatory and operational problems in a highly complex industry.

As a Technical Program Manager, Regulatory Monitoring, you’ll own our Regulatory Monitoring product area end-to-end, combining hands-on technical ownership with product, team, and customer leadership. You’ll help build and lead a small team of engineers, set priorities and technical direction, and remain deeply involved yourself — reviewing code, debugging production issues, and shipping fixes when needed.

Regulatory Monitoring tells our customers what regulators published overnight. It monitors more than 70 regulatory sources across the EU, the US, China, and other markets, captures new and changed guidance, legislation, decrees, and consultations, and delivers them into the customer’s Regulatory Inbox. You’ll work directly with regulatory affairs teams at pharma and MedTech customers to turn their needs into a clear roadmap and make sure coverage, data quality, and reliability stay high. Coding agents build many of the sources, while engineers review and improve them.

 

We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week.

What you'll do

  • Own monitoring end to end: Turn customer needs and coverage gaps into priorities, specs and shipped sources, and answer for the coverage, reliability and relevance of what reaches the inbox.

  • Lead customer alignment: Join customer calls, maintain the source list per customer, clarify scope, and separate what is included from what is an upsell.

  • Lead the scraping team: Set priorities for two engineers, one on architecture and infrastructure and one on sources and features, and write the tickets and specs they build from.

  • Stay hands-on: Review pull requests, debug failed production runs, and ship a fix yourself when that is the fastest way.

  • Shape the roadmap: Decide what gets built next, including news feeds, ontology-based filtering and classification, and alerts when a regulator changes its site and a scraper breaks.

  • Scale source building with AI agents: Improve the agent workflow that builds sources so the team adds more sources per week and more of them pass review the first time.

  • Build the team: Help grow the Regulatory Monitoring engineering team and set a high bar for technical quality, ownership, and delivery.

What we're looking for

We are looking for a technical owner with product judgment, customer presence and the ability to read and write code.

You may be a strong fit if you have:

  • Relevant background: 2+ years in product leadership (Founder, Head of Product/Engineering or similar) and at least 3 years of hands-on coding as a software engineer, ideally on a data product.

  • Hands-on technical depth: You read a TypeScript pull request and judge whether it is correct, understand a Node.js and PostgreSQL service well enough to debug a failed production run, and can ship a fix yourself.

  • End-to-end product ownership: You have owned a product with paying customers from scoping through prioritization and requirements to operations, and were measured on outcomes rather than on tickets closed.

  • Strong customer presence: You run calls with enterprise customer teams independently, manage scope and expectations, and say no when a request is out of scope.

  • Team leadership: You have set priorities for engineers, defined the requirements they built from and reviewed their work. Hiring experience is a plus.

  • AI-native working style: You work with coding agents such as Claude Code or Cursor every day and have a view on how to make agent-built code reliable.

  • Operational discipline: You notice a failed nightly run before the customer does, and you put monitoring and alerts in place so that this does not depend on you.

  • Fluency in English (mandatory). German is a strong plus.

We'll be especially excited if you

  • Have built or operated web scraping, crawling or data ingestion pipelines at scale.

  • Know regulatory affairs or quality management, ideally in Pharma or MedTech.

  • Have been a founder or a very early employee and can show founder-like ownership.

Why Join Rematiq?

  • Real Ownership: You will own a strategic product area end-to-end

  • Agent-First Engineering: You’ll work at the frontier of how software gets built when agents become part of the core loop

  • Direct Business Impact: Your work will shape product direction and drive real revenue

  • Meaningful Mission: You’ll help leading healthcare companies move faster — and support more medical innovation in the process

  • Strong Customers: We already work with leading healthcare companies, including Novartis

  • Small Team, High Agency: You’ll work closely with founders in an ambitious, execution-focused environment

  • Tools That Match the Ambition: Large token budget, real freedom to experiment, and the chance to push modern coding agents to their limits

  • Compensation: Competitive salary and meaningful equity

descriptionHtml:

Dans le cadre de nos missions, nous axons notre développement sur une approche mixte IT et financière, du diagnostic jusqu’à la mise en place des recommandations et nous intervenons en collaboration étroite avec les membres de la Direction Générale.

En rejoignant notre équipe Transformation IT, vous interviendrez principalement dans les contextes suivants :

  • Accompagnement des opérations M&A :

    • Dans un contexte de transaction, vous participerez aux « IT Due Diligences » dans lesquels vous présenterez un état des lieux de l’entreprise d’un point de vue IT : organisation de la DSI, stratégie et projets, infrastructure, applications, analyses des dépenses IT.

    • Dans un contexte de détourage d’actifs

      • Vous réaliserez une « IT Due Diligence » de ou des entités concernées en insistant sur les enjeux de dépendance et d’adhérence vis-à-vis du groupe / du vendeur ;

      • Vous évaluerez les éléments IT ayant un impact sur la valeur des actifs ;

      • Vous participerez à l’élaboration de plan de séparation et à la rédaction des TSA.

    • Dans un contexte d’intégration

      • Vous définirez la stratégie d’intégration de l’entité cible, la recherche de synergies, la définition et la déclinaison opérationnelle de projets d’intégration, l’optimisation des coûts et du planning d’intégration ;

      • Vous challengerez les propositions d’intégration d’éventuels prestataires.

      • Vous participerez au suivi des différents chantiers d’intégration.

  • Conduite de la transformation IT & Digitale :

    • Vous participerez à la définition de plans de transformation IT et digitale, visant à soutenir la stratégie de développement ou de reconstruction de l’entreprise ;

    • Vous travaillerez à l’élaboration de schémas directeurs : planning, coûts, ressources, priorisation des projets, etc. ;

    • Vous pourrez suivre et piloter les différents chantiers de ce schéma directeur pour en assurer le bon déroulement.

  • Pilotage et amélioration de la performance :

    • Vous assisterez nos clients dans l’amélioration et le contrôle de leur performance IT, en particulier à l’audit de projets IT et à la revue de la performance de la DSI ;

    • Vous accompagnerez nos clients dans la rédaction de cahier des charges, en les assistant dans le choix des outils répondant à leurs besoins ;

    • Vous participerez à la définition et mise en œuvre de plan d’actions impactant l’EBITDA et/ou la trésorerie (réduction des coûts IT, réorganisation de la DSI, optimisation des projets, etc.) ;

    • Dans le cadre d’un accompagnement de nos clients en situation de perte de rentabilité, manque de visibilité ou de compréhension des flux de la part des managers (actionnaires ou société mère), vous participerez à la réalisation de diagnostics mêlant finance & IT, à l’accompagnement à la renégociation de contrats, à l’élaboration de plans d’amélioration de la rentabilité et de rationalisation de la DSI, puis à la mise en œuvre opérationnelle.


Nous recherchons pour ces missions des candidats de formation supérieure (Bac+5 –école d’ingénieur ou école de commerce de rang A), ayant acquis une expérience probante parmi les suivantes :

  • Une expérience dans le conseil durant laquelle il/elle aura développé de solides compétences IT & digitales avec une appétence pour l’analyse des impacts financiers attendus.

Vous êtes dotés de qualités relationnelles et analytiques reconnues. descriptionHtml:

Renting a place to stay is still slow, stressful and full of surprises. We're fixing that. With The Flex you pick your apartment, book in a few clicks and move in. Everything is handled for you: hotel-level service with the comfort of a real home.

You make sure the founder's time goes to what matters most. You run priorities, follow up on every project and keep the team moving. Perform well and you can grow into running The Flex in Algeria.

 

What you'll do

 

  • Set weekly priorities with the founder and track them.

What you get

  • Accommodation provided by The Flex.

  • A clear path to lead the country.

Who you are

 

  • A French-Algerian living in France who wants to build something back home.

  • Fluent in English. English is our working language across London, Berlin, Lisbon and beyond.

  • Open-minded. You've travelled, studied or worked abroad, or you love working with people from different cultures.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, pressure and speed.

Leading user experience for the Channel Landing Pages group, this role shapes the strategic direction for how travelers explore, decide, and book. title: UX Research Intern
descriptionHtml:
About baesh

baesh is a social platform connecting people in real life through events, communities, and shared interests.

We’re a small team using AI to move quickly from ideas to working experiences. Research is central to how we decide what to build and whether it’s good enough to ship. Your work will help us stay close to people as the technology moves faster.

You’ll work closely with our Head of Product and UX, an experienced researcher with a PhD in emotional and behavioural research. You’ll get practical guidance across the research process—from deciding what to investigate to helping the team act on what we learn.

This is an unpaid mandatory internship for students whose university programme requires a placement.

  • Location: Mostly remote, with opportunities to join research and events in Berlin.

  • Start date: Flexible, depending on your university requirements.

  • Duration: As required by your university, usually 3–6 months.

What you’ll help with

Usability testing and idea validation

  • Help plan and run usability tests on our app and prototypes, including interfaces built with AI.

  • Explore how easily people can discover events, join communities, and create their profiles.

  • Test whether experiences make sense to real people, beyond looking polished or functioning technically.

  • Validate early ideas and assumptions before the team invests further.

  • Identify confusing moments and recommend improvements that make a meaningful difference.

Exploratory research and interviews

  • Help interview existing users and people who haven’t tried baesh yet.

  • Explore how people make friends, find things to do, and connect with communities.

  • Understand their needs, motivations, habits, and barriers.

  • Help write discussion guides and ask open questions that uncover useful insights.

  • Bring people’s experiences into product decisions, keeping the human connection at the heart of how we build.

AI-supported research

  • Use AI to help draft interview guides, usability-testing scripts, and survey questions.

  • Explore how AI can support research synthesis by organising notes, summarising sessions, and suggesting patterns.

  • Check AI-generated summaries and interpretations against what participants actually said and did.

  • Learn where AI saves time, where it misses nuance, and where your judgement matters most.

  • Help us develop practical ways to combine faster research workflows with thoughtful, reliable findings.

Recruitment and ongoing feedback

  • Help recruit participants and coordinate research sessions.

  • Support Friends of BAESH, our community of early adopters who contribute through interviews, user testing, feedback, and feature suggestions.

  • Help create short in-app surveys about specific parts of the experience.

Making sense of what we learn

  • Analyse feedback and identify patterns across sessions.

  • Turn findings into clear insights and practical recommendations.

  • Share research with the product and development team to shape what happens next.

  • Help organise our research so we can build on previous learning.

You won’t be expected to do all of this independently from day one. We’ll guide you, give you feedback, and gradually help you take ownership of research activities.

What you’ll bring

  • You’re enrolled in a degree programme that requires a mandatory internship.

  • An interest in UX research, psychology, human–computer interaction, design, sociology, or a related field.

  • Curiosity about people and a willingness to question assumptions.

  • Good listening skills and an empathetic, respectful approach.

  • Strong communication skills in English.

  • An organised approach and willingness to take initiative.

  • An interest in using AI thoughtfully, including questioning its output.

Preferred, but not required:

  • German-speaking, so you can support research with German-speaking participants.

  • Some familiarity with interviews, usability testing, surveys, or qualitative analysis—university projects count.

  • Experience experimenting with AI tools for research, writing, analysis, or prototyping.

  • An interest in social products, communities, and how digital experiences support real-life connections.

You don’t need previous professional UX research experience. We’re looking for curiosity, care, and a willingness to learn.

What you’ll gain

  • Research mentorship: Learn directly from an experienced UX and behavioural researcher.

  • Practical experience: Contribute to exploratory interviews, usability testing, surveys, and idea validation.

  • Experience with AI-enabled product development: Learn how to assess and improve products when building is fast and informed judgement matters more than ever.

  • Visible impact: See your findings shape the experiences we build and release.

  • Portfolio experience: Develop research case studies, with guidance on what can be shared.

  • Flexible working: Agree a schedule that fits your university’s placement requirements.

  • A small, collaborative team: Work closely with the people designing and building the product.

Interested?

If you have relevant university work or a portfolio, we’d love to see it—but it’s optional.
