title: Value Consultant
descriptionHtml:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry: which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision. We help them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally. We are already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with near zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure. It’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company built to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Value Consulting team

The Pricing & Innovation team helps customers get the most from hx Renew, our market-leading SaaS pricing platform, and helps prospects and customers understand the value hx can create across pricing, underwriting and AI. Within it, Value Consulting turns complex customer problems into clear business cases, analysis and value stories that support better commercial decisions.

The team sits at the heart of our go-to-market motion, building the business cases and ROI stories that unlock strategic enterprise opportunities and drive adoption, expansion and long-term growth. You will work as a bridge between Sales, Product, Customer Success and senior customer stakeholders, turning ambiguous problems into quantified value stories that strengthen commercial conversations.

We are a small, high-ownership team. The culture is analytical, commercially minded and highly collaborative, with a strong expectation of independence, learning agility and comfort operating without a fully established playbook.

What you’ll be doing

  • Build clear, data-driven business cases and ROI models that quantify the financial impact of hx for prospects and customers, helping them make confident buying decisions.

  • Partner with Sales on strategic enterprise opportunities, getting involved early to shape tailored value narratives that accelerate deal cycles and increase win rates.

  • Run value workshops with stakeholders from junior underwriters to actuarial, pricing, transformation and executive leaders.

  • Develop benchmarking, ROI analysis and customer insight that give Sales and senior leaders compelling proof points for executive-level conversations.

  • Translate complex customer problems, workflows and data into simple, credible value stories.

  • Build the reusable models, benchmarks and templates that let Account Executives run a first-pass value case themselves on standard deals, so your time goes to the deals that need your judgement.

  • Continuously refine how we work, using AI and other tools to improve efficiency and impact.

What you’ll need to have done

  • Built robust business cases or ROI models for a technical or data-driven product, using clear assumptions and logic to demonstrate measurable commercial impact, that a buyer used to make a decision.

  • Presented numbers to a sceptical commercial or technical audience and held your ground when challenged.

  • Taken messy data and ambiguous customer problems through to clear, actionable recommendations, without close direction.

  • Translated complex quantitative analysis into simple, executive-ready stories or presentations that have influenced decision makers.

  • Worked cross-functionally with Sales, Product and Customer Success (or similar teams) to align on value drivers, messaging and success criteria.

  • Pushed back when a number was being stretched, because the case needed to be right.

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer highly defined, static playbooks and feel uncomfortable operating in ambiguity or helping to build the motion as you go.

  • You are not motivated by digging into the details of financial models, customer data and assumptions to create credible, defensible analysis.

  • You find it difficult to challenge or influence senior stakeholders, or you avoid direct collaboration with Sales on commercial outcomes.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process. Our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations, and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your Talent Partner will be able to share more details about this.

Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

  • Company pension scheme via Penfold.

  • Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

  • Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

  • Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

  • Income protection and Life Insurance.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

  • Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

  • Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

  • Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  1. Initial call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

  2. Hiring Manager interview (1 hour)

  3. Skills assessment (1 hour)

  4. Values interview (1 hour)

  5. Meet the CEO

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do; it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you’re energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

Why Join Us?

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers and more. All energised with an entrepreneurial, relentless spirit which helps us do big things as a team. In Operations, you’re at the heart of our marketplace — working directly with customers, riders and partners to keep Deliveroo moving.

What We Offer

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. title: Web Designer Intern (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Most of the internet looks the same now. Help us make sure our corner of it doesn't.

Cloud Studios is a product studio in Berlin. We build our own products and grow the strongest into companies. Our whole idea fits in one line: build what should exist.

We're looking for a Web Designer Intern to own how our websites look, feel and work. Ours, and our clients'.

What you'll work on

A wide range of work, across several brands at once:

  • Our own sites. The Cloud Studios and GetMOW websites are live, and they're never finished. You'll redesign pages, sharpen what's there and add what's missing.

  • Launches. We have new products in the pipeline. When one is ready to meet the world, you'll design the site it meets the world on, often starting from a blank page.

  • Client websites. We also design and build websites for clients. You'll take projects from first idea to live site, and help present them.

  • The details nobody asked for. Motion, interactions, the 404 page, what happens when you hover. That's where a website stops looking like everyone else's.

By the end of your internship, you'll have several live websites with your name on them.

Ownership, for real

You won't be pushing pixels on someone else's mockup. You'll get a brief, sometimes just a problem, and the freedom to answer it your way. You'll work directly with Eli, our founder, from the first idea to launch day, and see your work go live in weeks, not quarters.

That freedom comes with responsibility. If you think a page is wrong, say so and redesign it. Nobody here will ask you to stay in your lane.

About AI

Anyone can generate a website now. That's the problem. The internet is filling up with sites that look like they all came from the same prompt, and we're not hiring someone to make more of them.

We use AI every day, and we'd love it if you do too: to explore faster, prototype faster and build things you couldn't build alone. But the idea has to be yours. Your taste, your references, your weirdness. We want work that nobody could copy by typing the same prompt.

If something in your portfolio has made someone ask "how did you do that?", we want to see it.

Who you are

You've designed websites before, and you can show us. Client work, a side project, your own portfolio, a site for your friend's band: live sites count for more than concepts.

You have opinions about type, layout and motion. You notice when something is a few pixels off, and it bothers you. You'd rather make something strange that works than something safe that nobody remembers.

You'll need:

  • Experience designing websites, and a portfolio that proves it.

  • Strong skills in Figma or a similar design tool.

  • A real eye for typography, layout and motion.

  • Good English, written and spoken.

  • To work independently. You'll manage your own time and projects, whether you're at home or in the office.

Bonus points:

  • You can turn a design into a simple live page with a no-code tool like Framer or Webflow, or with a little HTML and CSS. Nice to have, not a must: you won't be writing production code here.

  • You've designed or built with AI before, and you have an opinion on where it helps and where it doesn't.

  • There's something in your portfolio you made purely because you wanted it to exist.

  • German.

A design role, not a development role

To be clear about what this is: this internship is about visual and interaction design. You'll spend your time on concepts, layouts, typography, motion and design systems, mostly in Figma. Development is handled separately.

If you're mainly a frontend developer who designs a bit on the side, this probably isn't the right fit. If you're a designer who can't stop thinking about how a site looks, feels and moves, it is.

What you get

  • Ownership early. Real websites, real clients and real launches, from your first week.

  • Creative freedom. We give you problems, not pixel specs.

  • A portfolio that's actually live. Websites real people use, not concepts in a Figma file.

  • Founder-level access. You work directly with Eli, and you see how a studio launches products.

  • Work from anywhere in Germany. Remote is fine. If you're in Berlin, or want to be, there's a desk for you at our office.

  • A way in. If it's a great fit, the conversation towards the end of your internship is about staying on.

How we work

  • Execution beats perfection. We ship, learn and improve. We don't wait for perfect.

  • Be a sponge. Learn from everyone, every project and every mistake.

  • Agency is a skill. Nobody hands you the next step. You find it.

  • Say it directly. We tell you what we think, and we expect the same back.

Who you'll work with

You'll work directly with Eli Cloud Läufer, who founded Cloud Studios in Berlin in autumn 2025, and alongside Öykü, our product designer, and Jenna in marketing and design.

Who can apply

You must live in Germany and be currently enrolled at a German university or in vocational training in Germany, and one of these must apply to you:

  1. Mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum): your study or training regulations require you to complete an internship. You'll need to confirm this with your enrollment certificate and your program's internship requirement.

  2. Voluntary internship alongside your studies: up to three months, and only if you have never interned at Cloud Studios before.

If neither applies to you, we unfortunately can't consider your application.

Details

  • Duration: Three to six months (mandatory internship) or up to three months (voluntary internship).

  • Working hours: 20 to 40 hours per week.

  • Location: Remote from anywhere in Germany, or from our Berlin office. You don't need to be in Berlin.

  • Start date: As soon as possible.

How to apply

Apply through our application form. It takes about ten minutes. The most important part is your portfolio, and the one project in it you'd fight for.

Show us something nobody else would have made.

Du musst nichts davon schon perfekt können. Wir brauchen jemanden, der schreiben kann, der mitdenkt und der Dinge zu Ende bringt. Den Rest zeigen wir dir.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission, falls du sie annimmst:

  • Unsere Social-Kanäle: Du planst, textest und veröffentlichst unsere eigenen Postings – Cases, Behind the Scenes, Team, Awards. LinkedIn ist unsere wichtigste Bühne. Dort findet unsere Branche statt: Kunden,Partner, potenzielle Kolleg:innen. Du sorgst dafür, dass dort regelmäßig etwas passiert, was nicht nach Unternehmensmeldung klingt. Instagram läuft parallel.

  • Award-Einreichungen: Du bereitest Cases für Awards und Festivals auf. Daten sammeln, Texte bauen, Fristen im Blick behalten.

  • Pressearbeit: Du schreibst Entwürfe für Pressemitteilungen, pflegst unseren Presseverteiler, behältst im Blick, wer in der Branche über was schreibt, und findest heraus, wo unsere Themen hinpassen.

  • Newsletter: Du hilfst uns, unseren Newsletter aufzubauen und zu befüllen – Themen sammeln, Texte schreiben, versenden, schauen was gelesen wird.

  • Website & Cases: Du hältst unsere Referenzen aktuell, damit wir nicht mit Projekten von vorgestern werben.

  • Mitdenken: Wenn dir auffällt, dass wir eine gute Geschichte liegen lassen, sagst du Bescheid. Oder machst sie einfach.

Die Strategie dahinter machen wir gemeinsam. Du musst nicht alleine entscheiden, wo die Reise geht – aber du bist die Person, die dafür sorgt, dass tatsächlich etwas rausgeht.

Qualifikation

Was wir wirklich brauchen:

  • Du kannst schreiben. Klar, lesbar, ohne Marketing-Floskeln und bestenfalls ist KI nur ein Begleiter. Das ist der Kern dieser Rolle. Deine Deutsch-Kenntnisse sollten entsprechend sehr gut sein.

  • Du bist eingeschrieben – idealerweise in Kommunikation, Medien, Marketing, Journalismus, PR oder etwas Benachbartem. Fachrichtung ist uns weniger wichtig als Schreiben und Kopf.

  • Du bringst Dinge zu Ende. Auch die unspektakulären. Ein Presseverteiler pflegt sich nicht von selbst.

  • Du hast ein Gefühl für unsere Branche oder zumindest echtes Interesse daran, was Creator, Brands und Agenturen gerade umtreibt.

Nice to have, kein Ausschluss:

Was du nicht brauchst: Agenturerfahrung, ein fertiges Portfolio oder Kenntnisse in zwölf Tools. Das ist eine Werkstudentenstelle, keine getarnte Senior-Position. Wir bauen das zusammen auf.

title: wo-stage woningmarkt onderzoek: verhuisketens, doorstroom en ouderenwoningen
descriptionHtml:
wo-afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027

Ben jij die analytische wo-student die nieuwsgierig is naar de doorstroom op de woningmarkt?
Krijg je energie van onderzoek doen, werken met data en programmeren in R?
Wil je jouw onderzoeksvaardigheden inzetten voor een actueel maatschappelijk vraagstuk?

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Verhuisketens geven inzicht in de doorstroom op de woningmarkt en zijn daardoor actueel en relevant. Het CBS heeft een methode ontwikkeld om deze ketens in beeld te brengen. Het dashboard Verhuisketens in Nederland toont onder meer de gemiddelde lengte van een verhuisketen. Er is echter nog veel ruimte voor verdieping.

Tijdens deze stage kun je afstudeeronderzoek doen naar de rol van ouderenwoningen in de doorstroom op de huizenmarkt. Je kunt daarin op zoek gaan naar antwoorden op de volgende vragen:

  • In hoeverre draagt het bouwen van ouderenwoningen bij aan de doorstroom op de woningmarkt?

  • Wat is de invloed van vergrijzing en overlijden van ouderen op de doorstroom en het woningaanbod?

Heb je zelf een goede onderzoeksvraag die aansluit bij dit thema, dan is daar ook ruimte voor.

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag

De afdeling Beleidsstatistiek bestaat uit 70 collega’s verdeeld over Den Haag en Heerlen. Er werken onderzoekers en projectleiders met veel verschillende studieachtergronden binnen onze afdeling. Wij stellen cijfers samen die gebruikt worden voor het ontwikkelen, monitoren en verbeteren van beleid, vaak met een thema-overstijgend karakter. We zijn samenwerkingspartner op het gebied van data-gedreven werken bij overheden.

Dit breng jij mee

Je bent bijna klaar met jouw wo master-opleiding in de sociale wetenschappen, demografie, ruimtelijke ordening of een aanverwante opleiding en zoekt een afstudeerstage om je opleiding succesvol af te ronden.

Daarnaast:

  • heb je (enige) ervaring met programmeren in R;

  • kun je zelfstandig onderzoek uitvoeren en uitkomsten analyseren;

  • weet je hoe je met verschillende methoden en technieken onderzoek doet.

Kernwoorden die jou omschrijven zijn enthousiast, proactief en analytisch.

Omdat alle communicatie tijdens de stage – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • jouw vakkennis vergroot en werkervaring opdoet;

  • programmeervaardigheden toepast in de praktijk;

  • leert werken met CBS-data.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken.

Dit zijn onze voorwaarden

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.
Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking.

descriptionHtml:
01 · Why this role exists

This year, RIZM has created unprecedented savings at our customers. We just aren't telling anyone. If you love telling stories, let's talk.

RIZMO is our Agentic Energy Manager: an AI agent that helps industrial companies optimize their energy use and cut costs. We work with BMW, Stellantis, Boehringer Ingelheim and Bitburger. Right now, those success stories stay inside the project team. You'll change that.

02 · What you'll do

You'll be our communications all-rounder and work directly with the founders and the go-to-market team.

  • Storytelling: Turn customer projects, technology and energy-market developments into stories that a CFO or plant manager reads to the end.

  • Video: Make short videos about customer projects and RIZMO, from concept and editing through to sign-off with the customer.

  • PR: Pitch stories to business and trade media (Handelsblatt, manager magazin and others), write press releases and prepare interviews.

  • LinkedIn: Plan and write content for our company page, and help the founders and GTM team with their own posts. We don't do Instagram, TikTok or blogs. Our audience is on LinkedIn and reads Handelsblatt.

  • Events: Prepare our presence at trade fairs like E-world and Hannover Messe. That covers materials, booking meetings in advance and following up with the contacts we make.

  • B2B marketing for long sales cycles: Our deals take months and involve many decision-makers. You'll build case studies and one-pagers that support a deal from first contact to signature.

03 · What you bring

  • Student status: You're enrolled at a university. Your field doesn't matter (communications, journalism, business, industrial engineering, energy …) as long as you write well.

  • Languages: Excellent German and good English.

  • Curiosity: Energy, industry and AI interest you. We'll teach you the technical side.

  • Ownership: You work independently, ask when something is unclear, and deliver.

  • Nice to have: Experience with video editing, PR or event organization.

  • Availability: 20 hours per week on-site in Münster or Munich, for at least 6 months, ideally longer.

descriptionHtml:
About us:

DeepJudge is Switzerland’s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry.

Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage.

Our technology is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O’Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it.

About the role:

As a Working Student Quality Assurance - Legal Track, you'll join a strong team of quality assurance professionals, help maintain the high quality of our product, and ensure our customers derive the greatest possible value from it. Your primary responsibility will be to thoroughly test our key features with every product release, ensuring that our users have a seamless product experience. This is a great opportunity for a quality-driven student who approaches their work with precision and dedication.

What you’ll do

  • Test new features and releases from the perspective of a legal end user — associates, in-house counsel, M&A teams

  • Map out and stress-test full user flows, not just individual functions — where does the experience feel clunky, confusing, or slow?

  • Document bugs and usability issues clearly enough that engineering can act on them fast

  • Flag legal/domain edge cases a non-lawyer tester would likely miss

What we’re looking for:

  • Currently studying law (Bachelor's or Master's)

  • You think like an associate: structured, detail-oriented, quick to notice when something doesn't add up

  • A sharp eye for usability — you notice when something works but doesn't feel right

  • Comfortable giving direct, well-organized feedback in writing

  • Have excellent command of English, both written and spoken

  • Are interested in legal technology and highly motivated to learn about the needs of our customers

  • Based in or able to commute to Zurich, available Mondays and Tuesdays

These aren’t required, but they’ll make you a stronger candidate:

  • Practical legal experience: internship, clerkship, or clinic work, ideally at a larger law firm or in-house team

  • Exposure to M&A, corporate, or transactional work

  • Familiarity with legal AI tools, or a genuine interest in the intersection of law and technology

What you can look forward to:

  • A real, up-close look at how one of Switzerland's fastest-growing startups operates

  • A fast-track into the Zurich tech and startup network

  • A modern office just 5 minutes by foot from Zurich main station.

  • Direct exposure to how engineering teams build and ship product

  • A front-row seat to where the legal industry is heading
